text.title: Tracking Down the Scepter
text.objectives: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.
text.description: The logbook contains the latest information on the Scepter of Sargeras. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

english.title: Tracking Down the Scepter
english.objectives: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.
english.description: The logbook contains the latest information on the Scepter of Sargeras. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

text.title: 突袭守望高塔：黑暗信徒尖塔

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭吉尔尼斯旅的队长
消灭吉尔尼斯旅的狼人

text.title: 突袭守望高塔：黑暗信徒尖塔
渡鸦之眼
text.objectives: 听瓦莉拉讲述渡鸦之眼的传说。
text.description:
我们必须破译军情七处的信件，搞清楚里头的秘密，否则就迟了。但是我们最优秀的破译员到现在都没有头绪。

不过，我们现在已经知道那个传说是真的了。渡鸦之眼是真实存在的。

我们应该把它告诉其他人吗？

english.title: The Raven's Eye
english.objectives: Listen to Valeera's tale of the Raven's Eye.
english.description:
It is imperative that we decipher the SI:7 letter. We must uncover the secrets that it holds before it is too late. But, our best code breakers have yet to make a dent in the cypher.

However, we now know that the myth is in fact reality. The Raven's Eye truly exists.

Shall we tell the others?

text.title: 前往庭院
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉的渡鸦庭院与瓦莉拉·萨古纳尔碰头。
text.description:
我们就从黑鸦堡垒的渡鸦庭院开始搜查。黑鸦堡垒是上古之战时期的暗夜精灵英雄——库塔洛斯·拉文凯斯的老家。我的一些祖先就埋葬在那边的墓地里。

我们到那里碰头，小心不要被跟踪。军情七处的人可不是吃素的。我们必须比他们更谨慎。

english.title: Off to Court
english.objectives: Meet up with Valeera Sanguinar at Ravencourt in Val'sharah.
english.description:
The Ravencourt of Black Rook Hold is where we begin our search. It is the ancestral home of Lord Kur'talos Ravencrest, night elven hero of the War of the Ancients. Some of my own ancient ancestors are interred in its cemetery.

Meet me there and make sure that you are not followed. SI:7 is very good at what they do. We have to be better.

text.title: 寻找渡鸦之眼
text.objectives: 打开上古精灵宝箱，寻找渡鸦之眼。
text.description:
渡鸦之眼应该就在庭院的某个地方。这里是拉文凯斯的副官们生前部署战略的地方。看来，他们在死后仍然在这么做。

渡鸦之眼一定就在附近。你的开锁技术现在真是弥足珍贵。

english.title: In Search of the Eye
english.objectives: Pick the locks of the Ancient Chests to find the Raven's Eye.
english.description:
The Raven's Eye should be somewhere within the courtyard. This is where Ravencrest's lieutenants used to plan their strategies in life. Hell, it looks like they still might be doing so in death.

It has to be around here somewhere. Your skill at lock picking should prove invaluable.

text.title: 不得安宁
text.objectives: 让塞丝塔·星眼、曼德尔·夜魔和特瑞尔·月刃安息。
text.description:
我的祖先就埋葬在西边的墓地里。不知道是什么东西让亡者又死而复生了，现在他们的灵魂都不得安宁。

血精灵是高等精灵的后裔。在大分裂之前，他们都是来自这片土地。

我实在下不了手。你能去让我的祖先安息吗？

english.title: Eternal Unrest
english.objectives: Put Cesta Stargazer, Mandrel Nightsbane, and T'rel Moonblade to rest.
english.description:
My ancient ancestors are buried here in the cemetery to the west. Because of whatever is causing the dead to rise, their souls are now at unrest.

All blood elves are descended from high elves, who in turn came from these lands before they were sundered.

I cannot bring myself to do it. Will you put my ancestors to rest?

text.title: 噬魂之喉：古老的维库传说
text.objectives: 找些帮手，登上噬魂之喉的纳格法尔号幽灵船，并拓印渡鸦之眼石板。
text.description:
我们在风暴峡湾靠声东击西的手段发现了一些情报，我曾经以为那只是一个神话。

传说维库人在人类诞生以前制作了一件魔法珠宝。据说这件珠宝可以……

<瓦莉拉停下来四下看了看，然后斜眼看着你。>

在找到证据以前，我不想谈这个。

不幸的是，要想找到证据，我们就得进入噬魂之喉并登上纳格法尔号……那可是一艘幽灵船。
text.completed: 返回暗影大厅去找瓦莉拉·萨古纳尔。

english.title: Maw of Souls: Ancient Vrykul Legends
english.objectives: Gather a group and take an etching of the Raven's Eye Tablet on the ship of the dead, The Naglfar, in the Maw of Souls.
english.description:
Our diversionary tactics in Stormheim uncovered intel on something I thought only a myth.

There is a legend about a magical jewel the vrykul created long before the time of man. The jewel was said to be able to...

<Valeera stops herself from continuing while looking around and eyeing you wryly.>

I do not want to talk about it just yet. Not until we have proof.

Unfortunately, the only way we are going to get that proof is in the Maw of Souls on the Naglfar... the ship of the dead.
english.completed: Return to Valeera Sanguinar in the Chamber of Shadows.

text.title: 破坏仪式
text.objectives: 搭乘魔蝠前往萨格拉斯之墓并窃取萨格拉斯权杖。
text.description: 好戏上场了，朋友！古尔丹要举行他的重大仪式，为这个世界招来毁灭。卡里杜斯相信，只要拿走权杖就能阻止他的计划。$b$b乘坐这只魔蝠前往萨格拉斯之墓，找到仪式地点，并偷走权杖。哦……然后逃走！$b$b卡里杜斯会尽量帮忙的！祝你好运！朋友！

english.title: Ritual Ruination
english.objectives: Take the Fel Bat to the Tomb of Sargeras and steal the Scepter of Sargeras.
english.description: Time for main event, friend! Gul'dan wants to begin his big ritual, cause end times for this world. Calydus confident getting the Scepter will stop that plan.$b$bTake this bat to Tomb of Sargeras, find ritual, steal Scepter. Oh... and get out!$b$bCalydus will help when he can! Good luck, friend!

objectiveDetails.description: 逃往达拉然与卡里杜斯见面
搭乘魔蝠前往破碎海滩

text.title: 小心那棵扭曲之树
text.objectives: 调查鲑鱼溪的扭曲之树。
text.description: $R，你必须保持警惕。瓦尔莎拉的邪恶力量非常强大。我曾亲眼见识过，并且宁愿从未见过。如果愿意听从我的劝告，你就远离鲑鱼溪的扭曲之树。

english.title: Beware of the Crooked Tree
english.objectives: Investigate the crooked tree in Bradensbrook.
english.description: $R, you must be warned. There is great evil in Val'sharah. I've seen it, and I wish I hadn't. If you take my advice, you will stay far away from the crooked tree in Bradensbrook.

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.objectives: 招募纳兹戈林和萨萨里安。
text.description: 你的力量十分强大，死亡领主，不过个人的力量不足为凭。$b$b如果要阻止燃烧军团毁灭这个世界，我们就需要强大的盟友。黑锋骑士团已经向你效忠，你应该善用他们的力量。$b$b去跟纳兹戈林和萨萨里安谈谈吧。在对抗燃烧军团的战争中，他们可以发挥巨大的作用。

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.objectives: Recruit Nazgrim and Thassarian.
english.description: Your power is great, Deathlord, but power alone will not be sufficient.$b$bIf we are to save this world from the onslaught of the Burning Legion, then you will need powerful allies. The Knights of the Ebon Blade are yours to command, it will be wise to make use of them effectively.$b$bGo and speak with Nazgrim and Thassarian. They will be of great use to you in the fight against the Burning Legion.

text.title: 散布消息
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“散布消息”任务。
text.description: 你已经招募好勇士，现在可以使用侦察地图在破碎群岛执行重要的任务。$B$B第一个任务关系到组织的发展和力量。派纳兹戈林和萨萨里安去为黑锋骑士团寻找新鲜血液吧。$b$b要打败燃烧军团的话，我们的组织就必须不断壮大。

english.title: Spread the Word
english.objectives: Use the Scouting map and complete "Spread the Word."
english.description: Now that you have recruited your champions, you can use the Scouting Map to complete vital missions across the Broken Isles.$b$bThe first mission is critical to the growth and power of our order. Send Nazgrim and Thassarian to seek out new candidates for the Ebon Blade.$b$bOur order must grow in strength if we are to defeat the Burning Legion.

text.title: 壮大部队
text.objectives: 与黑暗召唤师马洛格谈一谈，以召唤食尸鬼。
text.description: 有一位强大的通灵师加入了黑锋骑士团。$b$b黑暗召唤师马洛格从暗影界千里迢迢赶过来，他将成为黑锋骑士团的强大盟友。$b$b跟他谈谈，让他开始为我们召唤一支食尸鬼大军。

english.title: Recruiting the Troops
english.objectives: Speak with Dark Summoner Marogh to summon ghouls.
english.description: A powerful necromancer has joined the cause of the Ebon Blade.$b$bDark Summoner Marogh has come a long way to us from deep within the realm of the Shadowlands. He will be a powerful ally of the Ebon Blade.$b$bSpeak with Dark Summoner Marogh to begin raising an army of ghouls for the Ebon Blade.

text.title: 部队出勤
text.objectives: 使用指挥台，完成“部队出勤”任务。
text.description: 是时候派出我们新招募的食尸鬼上战场了。使用指挥台，派出你的勇士和部队执行日常侦察任务。

english.title: Troops in the Field
english.objectives: Use the Command Table and complete the mission, "Troops in the Field."
english.description: It's time to send our newly summoned ghouls out into the field. Look at the Command Table and send your champions and troops on a routine scouting mission.

text.title: 更上一层楼
text.objectives: 与阿彻鲁斯的案员祖巴什谈一谈。
text.description: 档案员祖巴什对浮空城阿彻鲁斯进行了大量研究。$b$b据他所说，他已经找到一些有待改善的地方，可以使黑锋要塞的力量得到大幅增强。$b$b现在去找档案员祖巴什谈谈吧，他会告诉你能够做出哪些改善。

english.title: Tech It Up A Notch
english.objectives: Speak with Archivist Zubashi in Acherus.
english.description: Archivist Zubashi has been doing a great deal of research on the necropolis we call Acherus.$b$bThrough his studies on the necropolis, he has located a number of potential improvements that can greatly increase the power of the Ebon Hold.$b$bSpeak with Archivist Zubashi now and he will show you what improvements can be made.

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.objectives: 招募佳莉娅·米奈希尔和高阶女祭司伊莎娜。
text.description: 你是组织的领袖，其他的牧师都要依赖你的指导。许多人都愿意为你效力，为了打倒燃烧军团而付出一切努力。$B$B你在净化仪式中展现出了非凡的力量，许多人都迫不及待想为你效劳了。去找到他们，让他们为你分忧吧。

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.objectives: Recruit Calia Menethil and High Priestess Ishanah.
english.description: As leader of our order, other priests will look to you for guidance. Many will be willing to pledge themselves to you, doing whatever is necessary to bring down the Burning Legion.$B$BAfter your display of power during the cleansing ritual, there will be many who are eager to serve at your side. Seek out those priests, and let them ease the burden of leadership.

text.title: 勇士：高阶女祭司伊莎娜
text.objectives: 招募你的勇士。
text.description: 占位符

english.title: Champion: High Priestess Ishanah
english.objectives: [ph] Recruit your champions.
english.description: [PH]

text.title: 散布消息
text.objectives: 使用指挥地图，完成“散布消息”任务。
text.description:
台中间的就是破碎群岛的地图。你可以用它调遣我们的部队，完成各地的重要任务。

我们的首个任务对组织的发展至关重要——选出可靠并有能力的牧师，让他来训练我们的部队。

我们的新勇士中就有合适的人选。

english.title: Spread the Word
english.objectives: Use the Command Map and complete the mission, "Spread the Word".
english.description:
In the center of the dais is a map of the Broken Isles. From it, you can direct our allies to carry out vital assignments across the world.

The first task is critical to the growth of our order - identifying skilled priests whom we can trust to train our order's troops.

This is a task we can easily entrust to one of our new champions.

text.title: 壮大部队
text.objectives: 与资深学者格斯拉谈一谈，并训练一支助祭部队。
text.description: 我们的招募行动见效了。资深学者格斯拉加入了我们的组织。$B$B他的目光独到，擅于发掘有潜力的新人。他会选拔人才并把他们训练成强大的盟友。$B$B现在，去跟他谈谈并训练一支助祭部队吧。

english.title: Recruiting the Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Grand Anchorite Gesslar and train a troop of acolytes.
english.description: Our recruiting efforts have paid off. Grand Anchorite Gesslar has pledged his service to our order.$B$BHe has an eye for greatness, and can easily spot a recruit with potential. He takes those selected under his wing, and shapes them into worthy allies.$B$BSpeak to him now and train a troop of acolytes.

text.title: 部队出勤
text.objectives: 使用指挥地图，完成“训练中的部队”任务。
text.description: 是时候派出我们新训练的助祭上战场了。使用指挥地图，派出你的勇士和部队执行日常侦察任务。

english.title: Troops in the Field
english.objectives: Use the Command Map and complete the mission, "Troops in Training".
english.description: It's time to send our newly trained acolytes out into the field. Look at the Command Map and send your champions and troops on a routine scouting mission.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“训练中的部队”任务

text.title: 更上一层楼
text.objectives: 在虚空之光神殿与执政官泰里斯谈一谈。
text.description:
我们非常幸运能够遇到执政官泰里斯。

他的宝贵知识可以帮助我们强化守卫者，并巩固虚空之光神殿的防御。

english.title: Tech It Up A Notch
english.objectives: Speak to Archon Torias in Netherlight Temple.
english.description:
We are very fortunate to have come across Archon Torias.

His knowledge will be invaluable as we improve our defenders and fortify Netherlight Temple.

text.title: 入侵：希尔斯布莱德丘陵
该大乱斗了！
text.objectives: 与大卫·环球交谈，了解如何加入黑鸦大乱斗。
text.description: 欢迎来到黑鸦大乱斗！无数的勇士前赴后继，来到黑鸦竞技场，想要证明他们的强大。现在该轮到你来一展身手了。

english.title: Time to Rumble!
english.objectives: Speak with David Globerunner and find out how to participate in the Black Rook Rumble.
english.description: Welcome to the Black Rook Rumble!  Many combatants have entered to prove their might in the Black Rook Arena, and now it is your time.

text.title: 完美机会
text.objectives: 在残月酒馆与莉莉丝·月郡会面。
text.description:
我已经听到了来自苏拉玛的传言。

最近城里的动荡促使贵族们开始为艾利桑德的议会物色新的顾问了。这样的空缺很少出现，一定会引发激烈的竞争。

这是一个千载难逢的机会，莉莉丝正是最合适的人选。我们的计划必将成功！

我知道她讨厌耍手腕，很久以前就有意避开政事，但是我们现在必须请求她加入这场斗争。

到残月酒馆找她，并确保她能在竞选中获胜。

english.title: The Perfect Opportunity
english.objectives: Meet Ly'leth Lunastre at the Waning Crescent.
english.description:
I have heard whispers from Suramar City.

Recent unrest in the city has prompted the nobles to seek another advisor to fill Elisande's council. Such positions are rarely offered and hotly contested.

This is the perfect opportunity and Ly'leth is the perfect candidate. Fate smiles upon our cause!

I know she has historically chosen to avoid such politics and maneuvering, but we must now ask her to join the fray.

Seek her out at the Waning Crescent and ensure her victory.

objectiveDetails.description: 在残月酒馆与莉莉丝见面

text.title: 要么加入我们
text.objectives: 与阿洛拉夫人交谈。
text.description:
塔莉萨对我的要求太高了，不过我们的事业值得冒这些风险。

有了顾问的头衔之后，我们的势力可就举足轻重了。不管是情报还是权限都很容易获得。

我可以改变这场叛乱。我可以拯救许多人的生命。

但我需要强大力量的支持才能上台。由于我的家族名声显赫，很多家族愿意支持我。但有些人却踌躇不定。

阿斯塔瓦家族的阿洛拉夫人尤为迟疑不决。找到她。替我帮助她。

赢得她的信任，其他自会水到渠成。

english.title: Either With Us
english.objectives: Speak to Lady Aurore.
english.description:
Thalyssra asks much of me, but our cause is worth the risks.

The title of advisor would grant us enormous influence. Information. Access.

I could change this rebellion. I could save so many lives.

I will need strong endorsement to ascend, though. There are many houses who stand with me by virtue of my family's name. Some are more hesitant.

Lady Aurore of House Astravar is the most prominent of these. Seek her out. Offer your aid in my stead. 

Earn her trust and the rest will follow.

text.title: 要么反抗我们
text.objectives: 与阿鲁因交谈。
text.description:
如果要让莉莉丝坐上大魔导师顾问的位子，我们必须为她开路。

的确会有一些人支持她，但仅靠他们无法确保那个位子。

莉莉丝还必须对付其他家族。恐惧和胁迫是他们的工具。没人敢公开反抗他们，我们也无法依靠恩惠和誓言拉他们入伙。

找到阿鲁因。关于接下来该怎么做，我相信他肯定有不少点子。

english.title: Or Against Us
english.objectives: Speak to Arluin.
english.description:
If Ly'leth is to achieve the role of advisor to the Grand Magistrix we will need to open a path for her.

It is true she will have some supporters but they alone cannot grant her the title.

There are other houses that Ly'leth must contend with. Fear and coercion are their tools. None dare stand against them openly, and we cannot win them over with favors and oaths. 

Seek out Arluin. I trust he will have some ideas of how to proceed.

text.title: 露骨的威胁
text.objectives: 拯救艾伦·阿斯塔瓦。
text.description:
我怎么能让这样的事情发生呢？

<阿洛拉绞着双手。>

昨天，科恩·斯特拉瑞斯过来和我谈了任命的事情。他想要我支持他，但我没答应。

他说，我儿子可以继续过着正常的生活……只要我投票给他。

今天早上，我的儿子失踪了。

我满脑子里想的都是我的儿子会遭到怎样的折磨。你知道这个家族的人什么事都干得出来！

你想获得我的支持，但我的儿子身处险境，我根本帮不了你。我帮不了你。

求求你……救救他！

english.title: Thinly Veiled Threats
english.objectives: Rescue Ailen Astravar.
english.description:
How could I let this happen?

<Aurore wrings her hands.>

Yesterday Coryn Stelleris approached me about the appointment. He sought my support, but I did not offer it. 

He said my son's life would continue as normal... if I gave him my vote.

This morning my son was gone.

I can only think of the terrible things he may be suffering. You know what this family is capable of!

You want my support, but I can do nothing while my son is in danger. Nothing.

Please... save him!

text.title: 小道消息
text.objectives: 在暮湾家族的成员中间散播流言。
text.description:
科恩·斯特拉瑞斯和鲁文·暮湾是挚友，但其中一人的风头总是大大地盖过了另一个人。如今，鲁文领主的死令斯特拉瑞斯家族大为受益。

暮湾家族很快就会意识到自己的损失了。我要你去引导他们的愤怒和悲痛。

你只要在合适的场合散布一些谣言就可以了。

我很快就要离开这里，但莉莉丝希望知道你的进展。

你办好事情以后就回去找她。
text.completed: 返回残月酒馆，找到莉莉丝。

english.title: Rumor Has It
english.objectives: Plant rumors among members of House Duskmere.
english.description:
Coryn Stelleris and Ruven Duskmere were close friends, but one always overshadowed the other. Now the Stelleris family stands to gain from lord Ruven's death. Handsomely.

House Duskmere will soon learn of their loss. I want you to be the one to redirect their anger and grief.

A handful of well placed rumors should do the trick.

I won't be lingering in this part of the city for long, and Ly'leth will want to know of your efforts.

Return to her when you are finished.
english.completed: Return to Ly'leth at the Waning Crescent.

text.title: 群星庭院：君子报仇，十年不晚
text.objectives: 进入群星庭院地下城，消灭顾问麦兰杜斯。取得他的法术石并交给塔莉萨。
text.description:
机会来了，$n。

莉莉丝已经安排好让你混入群星庭院的舞会。我不知道这次行动会有什么收获，不过我必须交给你一个任务。

顾问麦兰杜斯以前自称是我的盟友。他跟我一起计划扳倒艾利桑德，可是最后却背叛了我。

他对我造成的伤害让我一直痛到现在。虽然我不能到苏拉玛去报仇，不过你可以。

让他付出背叛的代价，并把他的法术石带来给我。

english.title: Court of Stars: Beware the Fury of a Patient Elf
english.objectives: Enter the Court of Stars dungeon and slay Advisor Melandrus. Collect his Spellstone and return it to Thalyssra.
english.description:
An opportunity presents itself, $n.

Ly'leth has arranged to grant you entry into a ball at the Court of Stars. I do not know what we may gain from this venture, but there is one task I must set for you.

Advisor Melandrus once called himself my ally. He and I planned Elisande's downfall, but when the moment came I found myself betrayed.

The wound his dagger inflicted still aches. I cannot enter Suramar to take my revenge, but you can.

Give him a traitor's death, and bring me his spellstone.

text.title: 死亡化身
text.objectives: 消灭鲁文·暮湾。
text.description:
有两个家族对莉莉丝的晋升构成威胁，但我们现在还是先把注意力集中在一个家族上。

暮湾家族通过散播恐惧获得尊重，而这种恐惧并非空穴来风。很少有人能够吹嘘自己的魔法天赋与鲁文·暮湾不相上下。

然而，除了他这个迷人的典范之外，他们家族一无是处。

我知道你可能认为我的方案令人反感。要知道，苏拉玛城中的恶魔，早在燃烧军团出现之前便已存在。

而这个恶魔也已经活得够久了。

english.title: Death Becomes Him
english.objectives: Slay Ruven Duskmere.
english.description:
There are two houses that pose a threat to Ly'leth's rise, but we concern ourselves with only one of them now.

House Duskmere commands respect through fear and that fear is not unfounded. Few can boast of magical talent equal to that of Ruven Duskmere. 

Without this charming specimen, however, their house is nothing.

I know you may find my methods distasteful. Know that there were demons in Suramar long before the Legion.

This one has lived long enough.

text.title: 囊中之物
text.objectives: 见证莉莉丝·月郡升迁顾问。
text.description:
整座城市都已因愤怒而议论纷纷。

我不骗你——科恩这样的人被愚弄，让我非常开心。

其他家族都已立场鲜明地支持我。一切都搞定了，现在只缺一个授予我顾问职衔的正式仪式了。

到那里和我碰头。你有权分享胜利的荣光。

english.title: In the Bag
english.objectives: Witness Ly'leth Lunastre's ascension to advisor.
english.description:
Already the city is abuzz with outrage.

I will not lie to you- it pleases me greatly that one such as Coryn is made a fool.

The other houses have sent their endorsements. It is done, and nothing remains but a formal ceremony to grant me the title of advisor.

Meet me there. You deserve to share in this success.

objectiveDetails.description: 见证莉莉丝·月郡的升迁

text.title: 莉莉丝的勇士
text.objectives: 与莉莉丝谈话来开始战斗。
text.description:
塔尔艾什是一种荣誉决斗。

如果我输了，就必须将我的头衔让给科恩·斯特拉瑞斯。

<莉莉丝微微一笑。>

所以你要为我而战。

为了这项任务，我会赋予你更为强大的伪装，让我们携手将科恩送回老家吧。

你做好为我而战的准备后，就告诉我一声吧。

english.title: Ly'leth's Champion
english.objectives: Speak with Ly'leth to begin the encounter.
english.description:
Tal'ashar is an honor duel.

If I lose, then I must forfeit my title to Coryn Stelleris.

<Ly'leth smiles gently.>

That is why you are going to fight for me. 

I will grant you a more powerful disguise for this task, and together we will put Coryn in his place.

Speak to me when you are ready to battle on my behalf.

text.title: 白虎之道
text.objectives: 和征募官金莱对话。
text.description: 金莱是在天禅院加入我们的盟友中的一员，这位武僧因为对白虎之道的精通而闻名。$B$B在他的帮助下，我们就可以出训练白虎弟子，他们能在战场上快速精准地发动攻击。$B$B前去和他对话请求他为你服务。

english.title: The Way of the Tiger
english.objectives: Speak to Recruiter Gin Lai.
english.description: Among the allies who joined us from Tian Monastery is Gin Lai, a monk famed for his experience in the ways of the tiger.$B$BWith his help, we will be able to train Tiger Initiates, who strike swiftly and precisely on the field of battle.$B$BGo speak with him now and request his services.

text.title: 回顾过去
text.objectives: 正确回答一个由勒洛尔提出的有关艾泽拉斯历史的问题。
text.description: 此时此刻，我们要回顾至今走过的路，庆祝我们伟大的历史，和塑造历史的重大事件。

english.title: A Time to Reflect
english.objectives: Correctly answer one of Llore's questions about the history of Azeroth.
english.description: It is time to reflect on the events that have brought us to this moment. A celebration of our great history and the events that shape it.

text.title: 收获时间到
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾从拉克斯·六触身上收集六触的钥匙。
text.description:
你好，伙计。这一带的线人告诉我，你遇到了六触兄弟。我猜他们大概没给你好脸色看吧？

我跟他们也没什么好交情。

这样吧。我把他们目前所在的位置告诉你，你意下如何？说不定他们就会很不幸地发生意外，你懂的吧？

哦，还有，带几个朋友一起去。他们不怎么好对付。

english.title: Time to Collect
english.objectives: Collect Sixtrigger's Key from Rax Sixtrigger in Stormheim.
english.description:
Hey there, pal. My sources around here say you had a run-in with the Sixtrigger brothers. I'd imagine you're not very happy with them?

Let's just say we're not exactly friends either.

So I'll tell you what. How about I let you in on some intel about their current location? Maybe they might have an unfortunate accident, you follow?

Oh, and bring some friends. They're not exactly the easiest of targets.

text.title: 风雨欲来
text.objectives: 前往潘达利亚，在白虎的寺庙与他谈一谈。
text.description: 你拯救了我们所有人，我的朋友！你完美地践行了元素之道。$b$b如果大地之环想要取得最终的胜利，就需要威力强大的武器。我知道该去哪里寻找。潘达利亚之战后，我们在雷电王座下面发现了风暴之神莱登的武器。它们的力量太过强大，以至于无人可以驾驭。$b$b守护这副武器的白虎只会将其托付给配得上它们的人。走吧，$n！和我一起前往潘达利亚，证明你的能力！

english.title: The Coming Storm
english.objectives: Travel to Pandaria and speak to the White Tiger at his temple.
english.description: You saved us all, my friend! Truly you embody all the elements stand for.$b$bIf the Earthen Ring is to prevail, we will need weapons of great power. I know where to find some. After the Pandaren Campaign, the weapons of the storm god Ra-den were discovered beneath the Throne of Thunder. None have been able to wield them, so great is their power.$b$bThey were placed in the care of the White Tiger, who will give them only to one who is worthy. Come $n! Travel with me to Pandaria and we will prove your worth!

text.title: 求生技能
text.objectives: 用劈好的木头生火，并用营火炙烤肉排以展示你的求生能力。
text.description: 猎人的生活绝对不会无聊。在野外生活的时候，你永远不知道接下来会发生什么，但是你可以靠着自己的技能和直觉活下来。$B$B让我看看你有没有在野外求生的基本能力吧。

english.title: Survival Skills
english.objectives: Show your survival skill by building a campfire from chopped wood, and cooking a steak over an open flame.
english.description: The life of a hunter should never be dull. Living in the wild you never know what will happen next, but you survive on skill and instinct.$B$BShow me you have the basic survival skills to live off the land.

text.title: 莱登秘典
text.objectives: 前往锦绣谷的郭莱古厅取得磐石之诏、烈焰之诏以及风暴之诏。消灭魔古幽灵，以净化该地区。
text.description: 雷电之王窃取泰坦守护者莱——魔古发音为“莱登”——的力量，征服了潘达利亚。如果你真的想要至高守护者的圣物，就到魔古帝国中心的废墟去找到他的古老诏书：磐石之诏、烈焰之诏以及风暴之诏。$b$b这些诏书都是秘典的一部分，它们散落在锦绣谷郭莱古厅的各个区域里。

english.title: The Codex of Ra
english.objectives: Enter the Guo Lai Halls in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms and collect the Edict of Stone, the Edict of Fire, and the Edict of the Storm. Cleanse the area by slaying mogu spirits.
english.description: The Thunder King conquered Pandaria using power stolen from the Titan Keeper Ra, known as "Ra-den" in the mogu tongue. If you truly seek to wield the relics of the Highkeeper, seek out his ancient edicts among the ruins in the heart of the mogu empire: The Edict of Stone, The Edict of Fire, and the Edict of the Storm.$b$bThese pieces of the codex are scattered amongst the Guo-Lai Halls in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, one in each wing.

text.title: 联合势力
text.objectives: 在破碎群岛的各个阵营中达到至少友善声望。
text.description: 破碎群岛上遍布着各种各样的势力。如果我们想要有机会战胜燃烧军团，就必须将他们联合起来。向他们证明你的价值，然后向我汇报。

english.title: Uniting the Isles
english.objectives: Earn at least Friendly reputation with the factions of the Broken Isles.
english.description: There are a great number of factions here on the Broken Isles. We must unite them if we want to stand a chance against the Legion. Prove your worth to them and report back to me.

objectiveDetails.description: 在风暴峡湾的瓦拉加尔阵营中达到友善声望
在瓦尔莎拉的织梦者阵营中达到友善声望
在高岭部族阵营中达到友善声望
在阿苏纳的法罗迪斯宫廷阵营中达到友善声望
在苏拉玛的堕夜精灵阵营中达到友善声望

text.title: 阿格拉玛之盾
text.objectives: 将阿格拉玛之盾放在达拉然的守护者大厅中保管。
text.description:
既然神盾已经脱离军团的魔爪，那么最好将它带回达拉然妥善保存，并继续寻找剩余的创世之柱。

中央传送大厅应该能够保护神盾的安全，直到我们需要它为止。

english.title: The Aegis of Aggramar
english.objectives: Secure the Aegis of Aggramar in the Chamber of the Guardian in Dalaran.
english.description:
Now that it's out of the hands of the Legion, the Aegis should be brought back to Dalaran for safekeeping while the hunt continues for the rest of the Pillars of Creation.

It should be safe in the central portal chamber until the time comes when it is needed.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用达拉然的中央传送器

text.title: 财产安全
text.objectives: 从城市守卫手中保护阿鲁因的存货。
text.description:
恶魔和守卫们就和吃错药了一样，四下搜捕，我已经快找不到安全的地方来储存违禁品了。守卫已经盯上了我最爱用的藏匿处之一，他们随时都有可能来洗劫我的货物。

去我的货物那里，然后想办法打消一下他们的好奇心。你需要一副爪钩枪才能到达那里——你得注意，在屋檐边寻找能够抓附的地方。

等事成之后，我绝不会少了你的好处的。

english.title: Asset Security
english.objectives: Defend Arluin's stash from the city guards.
english.description:
With the demons and guards so agitated, I'm running out of safe places to store contraband. The guards have caught on to one of my favorite havens and will be making off with my goods any minute now.

Head to my stash and discourage their curiosity. You will need to use a grappling hook to access it- just look for something to latch onto along the ledge.

I will make sure there is something in it for you when you are done.

text.title: Tracking Quest: Celestine of the Harvest

english.title: Tracking Quest: Celestine of the Harvest

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 到啸山熔炉前的指定地点举起你的武器。
text.description: 大宗师，你在危急存亡之时拯救了教派。$b$b你用行动告诉了我们，只要付出坚定不移的努力，我们就能战胜任何挑战。我们以你为榜样，全力以赴。我们还研究出一种方法，能够释放这把武器所蕴含的真正潜力。$b$b请站在啸山熔炉的前面，高举你的武器。

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Forge of the Roaring Mountain and raise your weapon.
english.description: Grand Master, you have saved our order from the brink of destruction.$b$bYour deeds have shown us that with effort and determination we can overcome any challenge. In light of your example, we have doubled our efforts and developed a technique that will awaken your weapon to its true potential.$b$bPlease, stand before the Forge of the Roaring Mountain and raise your weapon high.

text.title: 碎石侍女
text.objectives: 在破碎轨迹消灭6个碎石侍女。
text.description:
很久以前，我在这片大陆上漫游的时候，见过各种各样的腐化。

这些生物在大殿里游荡，她们被阿坎多尔失败品放出的魔法能量扭曲变形。这些树妖已经迷失了方向，没人能拯救她们。

你必须消灭她们。终结她们的痛苦。

english.title: The Shardmaidens
english.objectives: Slay 6 Shardmaidens in the Shattered Locus.
english.description:
Long have I walked this land and I have seen many forms of corruption.

The creatures that wander this hall are twisted by the magics unleashed by the failed arcan'dor. These dryads have lost their way, and cannot be saved.

You must destroy them. End their suffering.

text.title: 灾难碎片
text.objectives: 采集5片晶化树皮。
text.description:
前方大厅里散落着阿坎多尔失败品的残骨。

我想采集一些晶化树皮的碎片，试试看能不能解读它们。我们必须找到这场大毁灭的原因。

只有这样，我们才能防止这样的灾难再次发生。

english.title: Fragments of Disaster
english.objectives: Collect 5 Crystallized Bark.
english.description:
In the hall beyond rests the bones of the failed arcan'dor.

I will take fragments of the crystallized tree and attempt to read them. We must discover the root cause of this destruction.

Only then do we have any hope of preventing this disaster from repeating itself.

text.title: 翡翠梦魇：梦中之物
text.objectives: 从翡翠梦境里收集净化的生命精华，它隐藏在翡翠梦魇团队副本中。
text.description:
这个阿坎多尔属于上古物种。它们不是孕育而生，而是被创造出来。在它们体内，奥术能量与德鲁伊的原始魔法融合在一起，创造出了更加强大的东西。

用不了多久，奥术能量便会将它吞噬殆尽。

我们可以让它恢复平衡，但这需要荒野魔法的力量。而荒野魔法被困在另一个位面。

你必须进入翡翠梦境——艾泽拉斯纯洁无瑕的视界——之中，带回生命精华。

这样阿坎多尔才能恢复稳定，再次蓬勃发展。

english.title: The Emerald Nightmare: The Stuff of Dreams
english.objectives: Collect Purified Life Essence from the Emerald Dream, hidden inside the Emerald Nightmare Raid.
english.description:
This arcan'dor is one of an ancient species. They were not bred, but created. In them the arcane and primitive druidic magics merged into something greater than both.

The arcane will soon devour it whole.

We can restore balance, but it will require wild magic. Magic trapped in another realm.

You must enter the Emerald Dream- the pure, unsullied vision of Azeroth - and bring back the essence of life itself.

Only then can the arcan'dor find stability and begin to thrive once more.

text.title: 轮回永续
text.objectives: 在尸体上种植100枚梦境之种。
text.description: 耶！林地的再生很成功。我们的小花朋友感谢你帮助了它们。$B$B我们成功挽救了林地的绝大部分，但很可惜，许多生物的灵魂已经消逝了。$B$B光明之翼好伤心！$B$B但你可以帮上忙！拿上装有梦境之种的包裹。把这些种在尸体上，很快新的花儿就会长出来啦！$B$B死亡是美丽的，而在死亡中我们迎来重生。这就是永不停歇的轮回！

english.title: The Cycle Continues
english.objectives: Plant 100 Dream Seeds on corpses.
english.description: Yay! The grove is regenerating nicely. Our flower friends thank you for helping them.$B$BWe were able to save most of the grove, but sadly, many living souls were lost as well.$B$BBrightwing is so sad!$B$BBut you can help! Take this bag of Dream Seeds. Plant them onto fresh corpses, and in time, new flowers will grow!$B$BDeath is beautiful, and from death comes rebirth. This is the cycle that must continue!

text.title: 全新发明
text.objectives: 我应该可以制作一种物品，让你改变哈提的外形，不过我需要一些非常罕见的材料。风暴峡湾的猎风者身上有一种风暴腺体。瓦尔莎拉的萨斯塔拉附近有石血鹰身人，她们身上有我需要的完整的鹰身人羽毛。阿苏纳的纳萨拉斯废墟附近有积怨纳迦，听说他们身上有反射之鳞。最后，我还要你前往至高岭的盲眼沼泽，从海缚秘法师身上取得纯洁精魂。
text.description: 我一直在实验一种技术，让你能够改变野兽的身体结构，尤其是它们的外形。

english.title: A New Invention
english.objectives: I should be able to create an item that allows you to change the appearance of Hati, but the components for such an item are rare. The Squallhunters from Stormheim have a Stormy Gland, and the Stoneblood Harpies near Thas'talah in Val'sharah have Pristine Harpy Feathers that I need.  The Hatecoil Naga near the Ruins of Nar'thalas in Azsuna are said to have Reflective Scales, and finally I need an Essence of Pure Spirit from the Seabound Mystics in the Blind Marshlands of Highmountain.
english.description: I have been experimenting with technology that allows you to alter the structure of beasts, specifically with how they look.

text.title: 慰劳前线
text.objectives: 点击指挥地图，完成“慰劳前线”任务。
text.description: 我们组织中的很多人都长期在前线坚持战斗，为那些挺身抵抗燃烧军团的战士们提供援助。$B$B是时候慰劳他们一下了，我们的盟友十分需要休息。

english.title: Relieving the Front Lines
english.objectives: Interact with the Command Map and complete the mission, "Relieving the Front Lines".
english.description: Many within our order have been on the front lines of battle for too long, aiding those who are attempting to thwart the Legion's invasion.$B$BIt is time we send in some relief, allowing our allies some much needed rest.

text.title: 虚空低语
text.objectives: 与虚空圣殿的吉尔纳·灰苔谈一谈。
text.description: 我们的牧师正在休养生息，但有一个人的情况不太顺利。吉尔纳·灰苔一直在虚空圣殿徘徊，还自己笑个不停。$B$B他不肯离开，但他的行为让其他的牧师感到不安。$B$B或许你可以和他谈谈，看看是哪里出了问题？

english.title: Whispers in the Void
english.objectives: Speak to Gilner Greymoss in the Sanctuary of the Void.
english.description: Our priests are resting and recuperating, but one not as well as the others. Gilner Greymoss lingers within the Sanctuary of the Void, laughing to himself.$B$BHe refuses to leave, but his presence is making the other priests uneasy.$B$BPerhaps you should speak to him and see what is wrong?

text.title: 聪明加能干
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳找到扎布拉·海克斯。
text.description: 如果我们想要弄清隐藏在吉尔纳疯言疯语中的真相，我们就得引发一个幻象。$B$B这和通常的那种被迫看到的幻象有所不同，但我们拥有最为优秀的炼金师，他们完全可以炼制出我所需要的药剂，让我看到我想看到的事物。$B$B去阿苏纳找到他们，他们目前正在那里支援前线的部队。

english.title: The Best and Brightest
english.objectives: Find Zabra Hexx in Azsuna.
english.description: If we wish to see the truth in Gilner's ramblings, I will need to induce a vision.$B$BIt is not the sort of thing that is typically forced, but we have within our ranks the best and brightest alchemists who can craft an extract that will grant me the sight I need.$B$BSeek them out in Azsuna where they are currently aiding those on the front lines.

objectiveDetails.description: 在阿苏纳找到扎布拉·海克斯

text.title: 鱼人心灵控制
text.objectives: 在艾达尼尔浅滩从鱼人手里救出雅丽亚·圣言者。
text.description: 我和雅丽亚当时正要把解药送到法罗纳尔的前线那里去，但我们中途遭到了一群鱼人的袭击。我们丢下了所有的补给并试图逃离那里，但雅丽亚却没能成功地逃出营地。显然，我自己的情况也好不到那里去。我的骨头到现在还在隐隐作痛，因为中了石化魔法。$B$B雅丽亚有可能还活着，而且被抓了起来。求求你，你一定要找到她！

english.title: Murloc Mind Control
english.objectives: Rescue Yalia Sagewhisper from the murlocs within El'dranil Shallows.
english.description: Yalia and I were deliverin' antidotes to da front lines a Faronaar when we were attacked by a herd a murlocs. We dropped our supplies and made a run for it, but Yalia never made it out a da camp. Obviously I didn't fair much better, ma bones still ache from bein' turned to stone.$B$BIt's possible Yalia's still alive and bein' held captive. Please, ya have to find her!

text.title: 充足补给
text.objectives: 从散落在艾达尼尔浅滩的箱子里找回魔蝠毒膏。
text.description: 我们本来打算把补给品带到法罗纳尔的恶魔猎手那里，但当我和雅丽亚想从鱼人手中逃脱的时候，我们把它弄丢了。$B$B这些箱子里都装着药膏瓶，是我们花了无数时间和资源才提炼出来的。如果我们没法夺回那些补给，我们的盟友恐怕就要受苦了。

english.title: An Ample Supply
english.objectives: Recover Felbat Toxin Salve from supply crates scattered around El'dranil Shallows.
english.description: Durin' our attempt to flee da murlocs, Yalia and I dropped da supplies we planned to deliver to da demon hunters in Faronaar.$B$BInside each a those crates were vials a salve dat took us countless days and resources to craft. If we don' get those supplies back, I fear our allies on da front lines will suffer.

text.title: 药到病除
text.objectives: 使用药膏治疗阿苏纳法罗纳尔前线患病的恶魔猎手们。
text.description: 无论如何，引发幻象都不是件容易的事情。光是找齐药剂的原料就要花上大把的时间，而我们最缺少的就是时间。就在我们谈话的这段时间里，前线的战士们正在遭受折磨。他们需要药膏，我们必须把之前就该带过去的药膏送到他们手上。$B$B如果你能带着药膏去法罗纳尔，治好那些恶魔猎手，我和扎布拉就去会找维伦的药剂所需的原料。这还算公平吧？

english.title: Problem Salver
english.objectives: Use the salve on diseased demon hunters at Faronaar Front in Azsuna.
english.description: Forcing a vision isn't easy by any means. Finding the ingredients for the elixir alone will take a considerable amount of time, time we don't have. Too many are suffering on the front lines as we speak, in need of the salve we were meant to deliver.$B$BI suppose if we all work together, we can make this work.$B$BZabra and I will find the items needed for Velen's elixir, if you take the salve to Faronaar and cure the demon hunters. Does that sound fair?

text.title: 英灵殿：圣光之心
text.objectives: 从英灵殿地下城的赫娅身上取得圣光之火。
text.description: 我们不能忽视先知的预言，$n。假如我们真这么做，我们所熟知、所珍视的一切都将被燃烧军团毁灭。$B$B我们必须重视我们所知的一切，牢记圣光永远与我们同在。$B$B你可以在英灵殿中找到一名叫做赫娅的瓦格里英灵。从她那里取得圣光之火，然后在我们的神殿中释放。

english.title: Halls of Valor: The Light Within
english.objectives: Recover a Spark of Light from Hyrja within the Halls of Valor dungeon.
english.description: We cannot ignore the Prophet's vision, $n. To do so would mean that everything we know and hold dear will be lost to the Legion.$B$BWe must focus on what we know, and that is that the Light must walk among us.$B$BWithin the Halls of Valor you will find an ascending val'kyr by the name of Hyrja. Recover a spark of her Light and release it within our temple.

objectiveDetails.description: 在圣光圣殿释放圣光之火

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：积怨透镜
text.objectives: 进入艾萨拉之眼地下城，从积怨夫人手里取得潮汐透镜。
text.description: 我们已经有了维伦药剂的材料，但要让别人也能看见维伦看到的幻象，我们就必须找东西把他脑海中的景象投影出来。$B$B附近的纳迦拥有一种透镜，那东西应该可以派上用场，但我认为他们并不会心甘情愿地把它交出来。

english.title: Eye of Azshara: Looking Through the Lens
english.objectives: Recover the Lens of the Tide from Lady Hatecoil within the Eye of Azshara dungeon.
english.description: We have what we need to create Velen's elixir, but in order for others to be able to witness his vision, we'll need to find something that can be used to project images from the mind.$B$BA lens from the nearby naga should work well, but I don't think they're going to be too eager to give it up.

text.title: 维伦的预见
text.objectives: 使用潮汐透镜见证先知维伦预见到的景象。
text.description: 我终于获得了召唤幻象的所有材料，但还有一个问题：你准备好观看幻象了吗？即使是对未来景象的惊鸿一瞥，也会让你的灵魂承受重担。$B$B一旦我服下药剂，幻象就会随之而来。凝视潮汐透镜，你就会看到我看到的一切。$B$B如果你准备好了，就和我说一声吧。

english.title: Velen's Vision
english.objectives: Use the Lens of the Tides to witness Prophet Velen's vision.
english.description: I have everything I need to bring forth a vision, but the question remains: are you ready to witness it? Even the smallest glimpse into the future can weigh heavy on your soul.$B$BOnce I ingest the elixir, the vision will come quickly. Gazing into the Lens of the Tides will allow you to see what I see.$B$BLet me know when you are ready to begin.

objectiveDetails.description: 见证先知维伦预见到的景象

text.title: 圣光觉醒
text.objectives: 完成职业大厅系列任务来收集纯净圣光。
text.description: 只有放置在这个世界最神圣之所，在圣光的笼罩下，火花才会迸发出它真正的力量。$B$B给予它滋养，它便会茁壮成长，与你同行。

english.title: Awakening the Light
english.objectives: Collect Pure Holy Light by completing Class Hall missions.
english.description: This spark will only know its full potential once it's been filled with pure Light, gleaned from the holiest places in our world.$B$BNurture this spark, and it may grow to walk among you.

text.title: 恶魔符文
text.objectives: 从破碎群岛的恶魔身上收集恶魔符文石。
text.description:
我不能眼睁睁地看着燃烧军团摧毁我的家园。

我研究他们的语言已经有些时日了，也尝试过破译拿得到的所有符文，但我的资源真的是太有限了。

如果有更多的符文供我研究，或许我就能发现更多的东西，帮助我们找到巴纳扎尔的位置。

english.title: Demonic Runes
english.objectives: Collect Demonic Runestones from demons throughout the Broken Isles.
english.description:
I cannot stand by idly and allow the Legion to destroy our home. 

I've been studying their language for some time, deciphering any runes I can get my hands on, but my supply is severely limited. 

If I had more runes to study, it's possible that I may discover something that will help us in locating Balnazzar.

text.title: 渗透敌军
text.objectives: 使用指挥地图，完成“渗透敌军”任务。
text.description:
既然我们有圣光的帮助，就应该集中精力，弄清哪些敌人可以作为我们的潜在盟友。

你的勇士们都有能力渗透到敌人的阵营中，这样一来我们就可以更清楚实现这个目标需要做哪些努力。

即便这样，这仍然是一项高风险的任务。我们必须谨慎。

english.title: Infiltrating Our Enemies
english.objectives: Interact with the Command Map and complete the mission, "Infiltrating Our Enemies".
english.description:
With the Light at our side, we should focus our efforts on figuring out who among our enemies could be a potential ally.

Any of your champions should be capable of infiltrating enemy ranks, giving us a better understanding of how to approach this.

Even so, it is a delicate task. Proceed with caution.

text.title: 先锋军使者
text.objectives: 在新壁炉谷的宿敌中找到一位新的盟友。
text.description: 我们在诺森德发现了一小群血色先锋军的变节者。$B$B虽然我知道，他们很难在我们的事业中派上多大用场，但我们必须得做出尝试。$B$B预言也曾说过，一名古老的宿敌将成为我们的盟友，所以，我们应该派人调查一下，看看那些变节者们还能否回归圣光的怀抱。

english.title: Onslaught Envoy
english.objectives: Find a new ally among old enemies in New Hearthglen.
english.description: A few defectors have been discovered among the Scarlet Onslaught in Northrend.$B$BI know it's difficult to think that any within their ranks could be useful to our cause, but we must make an attempt.$B$BThe prophecy says an old enemy will become an ally, so it's worth it to investigate and see if these defectors can be brought to the Light.

text.title: 血色救赎
text.objectives: 杀死新壁炉谷的血色先锋军成员，帮助异端者马丽拉完成救赎。
text.description:
圣光正照耀着我，$n！这是我有生以来的第一次，我感受到了圣光！

我曾经以血色十字军的名义犯下了许多的罪行。我失去了希望，准备自裁以谢罪，但你出现在了我的面前！你给了我赎罪的机会。

求求你，让我证明自己，给我一个洗心革面的机会吧。我要消灭那些我曾经效忠过的人！

english.title: Scarlet Redemption
english.objectives: Help Mariella the Heretic redeem herself by killing members of the Scarlet Onslaught in New Hearthglen.
english.description:
The Light shines upon me, $n! For the first time in my life, I feel it!

I was without hope, ready to die for the things I had done in the name of the Scarlet Crusade, but then you appeared! You are my chance at redemption. 

Please, let me prove to you that I am worthy of a second chance. Let me slay those I used to be loyal to!

text.title: 解救变节者
text.objectives: 解救新壁炉谷的先锋军变节者。
text.description:
有很多人都和我一样，你也知道的。他们揭露了血色十字军长期以来蒙蔽我们的谎言。

他们被关在笼子里，就像牲畜一样，就因为他们的信念与血色先锋军所谓的正义而神圣的事业出现了分歧。

他们希望获得救赎。我们应该尝试解救他们，如果你认为他们还值得拯救的话。

english.title: Apostate Liberation
english.objectives: Rescue Onslaught Apostates within New Hearthglen.
english.description:
There are others like me, you know. Others that have removed the veil that the Scarlet Crusade has kept over our eyes for so long. 

They've been placed in cages, treated like animals, simply because their beliefs no longer line up with what the Onslaught deems is right and holy. 

They wish to redeem themselves. We should try to free them, if you think their lives are worth saving.

text.title: 不速之客
text.objectives: 返回虚空之光神殿找阿隆索斯·法奥。
text.description:
你将我从绞刑架上救了下来，让我摆脱了死亡的命运。但真正拯救我的心灵、将我从无尽罪孽中解放出来的，正是你允许我并肩对抗血色先锋军的慷慨与仁慈。

我想为更加崇高、而且不会扭曲圣光本意的事业做出一份贡献。

请允许我与你一同前往神殿，并向先知乞求宽恕。虽然我并不受欢迎，但为了赎罪，我必须踏上这一旅程。

english.title: Unexpected Guests
english.objectives: Return to Alonsus Faol in Netherlight Temple.
english.description:
You helped me escape my fate by freeing me from the gallows, but allowing me to fight the Scarlet Onslaught by your side has truly freed my heart and mind from the guilt I have felt for so long.

I want to be a part of something greater than myself, a noble cause that won't distort the meaning of the Light. 

Let me travel to your temple and beg forgiveness of the Prophet. I may not be a welcome guest, but it's a journey I must make to complete my redemption.

text.title: 遗忘之影
text.objectives: 前往暮色森林与遗忘之影教派的教徒见面。
text.description:
圣光与我们同行，即便是敌人也是如此。你成功地让预言得以应验，但一切远没有结束。

暗影必将崛起，因此，我们必须重建遗忘之影教派。

在暮色森林的墓地中，你将会找到仅存的几朵鲜花。它们就生长在逝去领袖之墓旁边。

english.title: Forgotten Shadows
english.objectives: Head to Duskwood and meet with a member of the Cult of Forgotten Shadows.
english.description:
The Light walks among us, as does one of our enemies. You have done well to bring the prophecy to life, but it is not yet complete.

The shadows must rise, and to do so, the Cult of Forgotten Shadows must be restored. 

You will find the few remaining followers at the cemetery in Duskwood. They linger there near the grave of their fallen leader.

text.title: 虚空之谜
text.objectives: 从暮光领主乌戈洛克那里取回娜塔莉的日记。
text.description:
我们的领袖因其信仰而遭到杀害，或者说大部分人都是这么认为的。

娜塔莉·塞林清楚自己的命运，既然死亡不可避免，她就采取了措施保护自己。

在袭击者来临的那天晚上，娜塔莉将她自己的灵魂送入了虚空之中，只有她自己才知道灵魂的位置。

她把取回灵魂的咒语写了下来，并藏在了她为数众多的日记中。不幸的是，这些日记随后就落入了谋杀者的手中。

如果没有她的日记，我们就无法取回她的灵魂。

english.title: Secrets of the Void
english.objectives: Recover Natalie's Journal from Twilight Lord Urgrok.
english.description:
Our leader was murdered for her beliefs, or so most would believe.

Natalie Seline knew her fate, and took steps to protect herself from an inevitable death. 

The night her attackers came, Natalie sent her spirit to the Void, its location known only to Natalie herself.

She penned a spell to retrieve it in one of her many journals, but the tome has since fallen into the hands of those who wished her dead in the first place.

Without her journal, we will never be able to recover her spirit.

text.title: 踏入虚空
text.objectives: 在墓穴中的暗影祭坛阅读娜塔莉的日记，进入虚空，并取回她的灵魂。
text.description: 毫无疑问，这就是娜塔莉的字迹。虽然字迹非常匆忙潦草，但传达的信息却十分清楚：日记中的这道咒语将帮助我们找到娜塔莉的灵魂，但我们必须在墓穴的暗影祭坛中念出咒语，它才会生效。$B$B奥德莎和我必须看管娜塔莉的尸体，但既然你有如此强大的力量，你应该能轻而易举地施放这道咒语。

english.title: Into the Void
english.objectives: Read Natalie's Journal at the catacomb's shadow altar to enter the void and recover her spirit.
english.description: This is without a doubt Natalie's writing. The entry was scrawled in haste, but the message is clear: The spell within this journal will lead us to Natalie's spirit, but it needs to be incanted at a shadow altar within the catacombs.$B$BOdessa and I have a duty to watch over Natalie's body, but with your considerable power, you should be able to perform the spell with ease.

objectiveDetails.description: 解救娜塔莉·塞林的灵魂
在暗影祭坛查看娜塔莉的日记

text.title: 暗影崛起
text.objectives: 返回虚空之光神殿找阿隆索斯·法奥。
text.description:
我回归的消息很快就会在我的信徒之间传播开来。用不了多久，艾泽拉斯便会见证暗影的崛起，但你大概早就预见到了。

不管你有什么计划，我都希望遗忘之影教派能继续充当你的盟友。

english.title: Rising Shadows
english.objectives: Return to Alonsus Faol at Netherlight Temple.
english.description:
News of my return will spread fast among those who share my beliefs. Soon Azeroth will see the rise of Shadows, but I imagine this is not news to you.

Whatever your plan may be, I hope it continues to see the Cult of Forgotten Shadows as allies.

text.title: 穿越燃烧军团战线
text.objectives: 利用邪焰隘口的恶魔传送门进入尼斯卡拉，找到奥伯妮·亮鬃。
text.description: 我收到了大领主的消息，一群圣骑士和祭司在邪焰隘口的战斗爆发以后被抓了起来。你的女祭司，德拉丝·月牙也成了俘虏。$B$B恶魔通过传送门把他们押到了尼斯卡拉的军团要塞里。$B$B如果要救出他们，我们就需要教团的帮助。

english.title: Crossing Legion Lines
english.objectives: Use the demon portal at Felblaze Ingress to enter Niskara and find Aponi Brightmane.
english.description: I've received word from the Highlord that a group of paladins and priests were captured after a battle broke out at Felblaze Ingress. Your priestess, Delas Moonfang, was among those captured.$B$BThey've been taken through the demon portal and into the Legion stronghold of Niskara.$B$BWe will need the assistance of the Conclave if we have any hope of recovering them.

text.title: 圣光同盟
text.objectives: 拯救白银之手骑士或教团牧师，并救出救赎者阿拉托尔和德拉丝·月牙。
text.description: 阿拉托尔和德拉丝两个人都还在这片荒凉之地，而我们的许多盟友也下落不明。$B$B我们不能抛下他们，$n。

english.title: Allies of the Light
english.objectives: Save Silver Hand Knights or Conclave Priests, and rescue Arator the Redeemer and Delas Moonfang.
english.description: Both Arator and Delas are still somewhere on this forsaken rock, as well as many of our other allies.$B$BWe cannot leave them, $n.

text.title: 敌人的意图
text.objectives: 找出军团情报、星图，以及维伦的影像，然后消灭蛛后艾拉米丝。
text.description: 恶魔狱卒提到即将发起一次入侵。他们正在集结大军，准备大干一场。这让我非常担心。$B$B我们得去找一找有关他们计划的线索。

english.title: The Mind of the Enemy
english.objectives: Find the Legion Intelligence, Star Map, and Image of Velen, then slay Brood Queen Aramis.
english.description: The demon jailors spoke of an upcoming invasion. Their army is gathering for something big, and it worries me greatly.$B$BLet us find whatever information we can about their plans.

text.title: 万众一心
text.objectives: 前往圣光秘殿，与女伯爵莉亚德琳对话，并旁听作战会议。
text.description:
你和德拉丝曾经与圣骑士有过合作，也许他们会允许你们旁听他们的作战会议。

前往圣光秘殿，并请求圣骑士帮助我们防守虚空之光神殿，抵御巴纳扎尔的袭击。

english.title: United As One
english.objectives: Make your way to the Sanctum of Light to speak with Lady Liadrin, and hear the council of war.
english.description:
You and Delas have had dealings with the paladins before, maybe it's possible they will grant you an audience with their war council. 

Head to the Sanctum of Light and ask the paladins to help us defend Netherlight Temple from Balnazzar's attack.

objectiveDetails.description: 与女伯爵莉亚德琳交谈

text.title: 驻防神殿
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description: 我们齐心协力，将这座神殿改造成了所有牧师的自豪之地。如果这里被燃烧军团摧毁，那就真是奇耻大辱。$B$B我们必须加强防御，准备抵抗接下来的进攻。有了充足的资源，我们就能将这座神殿打造成一座难攻不落的要塞。

english.title: Fortifying the Temple
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description: We've all worked so hard turning this temple into something all priests can be proud of, it would be a shame to see it fall to the Burning Legion.$B$BWe must strengthen our defenses in preparation for the attack. With the right resources, we can make the temple a nearly impenetrable fortress.

text.title: 流明石
text.objectives: 派遣勇士在“流明石”系列任务中收集50个流明石。
text.description: 我们需要拿到最顶级的护甲和武器，为这场战斗做好准备。$B$B流明石是一种魔法材料，可以抵抗大量邪能魔法。$B$B破碎群岛各地都有少量发现，并且当地很多种族会在自己的锻造物品中使用这种材料。$B$B我们最好派遣勇士去清扫破碎群岛的敌人——他们的物资中应该会藏有大量流明石。

english.title: Lumenstone
english.objectives: Collect 50 Lumenstone by sending champions on "Lumenstone" missions.
english.description: To prepare for the battle, we will need the best armor and weapons we can get.$B$BLumenstone is an enchanted material that can withstand great amounts of fel magic.$B$BIt is found in rare quantities all over the Broken Isles, and many of the native races use it in their own metalcrafting.$B$BWe should send our champions to target enemies around the Broken Isles - there should be plenty of lumenstone to be found in their stockpiles.

text.title: 黑暗中的光明
text.objectives: 联合圣骑士，防守虚空之光神殿并消灭巴纳扎尔。
text.description: 燃烧军团已经发动攻击！$B$B我会留在这里部署神殿的防御。你必须立刻前达拉然，并告诉我们的盟友，战斗已经打响！$B$B抓紧时间，$n。我不知道我们究竟能挡住巴纳扎尔多久。

english.title: A Light in the Darkness
english.objectives: United with the paladins, defend Netherlight Temple and slay Lord Balnazzar.
english.description: The Burning Legion has begun their attack!$B$BI will remain here and prepare the temple's defenses. You must meet our allies in Dalaran and let them know that the battle has begun!$B$BMake haste, $n. I do not know how long we will be able to keep Balnazzar at bay.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“保卫虚空之光神殿”场景战役
使用传送门前往虚空之光神殿
与玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵交谈

text.title: 虚空之光大祭司
text.objectives: 在你受到牧师教团嘉奖时认真聆听。
text.description:
你不光实现了预言，还将艾泽拉斯大陆上的所有牧师都团结到了一起。

我们应该抽出时间，表彰一下你的光荣成就。

english.title: High Priest of Netherlight
english.objectives: Listen as you are honored by the Conclave of priests.
english.description:
You have fulfilled the prophecy, but more than that, you have united the priests of Azeroth.

We should take a moment to recognize all that you have accomplished.

text.title: 保卫群岛
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description: 作为德鲁伊，我们的使命就是守卫自然……然后是守卫我们的家园，艾泽拉斯。$B$B现在，战火燃遍了整个破碎群岛。燃烧军团不断推进，无数盟友在呼唤我们的支援。$B$B在我们准备好对梦魇发起总攻之前，我们必须采取守势。$B$B去支援破碎群岛各处的盟友，等战局得到控制之后回来找我。

english.title: Defending the Isles
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description: As druids, our charge is to defend nature... and in turn, our home, Azeroth.$B$BConflict breaks out all across the Broken Isles. The Burning Legion pushes forward, and numerous allies call out for our aid.$B$BWe must focus our efforts on defense, before we can mount an offense against the Nightmare.$B$BHelp our allies across the Broken Isles, then return to me when the situation is under control.

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 前往灵魂熔炉前的标记位置，并举起你的武器。
text.description: 我很高兴地向您汇报，灵魂熔炉的改造已经完成了！$b$b等您准备好之后，我们就可以用它来解放这把武器的真正力量！

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Soul Forge and raise your weapon.
english.description: I'm pleased to report that the improvements to the Soul Forge are complete!$b$bWhen you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapon!

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 前往纪元之种前的标记地点，并举起你的武器。
text.description: $ct，虽然我们相处的时间尚短，但你已经为我们的议会做了太多的贡献。$b$b在你执著精神的激励下，我们找到了一种新的方法，它可以将翡翠梦境的力量赋予你的武器！$b$b一切都已就绪，只要你做好准备，我就可以开始。

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Seed of Ages and raise your weapon.
english.description: $ct, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Circle.$b$bWe are inspired by your determination and have developed a new technique that will bind the power of your weapon with the Emerald Dream itself!$b$bEverything is prepared. When you are ready we shall begin.

objectiveDetails.description: 在纪元之种与大德鲁伊巨蹄见面

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 前往纳斯雷兹姆的诅咒熔炉前的指定位置，并举起你的武器。
text.description: 我很高兴地向您汇报，熔炉的改造已经完成了！$b$b等您准备好之后，我们就可以用它来解放这把武器的真正力量！

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim and raise your weapon.
english.description: I'm pleased to report that the improvements to the Forge are complete!$b$bWhen you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapon!

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 前往魔血祭坛前的指定地点,并举起你的武器。
text.description: $ct，我们对魔血祭坛的研究果然是值得的。我们发明了一种仪式，它可以解放这把武器真正的力量！$b$b只要你下令，我们就可以立刻开始仪式！

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Felblood Altar and raise your weapon.
english.description: $ct, our research into the Felblood Altar has proven useful. We've developed a ritual that should unleash the full powers of your artifact weapon!$b$bSay the word, and we shall begin the ritual at once!

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 前往守护者熔炉前的指定地点，并举起你的武器。
text.description: $ct，虽然我们相处的时间尚短，但你已经为我们做了太多的贡献。$b$b在你的一言一行激励下，我们无不加倍努力。我很荣幸地宣布，我们找到了一种新的方法，它或许可以帮助到你。$b$b如果你有时间的话，$ct，我很乐意向你展示一下我们的研究成果。

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Forge of the Guardian and raise your weapon.
english.description: $ct, in our short time together you have done much for our order.$b$bThrough your words and deeds we've been inspired to redouble our efforts and I'm proud to report that we've discovered a new technique that may be of use to you.$b$bIf you have a moment, $ct, I would be pleased to show you the fruit of our research.

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 前往古代元素祭坛前的指定地点，并举起你的武器。
text.description: 先知，自从你加入我们之后，你已经为大地之环做出了伟大的贡献。$b$b无数双眼睛见证了你的努力。万灵注视着你的一切，并为你感到无比的欣喜。他们还向我展现了一种方法，可以解放这把武器的真正力量！$b$b仪式已经准备就绪，等你准备好我们就可以开始。

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Ancient Elemental Altar and raise your weapon.
english.description: Farseer, since you have joined us you have done much to aid the Earthen Ring.$b$bYour efforts have not gone unnoticed. The spirits have watched all that you have done and are pleased. They also have shown me a technique that will unleash the true power of your weapon!$b$bThe ritual is ready. When you are prepared we can begin.

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 前往光影祭坛前的指定位置，并举起你的武器。
text.description: $ct，虽然我们相处的时日尚短，但你已经为议会做出了伟大的贡献。现在，光影祭坛已经改造完成，该轮到我们祝你一臂之力了。我们发现了一种方法，可以唤醒武器中的沉睡力量！$b$b请走到祭坛面前，并高举你的武器。

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Altar of Light and Shadow and raise your weapon.
english.description: $ct, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Conclave. Now, with the work upon the Altar of Light and Shadow complete, it is time that we aid you. We have discovered a method to awaken the full power of your weapon!$b$bPlease, step before the altar and raise your weapon high.

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 前往无冕者锻炉前的指定地点，并举起你的武器。
text.description: 我很高兴地宣布，对坩埚的升级改造已经完成了！$b$b等你准备好之后，我们就将用它来解放这把武器的全部力量！

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Crucible of the Uncrowned and raise your weapon.
english.description: I'm pleased to say that the improvements to the crucible are complete!$b$bWhen you are prepared, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapons!

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 前往永恒猎杀祭坛前的指定位置，并举起你的武器。
text.description: 我很高兴地宣布，对永恒猎杀祭坛的升级改造已经完成了！$b$b等你准备好之后，我们就将用它来解放这把武器的全部力量！

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Altar of the Eternal Hunt and raise your weapon.
english.description: I'm pleased to say that the improvements to the Altar of the Eternal Hunt are complete!$b$bWhen you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the full potential of your weapon!

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 前往远古列王祭坛前的指定地点，并举起你的武器。
text.description: $ct，你将白银之手骑士团重新团结为一个整体，从来没有哪个$ct能做到这一点。你的行动向我们表明，在圣光的引领下，我们坚定的信仰可以战胜任何挑战。$b$b在你的激励下，我们的工匠奋发努力，力图强化远古君王祭坛。它将为你解放这把武器的真正力量。$b$b现在，他们的工作终于完成了！当你准备好之后，请走上前来，并与我们一同开始仪式。

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Approach the indicated location before the Altar of Ancient Kings and raise your weapon.
english.description: $ct, you've brought together the Silver Hand like no $ct has done before. You've shown us that with determination and faith in the holy light we can overcome any challenge.$b$bFollowing in your example our workmen have toiled hard to improve the Altar of Ancient Kings, allowing it to unlock the true potential of your weapon.$b$bTheir work is now complete! Step forward when you are ready and we shall begin.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵
玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 英雄的武器
text.objectives: 前往奥丁的熔炉与他会面，并在指定位置举起你的武器。
text.description: 我一直在关注你，$n。$b$b你挥舞着武器，带领瓦拉加尔人赢得了一场又一场战争！让一次又一次的胜利欢呼充满了英灵殿！$b$b现在，熔炉已经改造完成了，是时候解放这把武器的真正潜力了！到熔炉来找我，英雄。

english.title: A Hero's Weapon
english.objectives: Meet with Odyn at his forge and raise your weapon at the indicated location.
english.description: I've been watching you, $n.$b$bTime and again you've led the Valarjar to war with your weapon held high! Time and again the halls of Valhalas have thundered with the cheers of your victory!$b$bNow that the enhancements to the forge have been completed, it is time that your weapon's true potential be unleashed! Meet with me at the forge, hero.

objectiveDetails.description: 在奥丁的熔炉处与他见面

text.title: 通缉：被驱逐的诺曼提斯

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭被驱逐的诺曼提斯

text.title: 第二件武器
text.objectives: 选择要追求的第二件神器。
text.description:
如果你觉得拥有一把举世闻名、历史悠久的强大神器还不够，那么我们正好发现了其他适合你的上古武器的可靠线索。

我已经把选项都告诉你了，告诉我你的想法吧。

english.title: A Second Weapon
english.objectives: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
english.description:
We have strong leads on other ancient weapons that you might choose to pursue, if having one renowned, powerful piece of history in your hands is somehow insufficient.

I'll lay out the options for you. Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第二件神器

text.title: 回顾过去
text.objectives: 正确回答一个由吉帕提出的有关艾泽拉斯历史的问题。
text.description: 此时此刻，我们要回顾至今走过的路，庆祝我们伟大的历史，和塑造历史的重大事件。

english.title: A Time to Reflect
english.objectives: Correctly answer one of Ju'Pa's questions about the history of Azeroth.
english.description: It is time to reflect on the events that have brought us to this moment. A celebration of our great history and the events that shape it.

text.title: 主母奥兹拉姆
text.objectives: 消灭主母奥兹拉姆。
text.description: 这一带的邪恶小鬼一直在骚扰我们镇守下方营地的盟友。$B$B它们都是一个名叫主母奥兹拉姆的鬼母的子嗣。她就在南边的山上。$B$B只要消灭了她，我们就能彻底铲除那些小鬼。

english.title: Mother Ozram
english.objectives: Kill Mother Ozram.
english.description: The fiendish imps in this region are an incessant pain on our allies defending the camps below.$B$BThey are the spawn of a wicked imp-mother named Mother Ozram, who has been seen on a hill to the south.$B$BDestroy her, and we will end her brood as well.

enders.name: 裁决者朱莉亚·塞雷斯蒂

text.title: Ashes of a Fallen Crusader Tracking Quest

english.title: Ashes of a Fallen Crusader Tracking Quest

text.title: Ashes of a Fallen Crusader Tracking Quest 2

english.title: Ashes of a Fallen Crusader Tracking Quest 2

text.title: Ashes of a Fallen Crusader Tracking Quest

english.title: Ashes of a Fallen Crusader Tracking Quest

text.title: 沃尔菲之血
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份魔血。
text.description:
温斯顿·沃尔菲想让我们帮个忙。他说他需要大量的恶魔血液。他没有明说要拿来做什么，我也就没有多问。

我建议你顺手帮他一把。沃尔菲很少有求于人，他既然提了，我们就该答应下来。他总能保质保量地完成任务。

我们也应该让他看看我们的诚意。
text.completed: 返回暗影大厅去找瓦莉拉·萨古纳尔。

english.title: Blood for the Wolfe
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Fel Blood.
english.description:
We have a request in from Winstone Wolfe. He says that he needs a rather large amount of demon blood. He was not specific what for, and I did not ask.

I am inclined to do this for him with all expediency. The Wolf rarely asks for anything, so when he does, we jump. He gets results, one-hundred percent of the time and then some.

We should show him the same professional courtesy.
english.completed: Return to Valeera Sanguinar in the Chamber of Shadows.

text.title: 马迪亚斯究竟在哪？
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“马迪亚斯究竟在哪？”系列任务。
text.description:
马迪亚斯·肖尔大师是联盟情报机构军情七处的领袖。而他现在显然是一个恐惧魔王。

或者说，某个非常狡猾的恐惧魔王顶替了他的身份，并将他关押在了某个地方。

我们必须向暴风城的新任国王揭穿这个骗子。如果我们失败了，联盟肯定会分崩离析，燃烧军团也会赢得这场战争。

english.title: Where In the World is Mathias?
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the "Where In the World is Mathias Shaw?" missions.
english.description:
Master Mathias Shaw is the leader of the Alliance intelligence organization known as SI:7. And apparently, he is now a dreadlord.

Or rather, a very clever dreadlord has taken his place while he is being held captive somewhere.

It is imperative that we reveal this imposter to the new king of Stormwind. If we fail to do so, then the Alliance will surely be eaten alive from within and the Burning Legion will win this war for a certainty.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“马迪亚斯究竟在哪？：军情七处”任务
完成“马迪亚斯究竟在哪？：勇者之门”任务
完成“马迪亚斯究竟在哪？：末世祭坛”任务
完成“马迪亚斯究竟在哪？：黑鸦堡垒”任务
完成“马迪亚斯究竟在哪？：明显的起点”任务

text.title: 修剪花园
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description:
准确地说，无冕者就像园丁。这里砍一刀，那里剪一下。单看一处可能不会有什么特别，可你只要后退一步，审视整个花园就能感受到巨大的变化。

面对破碎群岛上的巨大威胁，我们必须采取果断措施。艾泽拉斯的敌对势力动作很快，我们必须剔除那些丑恶的花朵才能恢复花园的美丽。你说呢，$n？
text.completed: 返回暗影大厅去找陶矢。

english.title: Pruning the Garden
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description:
In a very real sense, the Uncrowned are gardeners. We snip and trim here and there. One clipping of a single branch may seem nonsensical until you step back and look at the garden as a whole.

On the greater theater of the Broken Isles, we must act decisively. The forces that arrayed against Azeroth are moving quickly. We need to prune some very ugly flowers to make our garden beautiful again, wouldn't you agree, $n?
english.completed: Return to Taoshi in the Chamber of Shadows.

text.title: 历史学家
text.objectives: 在暴风城的皇家图书馆与历史学家勒洛尔见面。
text.description: $n，我每年都会到暴风城帮助像你这样的冒险者回顾我们的历史。在放眼未来的同时，我们也必须吸取过去的教训。到皇家图书馆来找我吧，我们好好谈谈。

english.title: The Historians
english.objectives: Meet with Historian Llore in the Royal Library of Stormwind.
english.description: $n, each year I visit Stormwind to help adventurers like you reflect on our shared history. While our eyes must always be trained on the future, we must be mindful of our past. Come visit me in the Stormwind Royal Library and we can speak more.

text.title: 历史学家
text.objectives: 在奥格瑞玛的精神谷与历史学家吉帕见面。
text.description: $n，我每年都会到奥格瑞玛帮助像你这样的冒险者回顾我们的历史。在放眼未来的同时，我们也必须吸取过去的教训。到精神谷来找我吧，我们好好谈谈。

english.title: The Historians
english.objectives: Meet with Historian Ju'Pa in the Valley of Spirits of Orgrimmar.
english.description: $n, each year I visit Orgrimmar to help adventurers like you reflect on our shared history. While our eyes must always be trained on the future, we must be mindful of our past. Come visit me in the Valley of Spirits and we can speak more.

text.title: 试验药水：需要试验对象
黑日危机
text.objectives: 完成区域地图内任意一个”稀有精英”世界任务，此类任务会由金龙围绕的蓝色感叹号标识出来。
text.description:
我们已经修剪过了花园里的花木，是时候挖掉正中间的腐烂树桩了。

换句话说，我们必须阻止混乱势力霸占破碎群岛。当然，我们并非孤军作战。

不过，我相信你会从无冕者的角度明智地选择要铲除的目标。
text.completed: 返回暗影大厅去找陶矢。

english.title: The World is Not Enough
english.objectives: Complete any 1 "Rare Elite" World Quest designated by a blue exclamation mark surrounded by a gold dragon on the area maps.
english.description:
Now that we have pruned the garden, it is time to dig up the rotting tree stump in the middle.

Put another way, we need to make sure to keep the forces of chaos from overwhelming the Broken Isles. Certainly others are helping in this endeavor.

However, I am sure the target you select to eliminate will be the wisest from the standpoint of the Uncrowned.
english.completed: Return to Taoshi in the Chamber of Shadows.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“稀有精英”世界任务

text.title: 混淆视听
text.objectives: 在邪魂堡垒里安放诺格弗格炸弹，并启动引爆器以引爆炸弹。
text.description:
要想把马迪亚斯·肖尔从邪魂堡垒里救出来，我们就得弄点动静出来引开敌人。

我们要大闹一场。

在一些重要位置安放炸药就可以达到这个目的。诺格弗格非常配合，他特地为我们提供了一些炸药。他可能是想弥补自己之前的敲诈行为。

我需要有人进去找出合适的位置。你愿意接受这个任务吗？

english.title: A Burning Distraction
english.objectives: Place the Noggenfogger Boom Bombs on your way through Felsoul Hold and then trigger the Detonator to set them off.
english.description:
We're going to need a distraction if we are to rescue Mathias Shaw from where he's being held captive in Felsoul Hold.

A big one.

Explosives placed in a few key locations should do nicely. Noggenfogger is playing nice and has donated some bombs to the cause. He might be trying to smooth over relations due to his earlier extortion.

I can have someone go ahead and mark the best locations. You want to do the honors?

text.title: 破解法典
text.objectives: 在达拉然与德拉丝·月牙谈一谈。
text.description: 我一直在研究你从法罗纳尔带回来的《命令法典》。$B$B巴纳扎尔很重视这本书，但是为什么呢？它都记载了些什么？我很肯定，如果我们能破解这本法典，我们就能获得宝贵的知识。$B$B也许我的一位朋友可以帮上我们的忙：她是一名祭司，名叫德拉丝·月牙。她一直在研究艾瑞达语，也就是恶魔的语言。$B$B请把这个印记带到达拉然并交给她。告诉她，是我派你过去的。

english.title: Cracking the Codex
english.objectives: Speak to Delas Moonfang in Dalaran.
english.description: I have been studying the Codex of Command that you recovered from Faronaar.$B$BIt is important to Balnazzar, but WHY? What does it say? I'm sure we could gain valuable knowledge if we could just crack this code.$B$BI have a friend who might be able to help us: a priestess named Delas Moonfang. She has been studying Eredun, the language of the demons.$B$BTake the sigil to her in Dalaran. Tell her I sent you.

text.title: 突袭紫罗兰监狱：邪能词典
text.objectives: 从紫罗兰监狱的某个强大的囚犯手里取得邪能词典。
text.description: 我一直在研究恶魔语，不过我恐怕看不懂他们的书面材料。$B$B我听说有一本叫《邪能词典》的书，据说是由一个既懂艾瑞达语又懂德莱尼语的古代学者所写。如果我能得到这本书，应该可以从中学到很多东西！$B$B我听说这本书可能在紫罗兰监狱的某个强大的囚犯手里。$B$B把这本书给我带来，我就可以加快破译的速度了。

english.title: Assault on Violet Hold: The Fel Lexicon
english.objectives: Collect a Fel Lexicon from a powerful prisoner inside Violet Hold.
english.description: I have been studying the language of the demons, but it has been difficult to get my hands on written material.$B$BI have heard rumor of a book called the Fel Lexicon, written by an ancient scholar who spoke both eredun and draenei. If I could just get my hands on that book, I could learn so much!$B$BI heard that this book might be in the hands of a powerful prisoner inside the Violet Hold.$B$BBring me this book, and my work here will go much faster.

text.title: 敌人之血
text.objectives: 派遣勇士执行对付燃烧军团的“敌人之血”系列任务，收集5瓶恶魔鲜血。
text.description: 我曾经见过恶魔的神器，$n。$B$B军团印记只会在附近有恶魔之血的情况下显露。$B$B我感觉时间宝贵。我需要大量的恶魔之血，这样我或许就能在你取回那本书后立刻把它翻译出来。

english.title: Blood of Our Enemy
english.objectives: Send your champions on "Blood of Our Enemy" missions against the Burning Legion and collect 5 Flasks of Demon Blood.
english.description: I have seen demonic artifacts before, $n.$B$BLegion sigils will only reveal themselves in the presence of demon blood.$B$BI sense that time is of the essence. Bring me a large quantity of demon blood, so that I may translate the book as soon as you retrieve it.

text.title: 前往邪焰隘口
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳的邪焰隘口寻找奥伯妮·亮鬃。
text.description: 我带来了坏消息，大领主。$B$B年轻的阿拉托尔，酋长奥伯妮·亮鬃与祭司德拉丝·月牙出发前往邪焰隘口后，我们就再也没有收到过他们的任何消息。$B$B我们必须弄清楚她们到底发生了什么。$B$B我担心她们已经遭遇不测。

english.title: To Felblaze Ingress
english.objectives: Find Aponi Brightmane at Felblaze Ingress in Azsuna.
english.description: I have sobering news, Highlord.$B$BWe have had no word from Chieftain Aponi Brightmane, young Arator, or priestess Delas Moonfang since they departed for Felblaze Ingress.$B$BWe need to know what happened to them.$B$BWe fear the worst.

text.title: 奥伯妮的踪迹
text.objectives: 找到8张奥伯妮的日记书页，然后用它们找到奥伯妮的下落。
text.description: <这本书的其中几页不见了。你在附近发现了打斗的痕迹。>$B$B<如果你能在附近的恶魔身上找到这些缺失的书页，或许你就能得知同伴的最终命运。>

english.title: Aponi's Trail
english.objectives: Find 8 pages of Aponi's journal, then use them to track her down.
english.description: <The book is missing several pages. Nearby, you can see signs of a struggle.>$B$B<If you can seek the missing pages on the nearby demons, perhaps you could learn what fate befell your allies.>

objectiveDetails.description: 找到奥伯妮的日记书页

text.title: 圣光之友
text.objectives: 营救15名白银之手骑士或者教团牧师，并救出德拉丝·月牙和救赎者阿拉托尔。
text.description: 阿拉托尔和德拉丝还在这片荒凉之地的某个地方，我们的许多其他盟友也下落不明。$B$B我们不能丢下他们，$n。

english.title: Allies of the Light
english.objectives: Save 15 Silver Hand Knights or Conclave Priests, and rescue Arator the Redeemer and Delas Moonfang.
english.description: Both Arator and Delas are still somewhere on this forsaken rock, as well as many of our other allies.$B$BWe cannot leave them, $n.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 黑鸦堡垒：拉文凯斯领主
text.objectives: 击败黑鸦堡垒的库塔洛斯·拉文凯斯领主。
text.description: 大领主，我们刚刚收到消息，燃烧军团的一支部队出现在了黑鸦堡垒附近。$B$B据说暗夜精灵的指挥官，库塔洛斯·拉文凯斯在堡垒中集结了一只庞大的军队。$B$B召集你强大的战友吧，大领主，然后去查清这些传闻。拉文凯斯领主在艾萨拉女王统治时期是一位令人畏惧的将军。如果报告属实，我们就必须进一步地了解他的消息。

english.title: Black Rook Hold: Lord Ravencrest
english.objectives: Defeat Lord Kur'talos Ravencrest in Black Rook Hold.
english.description: Highlord, news has reached us of a Legion presence at Black Rook Hold.$B$BIt is rumored that the night elf commander, Kur'talos Ravencrest, amasses an enormous army behind the fortress walls.$B$BTake a group of your most powerful allies, Highlord, and investigate these stories. Lord Ravencrest was a formidable general during Azshara's reign, and if the reports are true, then we must know more.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: 对战库塔洛斯·拉文凯斯领主

text.title: 白银之手骑士
text.objectives: 与指挥官伯恩对话。
text.description: 好消息，大领主。我们招募到了一名圣骑士训练师，指挥官伯恩。$B$B他是一名严厉的教官，但他近年来训练出了不少出类拔萃的圣骑士。能够让他为我们效力真是幸事一件。$B$B去和他谈谈吧，然后训练一队白银之手骑士。

english.title: Silver Hand Knights
english.objectives: Speak to Commander Born.
english.description: Good news, Highlord! We have recruited a paladin trainer named Commander Born.$B$BHe is a hard teacher, but has trained some of the greatest paladin knights in recent times. We are lucky to have his services.$B$BGo speak to him, and train a squad of Silver Hand Knights.

text.title: 深藏的力量
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳的蓝翼栖地与大法师卡雷见面。
text.description: 很抱歉贸然打扰你，$n。有空聊聊吗？$B$B在你与燃烧军团战斗的过程中，你的武器所蕴含的力量已经大幅增长。不过，我忍不住要想它是否还有……更多的……潜力。没准它还有一个全新的形态！$B$B我们应该证实一下这个想法。$B$B你认识阿苏纳的那头老蓝龙塞纳苟斯吧？等你抽出空来，就到他的栖地来找我吧。到时我们再详细讨论。

english.title: The Power Within
english.objectives: Meet Archmage Kalec at Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.
english.description: My apologies for the unannounced intrusion, $n. Do you have a moment?$B$BThe power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!$B$BThe very thought demands we find out for sure.$B$BYou are familiar with the ancient blue dragon Senegos in Azsuna, yes? Meet me at his repose once you are able and we will discuss more.

text.title: 深藏的力量
text.objectives: 完成阿苏纳的“保卫蓝翼栖地”故事线，然后在蓝翼栖地与大法师卡雷会合。
text.description: 很抱歉贸然打扰你，$n。有空聊聊吗？$B$B在你与燃烧军团战斗的过程中，你的武器所蕴含的力量已经大幅增长。不过，我忍不住要想它是否还有……更多的……潜力。没准它还有一个全新的形态！$B$B我们应该证实一下这个想法。$B$B阿苏纳有一条奄奄一息的年迈蓝龙，他的名字叫塞纳苟斯。他对于我们的旅途至关重要。你必须帮助他，我会尽快到他的栖地跟你碰头。

english.title: The Power Within
english.objectives: Complete the "Defending Azurewing Repose" storyline in Azsuna, then meet Archmage Kalec at Azurewing Repose.
english.description: My apologies for the unannounced intrusion, $n. Do you have a moment?$B$BThe power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!$B$BThe very thought demands we find out for sure.$B$BThe ancient blue dragon in Azsuna known as Senegos lays dying and is key to our journey. You must aid him - I will meet you in his domain as soon as I am able.

text.title: 季节的变换
text.objectives: 与奥术师瓦尔托伊谈一谈。
text.description:
时候到了。

阿坎多尔就要成熟了。最后一次爆发性成长后，这份馈赠就能彻底成为现实。

我们必须准备好魔网能量。

english.title: A Change of Seasons
english.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Valtrois.
english.description:
It is time.

The arcan'dor is preparing to mature. With a final burst of growth, this gift will be fully realized.

We must make ready the leyline feed.

text.title: 深藏的力量
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳的蓝翼栖地与大法师卡雷见面。
text.description: 有空聊聊吗，咒术师？$B$B在你与燃烧军团战斗的过程中，你的武器所蕴含的力量已经大幅增长。不过，我忍不住要想它是否还有……更多的……潜力。没准它还有一个全新的形态！$B$B我们应该证实一下这个想法。$B$B你认识阿苏纳的那头老蓝龙塞纳苟斯吧？等你抽出空来，就到他的栖地来找我吧。到时我们再详细讨论。

english.title: The Power Within
english.objectives: Meet Archmage Kalec at Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.
english.description: Do you have a moment, Conjurer?$B$BThe power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away deep within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!$B$BThe very thought demands we find out for sure.$B$BYou are familiar with the ancient blue dragon Senegos in Azsuna, yes? Meet me at his repose once you are able and we will discuss more.

text.title: 深藏的力量
text.objectives: 完成阿苏纳的“保卫蓝翼栖地”故事线，然后在蓝翼栖地与大法师卡雷会合。
text.description: 有空聊聊吗，咒术师？$B$B在你与燃烧军团战斗的过程中，你的武器所蕴含的力量已经大幅增长。不过，我忍不住要想它是否还有……更多的……潜力。没准它还有一个全新的形态！$B$B我们应该证实一下这个想法。$B$B阿苏纳有一条奄奄一息的年迈蓝龙，他的名字叫塞纳苟斯。他对于我们的旅途至关重要。你必须帮助他，我会尽快到他的栖地跟你碰头。

english.title: The Power Within
english.objectives: Complete the "Defending Azurewing Repose" storyline in Azsuna, then meet Archmage Kalec at Azurewing Repose.
english.description: Do you have a moment, Conjurer?$B$BThe power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!$B$BThe very thought demands we find out for sure.$B$BThe ancient blue dragon in Azsuna known as Senegos lays dying and is key to our journey. You must aid him - I will meet you in his domain as soon as I am able.

text.title: 黑鸦堡垒：更强大的力量
text.objectives: 在地下城“黑鸦堡垒”中，击败库塔洛斯·拉文凯斯并从丹塔利纳克斯身上获取一枚巨型恶魔符文石。
text.description: 海姆达尔可以用符文石的原始力量暂时打开通往恶魔世界的入口，但这还不够。$B$B燃烧军团用黑暗魔法在遥远的世界中藏身。带回一块更强大的恶魔符文石，让海姆达尔可以在浩渺的宇宙中找到我们的敌人。

english.title: Black Rook Hold: Greater Power
english.objectives: Defeat Lord Kur'talos Ravencrest and retrieve a Greater Demonic Runestone from Dantalionax in the Black Rook Hold Dungeon.
english.description: The raw power of the runestones will allow Hymdall to temporarily open a tear into demonic worlds, but it's not enough.$B$BThe Legion hides its presence in far away worlds with dark magic. Bring a greater runestone so that Hymdall can hone in on our enemies across the cosmos.

text.title: 被关押的间谍大师
text.objectives: 跟着陶矢进入关押马迪亚斯·肖尔的日蚀大厅。
text.description:
我们必须趁乱行动。马迪亚斯·肖尔就被关在南边的日蚀大厅下层。

快，$n，我们走！
text.completed: 去日蚀大厅深处找到陶矢。

english.title: The Captive Spymaster
english.objectives: Follow Taoshi into the Halls of the Eclipse to where Mathias Shaw is being held captive.
english.description:
We must move swiftly while the distraction is working. Mathias Shaw is being held in the lower levels of the Halls of the Eclipse directly to the south.

Quickly, $n, we must go!
english.completed: Meet up with Taoshi ahead in the depths of the Halls of the Eclipse.

text.title: 奥丁的挑战
text.objectives: 击败英灵殿中的奥丁。
text.description:
奥丁亲自发来了一则消息。他和他的战士们正在英灵殿里等待有资格的挑战者出现。

击败英灵殿的勇士，夺得荣耀。

english.title: Odyn's Challenge
english.objectives: Defeat Odyn in the Halls of Valor.
english.description:
Odyn himself sends a message. He and his warriors await worthy contenders within the Halls of Valor.

Defeat the champions of the Halls of Valor, and claim glory.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 昔日浮华
text.objectives: 从维里迪斯·法隆那里取得一份浮华饮剂。
text.description: 辛艾萨莉之心的魔力通过强大的结界法术与艾萨拉的精锐紧密相连。如果我们冒然提取它的力量，无疑是自寻死路。$B$B不过，我们或许有办法避开它的结界。$B$B法罗迪斯王子和他的宫廷曾经是艾萨拉帝国的一部分，所以仍然保留着跟他们的肮脏过去有关的物品。其中有一种叫做浮华饮剂的东西，据说它可以使女王的追随者对她更加死心塌地。$B$B看看你能否说服宫廷分一瓶给你。

english.title: A Vainglorious Past
english.objectives: Obtain a Vainglorious Draught from Veridis Fallon.
english.description: The Heart's magic is attuned to Azshara's elite through powerful warding spells. If we tried to tap into its power now we would be met only with our own demise.$B$BHowever, there may be a way we can bypass the wards.$B$BPrince Farondis and his court were once a part of Azshara's empire, and still hold on to keepsakes of their sordid past. Among these is sure to be a Vainglorious Draught, said to further bind the queen's followers to her will.$B$BSee if you can convince the court to part with a bottle.

text.title: 黑心林地：堕落之力
text.objectives: 在史诗难度黑心林地的橡树之心身上取得腐化精华，并击败萨维斯之影。
text.description: 一旦我们得到了合适的工具，我们就能用这颗心脏向你的神器中注入强大的能量。我们现在唯一需要的就是能量之源。$B$B在黑心林地的深处有棵古树橡树之心，它曾经是莎拉达希尔强悍而伟大的守护者。遗憾的是，如同他的同族一样，他也已经堕入了梦魇之中。$B$B黑暗根植于他的内心，堕落精华也随之产生。我希望你取回堕落精华。我们可以从中汲取力量，也可以让高尚的橡树之心重获安息。

english.title: Darkheart Thicket: Fallen Power
english.objectives: Recover a Corrupted Essence from Oakheart and defeat the Shade of Xavius in Darkheart Thicket on Mythic difficulty.
english.description: Once we have the proper implements we can use the Heart to infuse great power into your artifact. We need only a source.$B$BDeep within the Darkheart Thicket lies the ancient Oakheart, once a great and mighty protector of Shaladrassil. He has regrettably fallen to the nightmare like so many of his kin.$B$BAs the darkness within him has taken root, an essence of the corruption has manifested. I ask that you recover the essence so that we may draw from its power, and put noble Oakheart to rest.

text.title: 调和黑暗
text.objectives: 获得$1oa份萨格拉斯之血。
text.description: 我并不怀疑塞纳苟斯的计划，但我很担心这颗心脏的不稳定性，尤其是它与梦魇能量相结合的时候。$B$B有种材料，虽然它名叫“萨格拉斯之血”，但实际上它却经常被技艺高超的工匠当做回火材料使用。我想我们也可以将它用于我们的仪式。$B$B在你四处旅行的过程中，你应该多加留意——我们需要大量的这种材料才能保证一切的顺利。

english.title: Tempering Darkness
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Blood of Sargeras.
english.description: I do not doubt Senegos' plan, but I do have some concerns about the Heart's volatility, especially when combined with nightmare energy.$B$BDespite its name, Blood of Sargeras is often used as a tempering agent by master craftsmen. I believe it would work for our ritual as well.$B$BYou should keep an eye out for it during your travels - we'll need a substantial amount to ensure that everything goes smoothly.

text.title: 清醒之力
text.objectives: 利用辛艾萨莉之心从堕落精华中吸取能量。
text.description: 我们已经准备万全，$n。$B$B你准备好了的话，就举起你的神器，并用它来安全地吸取辛艾萨莉之心中的梦魇能量。$B$B我会利用你带回的血来保证仪式的安全。

english.title: Lucid Strength
english.objectives: Absorb the power from the Corrupted Essence using the Heart of Zin-Azshari.
english.description: We have everything we need, $n.$B$BOnce you are ready, raise your artifact and channel its energy upon the Heart of Zin-Azshari to safely absorb the power stored within the nightmare essence.$B$BI will use the blood you provided to make sure the ritual stays safely contained.

text.title: 翡翠梦魇：梦魇之中
text.objectives: 在普通或更高难度的翡翠梦魇中获得死光之虹和梦魇之王的号角。
text.description: 我们必须竭尽全力，防止梦魇再次在翡翠梦境之中滋生。$B$B被称为“伊格诺斯”的畸变体就位于腐化的中心，你的旅程中遇到的所有恐惧，都蠕动着化身为这个活体。$B$B我请求你，将那只怪物连同梦魇之王……萨维斯一起从这世上永远抹去。$B$B一旦任务完成，记得把他们的碎片各带一份给我。我们可以对其进行研究，并弄清梦魇快速蔓延的真相。

english.title: The Emerald Nightmare: In Nightmares
english.objectives: Obtain a Deathglare Iris and the Horn of the Nightmare Lord from the Emerald Nightmare on Normal difficulty or higher.
english.description: We must do what we can to ensure that the Nightmare never again festers within the Emerald Dream.$B$BThe aberration known as Il'gynoth lies at the heart of the corruption - a living, writhing manifestation of the horrors you will encounter at every turn of your journey.$B$BI ask that you ensure its destruction, along with the Nightmare Lord himself... Xavius.$B$BOnce the deeds have been done, bring a small piece of each to me. We can study them to figure out just how the Nightmare grew so quickly.

text.title: 力量精华
text.objectives: 在普通或更高难度的翡翠梦魇中收集$1oa份堕落精华。
text.description: 现在，我们已经对这颗心脏的能力有了更深入的了解，是时候解放它真正的力量了。$B$B在翡翠梦魇中，你会发现本不应存在的生物，以及完全背离这片梦境存在意义的怪物。$B$B它们完全背弃了绿龙军团的意义。$B$B正如橡树之心一样，这些怪物的体内都存在着堕落精华，其力量也更加强大。尽可能地收集那些精华吧，我们将利用敌人的腐化之力让他们自食其果。

english.title: Essence of Power
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Corrupted Essence from the Emerald Nightmare on Normal difficulty or higher.
english.description: Now that we have a better understanding on the Heart's capabilities, it is time we tap into its true potential.$B$BIn the Emerald Nightmare you will find creatures that should not be; monsters that defy all that the Dream stands for.$B$BAll that the green flight itself stands for.$B$BEach of these fiends carry within them corrupted essence, as Oakheart did, but far more potent. Gather all that you can, and we will turn their corruption against them.

text.title: 吸收精华
text.objectives: 利用辛艾萨莉之心吸取堕落精华的混合之力。
text.description: 如同之前一样，$n，一旦你准备好了，就举起你的神器，把能量引导到辛艾萨莉之心上，而我们会释放你收集到的精华之力。$B$B不用担心，你收集的萨格拉斯之血我们还有剩余，足以保证仪式的安全进行。

english.title: Essential Consumption
english.objectives: Absorb the combined power of the Corrupted Essences using the Heart of Zin-Azshari.
english.description: As before, $n, once you are ready raise your artifact and channel its energy upon the Heart of Zin-Azshari and we will unleash the power of the essence you gathered.$B$BDo not worry - we still have enough of the blood you gathered to ensure the ritual remains stable.

text.title: 了结旧债
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛的沙尔艾兰与大法师卡雷会面。
text.description: 很多年前，在上古之战期间，月之守卫奋力抵抗燃烧军团入侵。他们非常了解我们的敌人，这对我们的事业是无价之宝。$B$B你救了萨伦努斯和他的家族之后，他们一直呆在沙尔艾兰。不如我们去拜访一下他们吧？

english.title: Repaid Debt
english.objectives: Meet Archmage Kalec in the Shal'Aran in Suramar.
english.description: The Moon Guard fought against the Legion many years ago, during the War of the Ancients. Their intimate knowledge of our enemies would be invaluable to our cause.$B$BThey have remained in Shal'Aran since you saved Thalrenus and his kin. Shall we pay them a visit and see what they can do?

text.title: 群星庭院：文学改良
text.objectives: 在史诗难度的群星庭院找到洛休斯的第一版《卷轴、印记及夜之子之道》。
text.description: 世界上有那么多的书，为什么偏偏是这一本？！哦，月神在上，我真是个好骗的傻瓜。$B$B真是抱歉，但你绝对想不到我的身上发生了什么。$B$B我把我创作的《结界、印记及夜之子之道》的初版借给了我的一位好朋友——或者说，曾经的好朋友——然后他就背叛了我。就好像命中注定一样，那本书里记载着一道咒语，而我需要这道咒语来完成仪式。$B$B求求你，帮我取回那本书吧。不过你得千万小心，它实在是太珍贵了！

english.title: Court of Stars: Literary Perfection
english.objectives: Find Lothrius' first edition copy of "Wards, Sigils, and the Nightborne Way" in the Court of Stars on Mythic difficulty.
