english.description: Out of all the books, why that one?! Oh, Mother Moon, I am but a trusting fool.$B$BI apologize, you have no idea what I'm going on about.$B$BI lent my first edition copy of "Wards, Sigils, and the Nightborne Way" to a dear friend - well, former friend, I should say - just before the betrayal.$B$BAs fate would have it, there is an incantation in that book that I will need for my part of the ritual.$B$BPlease retrieve it if you can, but be careful - it is quite valuable!

text.title: 守望者地窟：擅自借取
text.objectives: 在史诗难度的守望者地窟取得一个封锁水晶。
text.description: 神出鬼没的守望者在阿苏纳山脉的地底深处守卫着一座巨大的秘密监狱，这里关押着千奇百怪的可怕生物。$B$B也许……“曾经守卫过”这种表达要更加准确一些。$B$B这对我们来说是个绝好的机会。守望者曾借助强大的封锁水晶来确保所有的囚犯都无法冲破牢房。只要不是所有水晶都不复存在，我们就能拿取其中的一颗来储存心脏的能量。$B$B那些守望者已经用不上这些水晶了。

english.title: Vault of the Wardens: Borrowing Without Asking
english.objectives: Recover a Containment Crystal from the Vault of the Wardens on Mythic difficulty.
english.description: The elusive Wardens run an immense secret prison facility deep underneath the mountains of Azsuna housing all manner of terrible creatures.$B$BPerhaps... 'used to run' is more accurate.$B$BThis presents us with a unique opportunity. The wardens used powerful containment crystals to encase each prisoner in their cell. If any of them still remain intact, we could use one to safely contain the Heart's power.$B$BThey certainly won't be needing them.

text.title: 真正的考验
text.objectives: 利用辛艾萨莉之心从扭曲的符文腕轮中吸取能量。
text.description: 维祖尔的符文腕轮所具有的能量比我想象的还要强大。不过这也不是件坏事——能量这种东西当然是多多益善。不过，如果法术矩阵不稳定的话，这股能量就可能会闯出大祸来。$B$B如果我们在压制力场内使用你取回的永世之阶，我们应该就能安全地控制这股邪能……不过我们还是得小心谨慎，以防万一。

english.title: A True Test
english.objectives: Absorb the power from the Twisted Runebindings using the Heart of Zin-Azshari.
english.description: Vizuul's runebindings are more potent than I had anticipated. Not a bad thing - more power is certainly welcome - but there's certainly more potential for catastrophe if the spell matrix somehow becomes unstable.$B$BWe should be able to safely contain the fel energy within the containment field using the eon winder you recovered... but keep an eye open just in case.

text.title: 拯救月之守卫
text.objectives: 完成苏拉玛的“护月堡垒”故事线，然后在沙尔艾兰与大法师卡雷会合。
text.description: 月之守卫曾经名列艾泽拉斯大陆上最为强大的巫师。很多人认为他们在上古之战之后就消失了，但现在看来，他们在苏拉玛的上古要塞里活了下来！$B$B如果他们还在抵抗燃烧军团，我相信他们将会成为非常宝贵的盟友。$B$B$n，如果你能拯救月之守卫的残部，我会继续劝说六人议会给予我们额外援助。

english.title: Saving the Guard
english.objectives: Complete the "Moon Guard Stronghold" storyline in Suramar, then meet Archmage Kalec in Shal'Aran.
english.description: The Moon Guard were once among the most powerful sorcerers on Azeroth. Most assumed their ranks demolished after the War of the Ancients, but it seems they have managed to survive in their ancient stronghold in Suramar!$B$BI believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if they still oppose the Legion.$B$B$n, if you can save what remains of the Guard, I will work to convince the Council of Six to lend us additional aid.

objectiveDetails.description: 在苏拉玛协助月之守卫

text.title: 策划袭击
text.objectives: 等待暗夜要塞开放，然后与沙尔艾兰的大法师卡雷会面。
text.description: 多亏了你不知疲倦的努力，辛艾萨莉之心已经准备好承载燃烧军团的力量了。从我们旅程开始的那一刻，我们的终点就一直刺眼地占据着我们的视野——暗夜要塞，现在那里已经完全变成了古尔丹的巢穴。$B$B我们现在需要的，就是一条进入内部的通路。$B$B我正在积极地与六人议会的其他成员展开合作，试图找到一个入口。一旦我们成功，我们就应该将沙尔艾兰的月之守卫重新集结起来——我们依然需要他们的力量。

english.title: Planning the Assault
english.objectives: Await the opening of the Nighthold, then meet Archmage Kalec in Shal'Aran.
english.description: Thanks to your tireless efforts the Heart of Zin-Azshari is ready to withstand the full power of the Legion. The final destination in our journey has stood defiantly in front of us from the moment we began - the Nighthold, now home to none other than Gul'dan himself.$B$BWe just need a way inside.$B$BI am working fervently with the rest of the Council of Six to secure an entrance. Once we have, we should reunite with the Moon Guard in Shal'Aran - we still have need of their skills.

text.title: 暗夜要塞：崇高的幻象
text.objectives: 在普通或更高难度的暗夜要塞中收集崔利艾克斯的核心和大魔导师艾利桑德的千年之书。
text.description: 大魔导师艾利桑德和她的追随者都已经失去了理智——她们深信，与燃烧军团的联盟可以确保他们不会毁灭！$B$B恐怕，她们已经完全无可救药了，但她们拥有强力的物品，我们可以用来把力量注入辛艾萨莉之心。$B$B在你进攻暗夜要塞的时候，切记要拿到疯狂的构造体崔利艾克斯的核心，以及大魔导师的法术书。$B$B祝你好运。

english.title: The Nighthold: Delusions of Grandeur
english.objectives: Collect the core of Trilliax and Grand Magistrix Elisande's Millennia Tome in the Nighthold on Normal difficulty or higher.
english.description: Grand Magistrix Elisande and her cohorts have lost their minds - they truly believe that allying themselves with the Legion will end in anything but their own demise!$B$BThey are too far gone to save, I'm afraid, but they still have powerful items that we can use to help us infuse the Heart of Zin-Azshari with their power.$B$BIn your assault on the Nighthold, ensure you recover the mad construct Trilliax's power core, as well as the spellbook of the Grand Magistrix herself.$B$BGood luck.

text.title: 深入暗夜要塞
text.objectives: 在普通或更高难度的暗夜要塞中收集$1oa个暗夜碎片。
text.description: 我们的工作即将完成。既然这颗心可以安全地吸收邪能魔力，那么我们就应该尽可能地寻找强大的能量源。$B$B为了加强军力，古尔丹已经将夜之子的精锐部队召回了暗夜要塞。宫殿上方的邪能风暴已经渗入了这座建筑的每一寸砖瓦，甚至连许多暗夜井的晶化碎片中也含有邪能。$B$B这些碎片正是我们所需要的，$n。在你进攻的路上，请尽可能地收集它们。

english.title: Into the Nighthold
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Nightshards from the Nighthold on Normal difficulty or higher.
english.description: Our work is very nearly complete. Now that the Heart can safely absorb power from fel magic, we need the strongest sources of it that we can get our hands on.$B$BGul'dan has called the nightborne's elite back to the Nighthold to aid him. The storm of fel energy above the palace has seeped into the very fabric of their being, even making its way into the crystallized pieces of the Nightwell that many carry with them.$B$BThose shards are exactly what we need, $n. Save as many as you can in your assault.

text.title: 暗夜要塞：黑暗召唤
text.objectives: 在普通或更高难度中将一颗古尔丹之眼交给大法师卡雷。
text.description: 在我们举行仪式之前，我还要请你做一件事情，$n。$B$B你必须让古尔丹受到正义的制裁。$B$B他的谎言、他的欺骗、他的阴谋都必须永远地从这个世界上消失。这些都再也无法保护他。$B$B完事之后，拿回一颗古尔丹的魔法之眼。我们可以把他的力量用于正途。

english.title: The Nighthold: Darkness Calls
english.objectives: Bring one Gul'dan's eyes to Archmage Kalec on Normal difficulty or higher.
english.description: Before we perform the ritual there is one last thing I must ask of you, $n.$B$BYou must finally bring Gul'dan to justice.$B$BNo more of his lies, his deceits, or his trickery. None of it can save him now.$B$BTake one of his conjured eyes when you're done. Using his power for good will be a fitting end.

text.title: 能量的平衡
text.objectives: 在月光熔炉使用辛艾萨莉之心吸收暗夜碎片和古尔丹之眼融合后的力量。
text.description: 终于到了收获劳动果实的时候。$B$B洛休斯说，以前，月之守卫要塞深处有个地方，他们曾在那里为新守卫灌注强大的力量。若要融合并增强你收集的暗夜碎片的力量，那个地方是最完美的选择。$B$B拿上你努力获得的物品，准备好后和我在那里碰头。运用心脏，我们将最终释放出神器的强大力量。

english.title: Balance of Power
english.objectives: Absorb the combined power of the Nightshards and the Eye of Gul'dan using the Heart of Zin-Azshari at the Lunar Crucible.
english.description: At long last, it is time to reap the fruits of your labors.$B$BLothrius tells of a place deep in the former Moonguard Stronghold used to infuse new Guards with immense power. It will be the perfect place to tap into and augment the power of the Nightshards you gathered.$B$BGather your effects and meet me there when you are ready, and we will use the Heart to finally reveal the great power within your artifact.

text.title: 萨格拉斯之血
text.objectives: 收集5份萨格拉斯之血。
text.description: 我们需要一种强力的材料才能把魔法连结到武器和护甲上。有种稀有的材料刚好能行，名字叫做萨格拉斯之血。$B$B我们要的数量可不少。你有多少都尽管拿过来吧。

english.title: Blood of Sargeras
english.objectives: Collect 5 Blood of Sargeras.
english.description: We will require a powerful reagent to bind the magic in our weapons and armor. A rare material that will do just the trick is Blood of Sargeras.$B$BWe will need a plentiful quantity. Bring me whatever you can muster.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 翻译：危险！
text.objectives: 与圣光秘殿的奥伯妮·亮鬃谈一谈。
text.description: <德拉丝将邪能之血抹在词典的书页上，奇怪的印记开始在纸张上放射出光芒。她飞快地写了下来。>$B$B天呐……这些是在邪焰隘口的军团入侵部队的详细记录。他们准备打开一道直接通往尼斯卡拉恶魔世界的传送门！情况十分严峻——我们必须立刻通知你的盟友。$B$B如果你准备回圣光之愿礼拜堂，我可以与你同行吗？我希望能帮上忙。

english.title: Translation: Danger!
english.objectives: Speak to Aponi Brightmane at the Sanctum of Light.
english.description: <Delas smears fel blood across the lexicon's pages. Alien sigils blaze forth above the paper. She scribbles them down furiously.>$B$BMy goodness... these are detailed records of the Legion invasion force at Felblaze Ingress. They are planning to open a portal directly to their demon world of Niskara! This is quite serious - we need to alert your allies at once.$B$BIf you are going back to Light's Hope Chapel, could I accompany you? I would like to offer my services.

text.title: 骑手萨拉纳尔
text.objectives: 完成“骑手萨拉纳尔”任务。
text.description: 天启四骑士需要最完美的战马。这绝非易事。$b$b作为战役的下一步计划，我策划了一个前往暗影界的任务。$b$b任务目标是找到骑手萨拉纳尔，黑暗骑士的领袖，并将他召唤到阿彻鲁斯。$b$b等你一声令下，这个任务就将开始。

english.title: Salanar the Horseman
english.objectives: Complete the "Salanar the Horsemen" mission.
english.description: The Four Horsemen will need perfect steeds. This is no simple task.$b$bFor the next step of our campaign, I have organized a mission to the Realm of Shadows.$b$bThe goal of the mission is to find Salanar the Horseman, leader of the Dark Riders, and summon him to Acherus.$b$bThe mission is currently waiting your assignment.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“骑手萨拉纳尔”任务

text.title: 敌军情报
text.objectives: 找出军团情报、星图，以及维伦的影像，然后消灭蛛后艾拉米丝。
text.description: 恶魔狱卒提到他们即将发动进攻。他们正在集结大军，准备大干一场。这让我非常担心。$B$B让我们去搞清楚他们的计划吧。

english.title: The Mind of the Enemy
english.objectives: Find the Legion Intelligence, the Star Map, the Image of Velen, then slay Brood Queen Aramis.
english.description: The demon jailors spoke of an upcoming invasion. Their army is gathering for something big, and it worries me greatly.$B$BLet us find whatever information we can about their plans.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 团结一致
text.objectives: 跟德拉丝·月牙谈一谈并旁听战争会议。
text.description: 我很高兴你能平安回来，大领主。德拉丝·月牙也到了，她还带来了教团的代表。$B$B他们是来讨论虚空之光神殿的事的，那是他们深藏在扭曲虚空里的总部。$B$B你们都知道，燃烧军团一直在寻找这个神殿，而现在……恶魔已经发现了它。$B$B白银之手已经同意倾听他们的诉求。你愿意参与讨论吗，大领主？

english.title: United As One
english.objectives: Speak to Delas Moonfang and hear the council of war.
english.description: I am glad you returned safely, Highlord. Delas Moonfang has also arrived with representatives of the Conclave.$B$BThe priests have come to discuss Netherlight Temple, their seat of power, hidden deep within the Twisting Nether.$B$BAs you have both discovered, the Legion has been searching for them for quite some time, and now... they have found them.$B$BThe Silver Hand has agreed to hear their words. Would you join them now, Highlord?

text.title: 黑鸦堡垒领主
text.objectives: 在黑鸦堡垒击败库塔洛斯·拉文凯斯领主。
text.description:
我们的勇士在调查黑鸦堡垒废墟的时候遭到了伏击！黑鸦领主似乎已经和燃烧军团勾结到了一起。

我们需要你协助我们击败他不断壮大的军队并将他消灭。

english.title: The Lord of Black Rook Hold
english.objectives: Defeat Lord Kur'talos Ravencrest in Black Rook Hold.
english.description:
While investigating the remains of Black Rook Hold, our Champions were ambushed!  The Lord of the Rook appears to have allied himself with the Legion.

We need your assistance to defeat his growing army, and bring him down.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: 在黑鸦堡垒击败库塔洛斯·拉文凯斯领主

text.title: 深入梦魇：伊格诺斯
text.objectives: 击败翡翠梦魇的伊格诺斯。
text.description: 我们的勇士已经发现了腐化之源。翡翠梦境已经被燃烧军团感染，如果我们不想办法阻止他们的话，恐怕这将仅仅是腐化的开始。必须有人阻止它。

english.title: Into the Nightmare: Il'gynoth
english.objectives: Defeat Il'gynoth in the Emerald Nightmare.
english.description: Our Champions have discovered the source of the corruption.  The Emerald Dream has been infested by the Legion and if we don't put our efforts towards stopping them, this will be only the beginning of the corruption.  It must be stopped here.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 深入梦魇：伊格诺斯
text.objectives: 击败翡翠梦魇的伊格诺斯。
text.description: 我们的勇士找到了腐化的源头。燃烧军团已经侵蚀了翡翠梦境，如果我们不加以阻止，腐化就会大肆扩散。我们必须把邪恶扼杀在摇篮里。

text.title: Court of Stars
text.objectives: Defeat Advisor Melandrus in Court of Stars.
text.description:
The weather is perfect for a party, isn't it?

Travel to the Court of Stars, where the Grand Magistrix herself may appear among her nobles to reassure them of the need for all the Legion patrols.

english.objectives: Defeat Advisor Melandrus in Court of Stars.

The weather is perfect for a party, isn't it?

Travel to the Court of Stars, where the Grand Magistrix herself may appear among her nobles to reassure them of the need for all the Legion patrols.

objectiveDetails.description: Defeat Advisor Melandrus in Court of Stars

text.title: 黑心林地
text.objectives: 击败黑心林地的萨维斯之影。
text.description:
在莎拉达希尔的枝干底下，萨维斯不断施压，扭曲并折磨着曾经圣洁的德鲁伊林地。

不仅如此，萨维斯还俘虏了许多德鲁伊，以缓慢又痛苦的方式折磨他们。我们必须前往黑心林地，阻止他的邪恶计划。

english.title: Darkheart Thicket
english.objectives: Defeat the Shade of Xavius in Darkheart Thicket.
english.description:
Beneath the boughs of Shaladrassil, Xavius extends his power to twist and torment the once-pure druid grove. 

Not only this, but Xavius has taken a prize from among the druids, and his revenge will be slow and painful. We should go to Darkheart Thicket and stop his wicked plans.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: 在黑心林地击败萨维斯之影

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼
text.objectives: 击败艾萨拉之眼的艾萨拉之怒。
text.description:
我们经过调查发现，在艾萨拉女王的命令之下，纳迦正在准备召唤某种强大的存在，企图让艾萨拉的力量席卷整个破碎群岛。

前往艾萨拉之眼，阻止这场仪式。

english.title: Eye of Azshara
english.objectives: Defeat the Wrath of Azshara in Eye of Azshara.
english.description:
Our investigation found that the naga, under the orders of Queen Azshara herself, are preparing to summon a powerful entity to unleash Azshara's power across the Broken Isles.

Travel to the Eye of Azshara, and put a stop to the ritual.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: 在艾萨拉之眼击败艾萨拉之怒

text.title: 噬魂之喉
text.objectives: 击败噬魂之喉的海拉。
text.description:
根据我们的斥候报告，被诅咒的维库人被迫登上了纳格法尔号幽灵船。

前往噬魂之喉并击败海拉，阻止她吸收更多的不幸灵魂。

english.title: Maw of Souls
english.objectives: Defeat Helya in Maw of Souls.
english.description:
Our scouts report that the vrykul damned are forced to sail aboard the Naglfar, a ship built of death.

Travel to the Maw of Souls and confront Helya, before she collects any more poor, unfortunate souls.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 奈萨里奥的巢穴
text.objectives: 击败奈萨里奥的巢穴的达古尔。
text.description:
我们的斥候发现，卓格巴尔不仅得到了泰坦圣物，还集结了一支足以威胁整个世界的大军。

在卓格巴尔军队大举入侵之前，深入地下，阻止地底之王。

english.title: Neltharion's Lair
english.objectives: Defeat Dargrul in Neltharion's Lair.
english.description:
Our scouts found that not only have the drogbar obtained a Titan relic, but also they've amassed an army large enough to threaten the overworld.

Delve underground and stop the Underking before he can unleash the might of his drogbar army.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: 在奈萨里奥的巢穴击败达古尔

text.title: The Arcway
text.objectives: Defeat Advisor Vandros in The Arcway.
text.description:
The Arcway is even more vast than we thought, and holds many dangers. If we have any hope of taking the city, we must first see to the underground.

Enter The Arcway and clear out any, and all enemies.

english.title: The Arcway
english.objectives: Defeat Advisor Vandros in The Arcway.
english.description:
The Arcway is even more vast than we thought, and holds many dangers. If we have any hope of taking the city, we must first see to the underground.

Enter The Arcway and clear out any, and all enemies.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: Defeat Advisor Vandros in The Arcway

text.title: 守望者地窟
text.objectives: 击败守望者地窟的科达娜·邪歌。
text.description:
守望者地窟里的状况比我们想象的还要糟糕。原来的囚犯摇身一变成为了狱卒，全面占领了地窟。不过，我们情报显示，科达娜·邪歌可能就在那里。

进入守望者地窟，净化那里的邪恶。

english.title: Vault of the Wardens
english.objectives: Defeat Cordana Felsong in Vault of the Wardens.
english.description:
It's worse than we thought within the Vault of the Wardens. The prisoners have become the jailers, and have completely taken over the vault. However, our intelligence reports that Cordana Felsong herself may be there.

Enter the Vault of the Wardens and cleanse the place of evil.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: 在守望者地窟击败科达娜·邪歌

text.title: 紫罗兰监狱
text.objectives: 击败突袭紫罗兰监狱的敌方领袖。
text.description: 紫罗兰监狱中关押着巫妖王手下的数名大将，而燃烧军团的爪牙很可能已经大量潜入。我们必须到那里去阻止恶魔放出任何囚犯。

english.title: Violet Hold
english.objectives: Defeat the leader of the Assault on Violet Hold.
english.description: The Violet Hold contains some of the Lich King's most powerful servants, and is at risk of being overrun by Legion agents. We must go there and thwart the demons before any of the prisoners can be set free.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: 击败突袭紫罗兰监狱的首领

text.title: 风元素领主的腕轮
text.objectives: 取得一对风元素领主的腕轮以及10块地狱硫磺。
text.description:
桑德兰重新控制了天空之墙，你或许真的能与他达成协议，换取那些微不足道的玩意儿。不过一个腕轮是没用的。

把两个腕轮都给我带来，还有足以将它们串联起来的强大矿石，我就会安排你去见风元素领主桑德兰。

english.title: Bindings of the Windlord
english.objectives: Retrieve both Bindings of the Windlord and 10 Infernal Brimstone.
english.description:
With Thunderaan risen again as the lord of Skywall, there may indeed be an arrangement you can make in exchange for those wretched implements. But one binding is of no use on its own.

Return to me with both bindings, and with powerful enough ore to bind them, and I will arrange your audience with Thunderaan the Windlord.

text.title: 会见桑德兰
text.objectives: 与桑德兰见面。
text.description:
我履行了承诺。风元素领主桑德兰已经在等你了。

记住，如果你心里有鬼的话，风元素领主肯定会一眼看穿的。闭上你的嘴，或许这次见面可以有个好结果。

english.title: Audience with the Windlord
english.objectives: Witness Thunderaan.
english.description:
I have kept my promise. Thunderaan the Windlord awaits.

Know that if betrayal is in your heart, the Windlord will not be deceived. Be silent, and perhaps your audience shall be a fortunate one.

text.title: I Believe I Can Fly!
text.objectives: Collect $1oa Molted Feathers for Snicarus Dungleflight.
text.description: Let's not bother explaining how this happened, just know that I have the plan of all plans to escape this... this... <Looks over his hand-crafted outfit, then quickly glances to a pile of droppings nearby.>$B$BThis place stinks! But you can help!$B$BThese feathers here will help craft my escape plan. If you wouldn't mind, I'm sure there's enough for the both of us!

english.title: I Believe I Can Fly!
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Molted Feathers for Snicarus Dungleflight.
english.description: Let's not bother explaining how this happened, just know that I have the plan of all plans to escape this... this... <Looks over his hand-crafted outfit, then quickly glances to a pile of droppings nearby.>$B$BThis place stinks! But you can help!$B$BThese feathers here will help craft my escape plan. If you wouldn't mind, I'm sure there's enough for the both of us!

text.title: 全力以赴
text.objectives: 激活苏拉玛的所有魔网能量，然后与瓦尔托伊交谈。
text.description:
阿坎多尔正在吸收巨量的能量。

魔网能量已经满负荷运转，但或许依然不够。

我们先来确保连接到沙尔艾兰的所有魔网导管都在运作。

之后我就能设法放大输出，希望能满足这棵贪婪的植物。

english.title: Giving It All We've Got
english.objectives: Activate all of the leyline feeds in Suramar, then speak with Valtrois.
english.description:
The arcan'dor is drawing incredible amounts of energy.

Even with the leyline feed at full capacity, we may not have the power.

Let us first ensure that all potential leyline conduits connecting to Shal'Aran are active.

Then I can attempt to amplify the output and hopefully satisfy this insufferable plant.

text.title: 瞬灭法力风暴发射器
text.objectives: 从时空防御者身上收集$1oa份抗迁跃镀层。
text.description:
欧库勒斯的理论十分可行。是有些不计后果，但可行。

小型迁跃力场能禁锢并激发导管里环境中的法力，并产生和阿坎多尔失衡时类似的法力风暴。

我可以制作能产生迁跃力场的装置，但我需要材料。

具体来说就是抗迁跃合金，比如贵族区高端保安构造体的装甲板。

那些构造体非常难对付。有帮手的话，就都叫上吧。

english.title: Ephemeral Manastorm Projector
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Warp-Resistant Plating from Chronarch Defenders.
english.description:
Oculeth's theory is sound. Reckless, but sound.

A small warp-field could trap and excite ambient mana in the conduit, thus creating a manastorm similar to when the arcan'dor fell out of balance.

I can build a device to generate the warp-field, but I need materials.

Specifically, warp-resistant alloys - such as the armor plating of high-end security constructs in the noble district.

Those constructs are deadly. If anyone owes you a favor, now is the time to call it in.

text.title: 流量控制
text.objectives: 关闭月郡巷、巡游广场和午夜庭院的回廊出口。
text.description:
一切顺利的话，法力风暴能使魔网能量过载，沿着魔法回廊输送一波激增的能量。

为了能让激增的能量到达沙尔艾兰，必须关闭沿途的全部出口。哪怕漏了一处，任务都会失败，溢出的能量会使数百人瞬间汽化。

但愿塔莉萨对这棵树的理解是正确的。

english.title: Flow Control
english.objectives: Seal off the Arcway Outlets in Lunastre Lane, The Parade Grounds, and the Midnight Court.
english.description:
If all goes as planned, the manastorm will cause the leyline to flare up, sending a great surge of energy through the arcway.

In order for the surge to reach Shal'Aran, we must seal off any outlets along the way. If we miss even one, the mission fails - and hundreds of people will be vaporized by the energy blow off.

Thalyssra had better be sure about this tree.

text.title: 道标归途
text.objectives: 利用高级传送道标，调查苏拉玛城中的永月平民区、永月集市和海妖之祈。
text.description:
我们需要的导管在魔法回廊里。自从你上次去过之后，魔法回廊的保安力量已经翻倍。

我们唯一的合理选择就是将你的突击队直接传送进去。

这是一次前往未锚定目的地的远程传送。也就是说，这将会是一项艰巨的任务。

带上这个道标，然后调查苏拉玛城中的平民，之后再把信标交换给我。这样我就能对结果进行分析。

这会让我更加精确地将你传送到导管附近！

english.title: Bring Home the Beacon
english.objectives: Use the Advanced Telemancy Beacon to survey Evermoon Commons, Evermoon Bazaar, and Siren's Vigil in Suramar City.
english.description:
The conduit we need is in the Arcway, and security in the Arcway has doubled since your last visit.

Our only reasonable option is to teleport your strike team directly in. 

This is a long-range teleport to a non-anchored destination. In other words, it will be hard.

Take this beacon and survey the commons in Suramar City, then return the beacon to me so I can analyze the results. 

This will help me teleport you as close as possible to the conduit!

text.title: 孤注一掷
text.objectives: 完成“孤注一掷”场景战役。$B$B首席传送师欧库勒斯可以开启此场景战役。
text.description:
是时候把我们的计划付诸实施了。

欧库勒斯将把你、阿鲁因还有我一起送入魔法回廊。进入后，我们需要在夜流水渠制造一场法力风暴。

瓦尔托伊将会留这里，让沙尔艾兰做好准备，迎接如潮的奥术能量——希望这足以让阿坎多尔满意。

$p……我们这儿有句老话……“领袖总是孤独的”。这句话的意思是，只有那些背负领导重担的人，才会真正懂得这种责任。

感谢你与我同行。其实，我觉得不孤独了。

english.title: All In
english.objectives: Complete the "All In" scenario.$B$BChief Telemancer Oculeth can begin the scenario.
english.description:
It is time to put our plan into action.

Oculeth will send you, Arluin and myself into the Arcway, where we shall trigger a manastorm in the Nightflow Conduit.

Valtrois will stay here and prepare Shal'Aran for a massive jolt of arcane power - hopefully enough to satisfy the arcan'dor.

$p... We have a saying... "To lead is to stand alone." It means only those who bear the weight of leadership can truly appreciate it.

Thank you for standing beside me. In truth, I do not feel alone.

text.title: 阿坎多尔，上古法师的馈赠
text.objectives: 取得阿坎多尔的果实，并交给首席传送师欧库勒斯、奥术师瓦尔托伊，以及首席奥术师塔莉萨。
text.description:
数千年前，当奎尔多雷刚刚开始破解魔法的奥秘时，有一个小小的德鲁伊秘境首次迎来了一位精灵法师。

在银色的月光下，他们组成了一个教派，致力于以自然为载体，将魔法带入平衡。阿坎多尔也由此诞生了。

我的导师们曾经隶属于这个教派。他们早已辞世，但他们的遗产留存了下来。

他们的恩赐能够治愈夏多雷的灵魂。让他们吃下阿坎多尔的果实，并重获新生吧。

english.title: Arcan'dor, Gift of the Ancient Magi
english.objectives: Pick the Fruit of the Arcan'dor and share it with Chief Telemancer Oculeth, Arcanist Valtrois, and First Arcanist Thalyssra.
english.description:
Thousands of years ago, as the Quel'dorei were just beginning to unravel the mysteries of the arcane, a small enclave of druids met with the first of the elven magi.

In the pale moonlight, they formed an order that would seek to bring the arcane into balance - using nature itself as a vessel. Thus the arcan'dor were created.

My masters who belonged to this order have long since faded away. Yet their legacy remains.

Their gift will mend the spirit of the shal'dorei. Let them eat, and be made whole.

text.title: 阿鲁因的请求
text.objectives: 找到奥露乐，并把阿坎多尔的果实交给她。
text.description:
我从没想到我还需要读这种东西……

<凡瑟尔在手中掂量着一个卷轴。>

阿鲁因在……他死去之前……制定好了……计划。虽然不算什么大事，但我还是愿意实现他最后的请求。

<凡瑟尔将卷轴交给了你。>

请前往地图上标注的地点。拿着阿坎多尔的这颗果实，并将它交给一个叫做“奥露乐”的女人。阿鲁因说得十分清楚，他希望把他所有的报酬都直接交给这个女人。

我想他之前已经知道了自己牺牲的意义。我错看他了。

english.title: Arluin's Request
english.objectives: Locate Arluelle and give her a piece of the Arcan'dor Fruit.
english.description:
I never thought I would need to read this...

<Vanthir hefts a scroll in his hand.>

Arluin made... plans... in the event he fell. It is not much, but I would like to honor his last request.

<Vanthir hands you the scroll.>

Go to the location marked on this map. Take this Arcan'dor Fruit and give it to a woman named Arluelle. Arluin was very specific that all rewards for his work be directed to her.

I think he may have known what his sacrifice meant. I was wrong about him.

objectiveDetails.description: 把阿坎多尔的果实交给奥露乐

text.title: 奈萨里奥的巢穴：地底之王的穗带
text.objectives: 从奈萨里奥巢穴中取回地底之王的穗带。
text.description: 你好，死亡领主。虽然多年不见，但对我来说，时间好像只过去了短短几天。$b$b骑士和战马之间的邪恶羁绊不容忽视。力量可以造就更多的力量，死亡领主。千万别忘了这一点！$b$b我可以让骑士和战马建立起牢固的羁绊，但我需要威力强大的媒介。$b$b首先，我需要地底之王的穗带，那是一件代代相传的黑暗萨满饰物。$b$b目前，它在地底之王达古尔手上。

english.title: Neltharion's Lair: Braid of the Underking
english.objectives: Retrieve the Braid of the Underking from Neltharion's Lair.
english.description: Greetings, Deathlord. Years have passed since we first met, but for me it has been mere days.$b$bThe unholy bond between Horseman and steed must not be taken lightly. Power begets power, Deathlord. Never forget this fact!$b$bI can forge an inseparable bond between rider and steed, but components of great power are required.$b$bThe first item I require is the Braid of the Underking, a dark shamanic adornment passed down for generations.$b$bCurrently, it is possessed by Dargrul the Underking.

text.title: 黑心林地：梦魇之鞭
text.objectives: 从黑心林地中取回梦魇之鞭。
text.description: 天启骑士的黑暗战马是残酷而暴虐的不羁生物。我们无法驯服它们……只能征服它们。$b$b我需要的下一件强力媒介生于怨恨，制作于翡翠梦魇。它就是梦魇之鞭。$b$b梦魇之鞭的力量足以消除生物心中的一切希望……和光明。$b$b萨维斯之影就拥有这条鞭子。击败他，然后把鞭子带给我！$b$b我将用它来征服诅咒的战马！

english.title: Darkheart Thicket: The Nightmare Lash
english.objectives: Retrieve the Nightmare Lash from Darkheart Thicket.
english.description: The dark steeds of the apocalypse are indomitable creatures of anguish and cruelty. They can never be tamed... only subjugated.$b$bThe next component of power we require is one born of hatred, fashioned within the Emerald Nightmare. It is known as the Nightmare Lash.$b$bThe Nightmare Lash has the power to suffocate all hope... all light... from within a living soul.$b$bThe Shade of Xavius himself carries the lash. Defeat him and bring the lash to me!$b$bI will use it to dominate the steeds of the damned!

text.title: 战火激烈
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description: 天启四骑士的任务是我们的当务之急，不过我们必须将注意力转向前线。$b$b我们在战场上取得了一系列的胜利，这让燃烧军团极为震惊。因此，他们增加了他们攻击的频率和力度。$b$b我们必须继续进行抵抗，阻止他们更加强力的攻击！$b$b只有这样，我们才有机会将精力再次转到天启四骑士上面。

english.title: Advancing the War Effort
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description: The quest for the Four Horsemen is of the utmost importance, however we must turn our attention to the warfront.$b$bOur continued success on the field of battle has shaken the Burning Legion and as a result, they have increased the frequency and intensity of their assaults.$b$bWe must meet the increased aggression with continued resistance!$b$bOnly then will we be able to turn our attention back to the Four Horsemen.

text.title: 噬魂之喉：亡者之锤
text.objectives: 从冥狱深渊中取回亡者之锤。
text.description: 所有必要的物品都已经集齐了。很快，邪恶的诅咒战马就将踏碎燃烧军团。$b$b不过，我们的工作还没有完成。我们还有一样物品没拿到……$b$b它在冥狱深渊的深处，那是由堕落女王海拉统治的死者的国度。她的手上有一把战锤，被灌注了无数逝去勇者的灵魂之力。$b$b把亡者之锤带来给我，这样我就能打造出刀枪不入的马铠……即使是恶魔也无法伤其分毫！

english.title: Maw of Souls: Maul of the Dead
english.objectives: Retrieve the Maul of the Dead from Helheim.
english.description: All of the necessary components have been gathered together. Soon, the unholy steeds of the damned will trample the armies of the Burning Legion.$b$bHowever, our work is not quite done. One item yet remains beyond our grasp...$b$bLurking within the depths of Helheim, the fallen queen Helya rules over the dead. In her possession is a maul, infused with the souls of countless fallen warriors.$b$bBring to me the Maul of the Dead and with it, I will forge barding so impenetrable... no demon shall break it!

text.title: 重聚避难所
text.objectives: 返回星歌避难所。
text.description:
我没法在这里好好思考。

虽然月亮井纯净依旧，但是梦魇的腐蚀还未完全消褪。

走吧，我们回避难所一起想想办法。然后再继续寻找我的丈夫。

english.title: Regroup at the Refuge
english.objectives: Return to Starsong Refuge.
english.description:
I cannot think clearly in this place.

Even though the moonwell is still pure, the corrupting influence of the Nightmare remains.

Come, we will return to the refuge and gather our wits. Then we will continue the hunt for my husband.

text.title: 占领传送门
text.objectives: 完成任务：调查邪魂堡垒、为我们的到来做好准备、最后的机会。
text.description: 是时候向燃烧军团展开攻势了。$B$B燃烧军团在破碎群岛上设立了很多传送门。$B$B如果你们能在保持传送门开启的情况下扫清那里的敌人，海姆达尔就可以使用你们收集到的符文石对它进行定向，让它通往霍迪尔被困的世界。

english.title: Capturing the Gateway
english.objectives: Complete the missions: Investigate Felsoul Hold, Preparing Our Arrival and Capturing the Gateway.
english.description: The time has come to make our move against the Legion.$B$BThe Legion has multiple portals across the Broken Isles.$B$BShould your armies succeed in securing one while it's still active, Hymdall can use the runestones you gathered to direct it to whatever hellish world Hodir is trapped in.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“为我们的到来做好准备”任务
完成“调查邪魂堡垒”任务

text.title: 耐心的智慧
text.objectives: 等待翡翠梦魇开启，然后向阿苏纳的塞纳苟斯汇报。
text.description: 你在林地里击败的可怕生物仅仅是一个开始。在翡翠梦魇中，你将直面威胁着整个艾泽拉斯的腐化源头。$B$B但现在，时辰还未到。$B$B我们目前还没有找到有效的方法，来突破保护着萨维斯邪恶领地的魔法屏障。不过，一旦我们找到了方法，你就必须尽快赶回这里；有很多工作等待着你去完成。

english.title: The Wisdom of Patience
english.objectives: Await the opening of the Emerald Nightmare, then report back to Senegos in Azsuna.
english.description: The horrors you braved in the thicket are only the beginning. Within the Emerald Nightmare you will face the very heart of the corruption that threatens the stability of all life on Azeroth.$B$BBut not just yet.$B$BWe have not yet managed to permeate the magic protecting Xavius' sinister realm. Once we have, however, you should return here; there is still much to be done.

text.title: “夏”罗纪公园
text.objectives: 骑乘苏伊什并击败$3oa个敌人。
text.description: 我们有一只魔暴龙。$b$b我觉得它把你当成兽群领袖了。它应该会听从你的命令。$b$b它好像饿了。你暂时解开它的缰绳怎么样？

english.title: Shalassic Park
english.objectives: Ride Su'esh and defeat $3oa adversaries.
english.description: We have a Devilsaur.$b$bI think she sees you as the pack leader now. She should obey your commands.$b$bShe looks hungry. Why don't you let her off the leash a little bit?

text.title: 准备大战
text.objectives: 完成“援助瓦尔基拉”、“海上迷航”和“海洋巨人的奴役”任务。
text.description: 在召唤盟友与燃烧军团进行最终决战之前，我们先得好好地壮大一下自己的军队。$B$B破碎群岛这里还有很多事情需要我们处理，而我们在这里取得的一个又一个胜利，也将成为我们战胜敌人的动力。

english.title: Preparing For War
english.objectives: Complete "Aiding the Valkyra," "Lost at Sea" and "Enslaved by Sea Giants" missions.
english.description: We would do well to bolster our own forces before calling upon our allies to join us in the final conflict against the Legion.$B$BThere still remains much to do in the Broken Isles and victories there will give us the momentum we need to crush the enemy.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“海洋巨人的奴役”任务
完成“援助瓦尔基拉”任务

text.title: 噬魂之喉：震慑海拉
text.objectives: 在地下城“噬魂之喉”中击败海拉。
text.description: 在腹背受敌的情况下我们毫无胜算。$B$B要在对抗燃烧军团时有回旋的余地，就必须在与海拉的战斗中取得决定性的胜利。我们的大敌不是她的军队，也不是她的军官，而是冥狱之母本人。$B$B前往噬魂之喉并击败海拉，$n。

english.title: Maw of Souls: Message to Helya
english.objectives: Defeat Helya inside the Maw of Souls dungeon.
english.description: We cannot fight on two fronts and succeed.$B$BIf we're to give ourselves the room we need to fight off the Legion we need to deliver a decisive victory against Helya. Not her armies, not her lieutenants, but the mother of the underworld herself.$B$BGo to the Maw of Souls and defeat Helya, $n.

text.title: 魔网能量：艾洛珊
text.objectives: 向魔网能量注入远古魔力。
text.description: <魔网能量似乎是完好无损的，但却毫无反应。或许远古魔力可以让它再次运行？>
text.end: 向魔网能量注入远古魔力。

english.title: Leyline Feed: Elor'shan
english.objectives: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.
english.description: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>
english.end: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.

text.title: 魔网能量：凯尔巴洛
text.objectives: 防守魔网能量并注入远古魔力。
text.description: <这里的魔网供给似乎需要吸收魔网能量才能正常运作。$b$b虽然你可以用魔力灌注其中，但得需要好几分钟的时间才能注入足够的魔力。$b$b要小心，这里的生物可能会注意到奥术能量的涌动……>
text.end: 保护魔网能量并注入远古魔力。

english.title: Leyline Feed: Kel'balor
english.objectives: Defend the Leyline Feed and infuse it with Ancient Mana.
english.description: <This feed appears to draw power from the leyline in order to become fully operational.$b$bYou should be able to imbue it with mana, but it will take a few minutes to draw enough leyline energy to accept the infusion.$b$bBeware, for creatures may notice the surge of arcane energy...>
english.end: Defend the Leyline Feed and infuse it with Ancient Mana.

text.title: 魔网能量：月落魔网节点
text.objectives: 找到破损的魔力圆盘并修复魔网能量。
text.description: <这个魔网能量已经受损。顶部的大型收集器坏掉了。$b$b它的碎片应该就在这附近。地板上有着粗糙的摩擦痕迹，留下这痕迹的东西似乎比此处室内的生物要大。$b$b而且，要大很多。>
text.end: 找到破损的魔力圆盘并修复魔网能量。

english.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Moonfall
english.objectives: Find the Broken Leydar Dish and repair the leyline feed.
english.description: <This leyline feed appears to be damaged. The large collector at the top is broken.$b$bThe broken piece must be around here somewhere. There are rough scuff marks on the floor that appear to be made by something larger than the creatures inside.$b$bMuch, much larger.>
english.end: Find the Broken Leydar Dish and repair the leyline feed.

text.title: 魔网能量：安瑟纳尔魔网节点
text.objectives: 收集6块魔网能量碎片，并向魔网能量注入远古魔力。
text.description: <这个魔网已经损坏了，需要修复才能使用。$b$b一些主要的大型部件不见了，奥术能量在这些缝隙中噼啪作响。$b$b附近的元素生物在走动时似乎卷起了一些残片，还把它们吸进了自己的身体里。也许它们的体内就有失踪的部件……>
text.end: 收集6块魔网能量碎片，并向魔网能量注入远古魔力。

english.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Aethenar
english.objectives: Collect 6 Leyline Feed Fragments and infuse the feed with ancient mana.
english.description: <This leyline appears to be damaged and needs repair.$b$bSeveral large chunks of the main column are missing and arcane energy is crackling in the gaps.$b$bThe elementals nearby seem to pick up debris and absorb it into their bodies as they move around. Maybe they have the missing pieces...>
english.end: Collect 6 Leyline Feed Fragments and infuse the feed with ancient mana.

text.title: 魔网能量：法兰纳尔隧道
text.objectives: 向魔网能量注入远古魔力。
text.description: <魔网能量似乎是完好无损的，但却毫无反应。或许远古魔力可以让它再次运行？>
text.end: 向魔网能量注入远古魔力。

english.title: Leyline Feed: Falanaar Arcway
english.objectives: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.
english.description: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>
english.end: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.

text.title: 魔网能量：法兰纳尔隧道深处
text.objectives: 向魔网能量注入远古魔力。
text.description: <魔网能量似乎是完好无损的，但却毫无反应。或许远古魔力可以让它再次运行？>
text.end: 向魔网能量注入远古魔力。

english.title: Leyline Feed: Falanaar Depths
english.objectives: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.
english.description: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>
english.end: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.

text.title: 魔网能量：日蚀大厅
text.objectives: 向魔网能量注入远古魔力。
text.description: <魔网能量似乎是完好无损的，但却毫无反应。或许远古魔力可以让它再次运行。>
text.end: 向魔网能量注入远古魔力。

english.title: Leyline Feed: Halls of the Eclipse
english.objectives: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.
english.description: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>
english.end: Infuse the leyline feed with Ancient Mana.

text.title: 缅怀英雄
text.objectives: 在冥口浅湾从克瓦迪尔身上收集8把古代蔑潮刀剑。
text.description:
海拉想抢夺的不止灵魂，而她手下的克瓦迪尔也很渴望取悦他们的女主人。

他们的战利品里有珍贵的刀剑，这些刀剑属于战死的英雄，他们生前曾经英勇地对抗海拉。这些刀剑应该存放在可供人们瞻仰的地方，而不是落在他们这帮邪恶之徒手里。

为了蔑潮的荣耀，夺回刀剑！

english.title: To Honor the Fallen
english.objectives: Collect 8 Ancient Tideskorn Blades from the kvaldir in Helmouth Shallows.
english.description:
Souls are not the only plunder Helya craves, and the kvaldir are ever eager to please.

Among their spoils are the venerable blades of fallen heroes who dared stand against Helya's minions. These blades belong in a place of honor, not among their wretched kind.

Reclaim the blades, for the honor of the Tideskorn!

text.title: 刺破迷雾
text.objectives: 在地下城“噬魂之喉”中击败海拉，之后回瓦狄斯丹找哈维。
text.description:
在遥远的过去，纳格法尔号曾是海拉舰队中的瑰宝。看来它至今仍在为海拉效力。

现在，这艘可怕的舰船在灵魂之海上航行，在生者看不到的迷雾中穿梭。克瓦迪尔肯定有办法召唤她，你得查个究竟。

找到纳格法尔号的停泊之处，然后登上去，摧毁这艘可怕的舰船，蔑潮的灵魂就能得到救赎。

english.title: Piercing the Mists
english.objectives: Defeat Helya in the Maw of Souls dungeon, then return to Havi in Valdisdall
english.description:
In a time before memory, the Naglfar was the prize of Helya's fleet. It would seem that it has lived on to serve her once more.

Now, the dread ship sails the sea of souls, and cuts through the mist unseen by the living. The kvaldir must have a way to summon her, and this is what you must seek.

Find her berth and board the Naglfar. Put an end to the dread ship, and the souls of the Tideskorn may be redeemed.

text.title: 突袭守望高塔：黑鹰堡垒

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭吉尔尼斯旅的队长
消灭吉尔尼斯旅的狼人

text.title: 突袭守望高塔：黑鹰堡垒
突袭守望高塔：风语堡垒

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭吉尔尼斯旅的队长
消灭吉尔尼斯旅的狼人

text.title: 突袭守望高塔：风语堡垒
噬魂之喉：伊米隆的断剑
text.objectives: 返回苍穹要塞说服奥丁复活伊米隆国王.
text.description: 你握着伊米隆国王之剑，心想要是这名勇猛无匹的战士能加入你的阵营那就太好了。$B$B也许你可以说服奥丁，让他强迫这位维库人国王的灵魂与你的军队并肩作战。

english.title: Maw of Souls: Ymiron's Broken Blade
english.objectives: Return to Skyhold and convince Odyn to raise King Ymiron.
english.description: You hold King Ymiron's blade and realize what a fierce combatant he would make, were he to fight on your side.$B$BPerhaps Odyn could be persuaded to force the vrykul King's spirit to fight along your army.

text.title: Needs of the Many
text.objectives: Take the portal from Dalaran over Karazhan to Dalaran in the Broken Isles.
text.description: [THIS IS A TEMPORARY QUEST TO GET YOU TO DALARAN IN THE BROKEN ISLES.]$b$bPlease take this portal to Dalaran in the Broken Isles and begin your artifact quest!

english.title: Needs of the Many
english.objectives: Take the portal from Dalaran over Karazhan to Dalaran in the Broken Isles.
english.description: [THIS IS A TEMPORARY QUEST TO GET YOU TO DALARAN IN THE BROKEN ISLES.]$b$bPlease take this portal to Dalaran in the Broken Isles and begin your artifact quest!

objectiveDetails.description: General Tel'arn and Ranger General Feleor slain

text.title: 利斧的秘密
text.objectives: 在破碎群岛寻找最强大的持斧战士。
text.description:
战争领主，我有一个请求。帮我找找灵感！我需要一把由世上最强大的战士所持有的久经考验的战斧。他们经受过无数战斗的洗礼，达到了人斧合一的境界。

找到这名英雄和他的武器，并说服他们来我们这里。

english.title: Secrets of the Axes
english.objectives: Search the Broken Isles for the greatest axe wielding warrior you know.
english.description:
Battlelord, I have a request. Find me inspiration! An axe whose form has seen a truly astounding amount of battle, wielded by one of the world's most powerful warriors. Both weapon and owner forged together in the crucible of war.

Find this hero and their weapon, and convince them to come here.

objectiveDetails.description: 与海尔加以及萨鲁法尔交谈

text.title: 深入海底
text.objectives: 跟埃鲁纳克一起前往瓦丝琪尔废墟。
text.description: 我向你保证，传说千真万确：莎拉达尔，潮汐权杖是用永恒之井的活水铸造而成的。它赋予了艾萨拉统治生命的能力。我派出萨满在世界各地寻找它，但是唯一一个发现线索的人却失踪了。$b$b波涛语者安德莉说她追踪权杖的踪迹进入了瓦丝琪尔废墟。可之后我们就再也没收到她的消息。$b$b$n！跟我一起深入海底，寻找那个失踪的萨满并取得神器吧！

english.title: To the Deeps
english.objectives: Travel to the Ruins of Vashj'ir with Erunak.
english.description: I assure you the legends are true: Sharas'dal, the Scepter of Tides, was forged around living waters of the Well of Eternity. It gave Azshara dominion over life itself. I have sent shaman throughout the world looking for it, but the only one to ever find it has gone missing.$b$bWavespeaker Adelee said she had tracked the scepter to the Ruins of Vashj'ir, but we haven't heard from her since.$b$b$n! Come with me to the ocean depths. Let's track down our missing shaman and get that artifact!

objectiveDetails.description: 跟埃鲁纳克一起前往瓦丝琪尔

text.title: 波涛语者的踪迹
text.objectives: 在瓦丝琪尔废墟找到与波涛语者安德莉下落有关的三个线索。
text.description: 我们要找的萨满名叫波涛语者安德莉，她为了寻找权杖来到了这片古老的废墟。根据她的报告，纳迦的军队在军团入侵之间就在这里集结了。$b$b她在发出找到莎拉达尔，潮汐权杖的消息之后就失去了音信。$b$b$n，到废墟下层去寻找她的下落吧。务必要当心纳迦的巡逻部队！

english.title: Wavespeaker's Trail
english.objectives: Locate three clues to the whereabouts of Wavespeaker Adelee within the Ruins of Vashj'ir.
english.description: The shaman we seek is Wavespeaker Adelee. Her research brought her down to these ancient ruins, where she reported naga armies amassing prior to the Legion invasion.$b$bThe last I had heard, she had located Sharas'dal, the Scepter of Tides - and then she went silent.$b$b$n, Search for clues to her whereabouts among the lower level of the ruins. Beware the naga patrols!

text.title: 第四骑士
text.objectives: 寻找第四骑士。
text.description: 巫妖王的要求太过分了！提里奥·弗丁戎马一生，死后不应该再化为亡灵，继续遭受痛苦！$b$b我得告诉你，死亡领主……我遵从您的意愿，但我们接下来要做的事情，一旦开始，就没有回头路了。$b$b白银之手绝不会乖乖把提里奥交给我们。第四骑士的崛起之路会洒满义人的鲜血！$b$b我们永远也无法洗刷掉这种罪孽。$b$b你的意愿必将实现，死亡领主。我要开始为入侵圣光之愿做准备了。如果这就是拯救世界的代价，那就来吧！

english.title: The Fourth Horseman
english.objectives: Obtain the Fourth Horseman.
english.description: The Lich King demands too much! Tirion Fordring deserves more than a life of anguish and undeath!$b$bKnow this, Deathlord... I will obey your will, but there will be no redemption for what we are about to do.$b$bThe Silver Hand will never hand Tirion to us. The path to the Fourth Horseman will be soaked in righteous blood!$b$bBlood that will stain our hands forever.$b$bYour will be done, Deathlord. I will begin the preparations to invade Light's Hope. If this is what it takes to save our world, so be it!

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

objectiveDetails.description: 完成圣光之愿场景战役

text.title: 暗影之行
text.objectives: 前往破碎群岛上方的阿彻鲁斯，寻求黑锋骑士的帮助。
text.description: 如果要将碎片的力量注入灰烬使者，我们需要帮助。我们无法掌控这种黑暗的魔法；但我知道谁可以……$B$B黑锋骑士。$B$B我马上为你安排前往阿彻鲁斯的飞行，到那里再碰头——你准备好之后，就去达拉然找奥鲁丹·白云。

english.title: Walking in Shadows
english.objectives: Seek the aid of the Knights of the Ebon Blade in Acherus above the Broken Isles.
english.description: If we are to infuse the shard's power into the Ashbringer we will need help. We cannot wield such dark magic; however, I know who can...$B$BThe Knights of the Ebon Blade.$B$BI will commission a flight for you to Acherus at once and meet you there - find Aludane Whitecloud in Dalaran when you are ready.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: 接受天启四骑士的协助

text.title: 圣光勇士
text.objectives: 请倾听白银之手骑士团为您献上的欢呼。
text.description: 今天我们齐聚于此，共同欢庆对阵燃烧军团的胜利。大领主，请一道加入我们吧。

english.title: Warriors of Light
english.objectives: Listen as you are honored by the Order of the Silver Hand.
english.description: We have gathered to celebrate our victory over the Burning Legion this day. Highlord, please join us.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 流明石
text.objectives: 派遣勇士在“流明石”系列任务中收集50个流明石。
text.description: 为了面对今后的战斗，我们需要准备好盔甲和武器。$B$B我们发现了一种叫做流明石的稀有金属，可以抵挡魔法……甚至是邪能魔法。$B$B破碎群岛各地都可以发现少量的流明石，它们被当地的居民用来冶金。$B$B我们应该派勇士锁定破碎群岛的敌人——他们应该储备了大量流明石。

english.title: Lumenstone
english.objectives: Collect 50 Lumenstone by sending champions on "Lumenstone" missions.
english.description: To prepare for the battle ahead, we will need armor and weapons.$B$BWe have learned of lumenstone, a rare metal that can negate magic... even fel magic.$B$BIt is found in small quantities all over the Broken Isles, and many of the native races use it in their own metalcrafting.$B$BWe should send our champions to target enemies around the Broken Isles - there should be plenty of lumenstone to be found in their stockpiles.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 世界守护者
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description: 破碎群岛的四处都在请求我们的援助，大领主。$B$B我知道我们正在支援虚空之光神殿的牧师，但其他人也需要我们的帮助。$B$B我们也不能对他们面临的问题视而不见。

english.title: Defenders of the World
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description: Requests are pouring in from across the Broken Isles for our aid, Highlord.$B$BI know that we are working to aid the priests at Netherlight Temple, but there are many others who need our help.$B$BWe cannot turn our backs on those who need our aid.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 黑暗曙光
text.objectives: 通过达拉然的牧师传送门前往虚空之光神殿，守住神殿并击败巴纳扎尔。
text.description: 大领主，你终于来了，感谢上苍！对虚空之光神殿的入侵已经开始了。$B$B我们的部队正在传送门的另一边等着我们。$B$B和他们汇合，然后我们将收紧巴纳扎尔周围的包围圈。

english.title: A Light in the Darkness
english.objectives: Go to Netherlight Temple using the priest's portal in Dalaran, then defend Netherlight Temple and slay Lord Balnazzar.
english.description: Highlord, thank goodness you've arrived! The invasion of Netherlight Temple has begun.$B$BOur forces are already waiting on the other side of the portal.$B$BJoin them, and we will close the trap around Lord Balnazzar.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: 完成保卫虚空之光神殿场景战役
使用达拉然的传送门前往虚空之光神殿

text.title: 软化目标
text.objectives: 骑乘驯服的夜翼蝠在沙拉尼尔杀掉50只梦魇生物。
text.description: 这位大德鲁伊的末路即将来临。他的记忆将活在我们所有认识他的人心中。$b$b埃洛瑟尔在绝望的挣扎中指明，玛法里奥被囚禁在沙拉尼尔，陷入莎拉达希尔根须之中。$b$b我的爱人。离我如此之近，又如此遥远……$b$b沙拉尼尔里梦魇生物横行。贸然冲进去无异于自杀。$b$b我驯服了一只萨维斯的造物。用它来对付他，$n，并为我们清出一条道路。
text.completion: This place remains deadly, but we can now press forward.

english.title: Softening the Target
english.objectives: Slay 50 Nightmare Creatures in Shala'nir riding the Subdued Nightwing.
english.description: The Archdruid's end draws near. His memory will live on in the hearts of all who knew him.$b$bElothir's desperate efforts revealed that Malfurion is being held in Shala'nir, amidst the roots of Shaladrassil.$b$bMy love. So near, yet so far....$b$bShala'nir is infested with Nightmare creatures. To rush in would be suicide.$b$bI subdued one of Xavius' creatures. Use it against him, $n and clear us a path.
english.completion: This place remains deadly, but we can now press forward.

text.title: 努波顿的背水一战
text.objectives: 保护预言者努波顿，抵御燃烧军团的袭击。
text.description: 埃索达人为燃烧军团的到来而感到震惊。我们还没来得及反应，恶魔就冲进了我们的居所，将挡路的一切都屠戮殆尽。如果不是有先知在，我们可能在第一波袭击中就全灭了。$B$B我当时负责水晶大厅的撤离任务，随后就和大部队失散了。$B$B我们撤到了这个倒塌的大厅里，组织起我们最后的防御。$B$B现在有了你的帮助，我们或许能够活过这次入侵。
text.completion: You have my thanks, and the gratitude of the Broken, hero. Many would have considered us an acceptable loss, yet you have shown us great compassion and kindness. An act that I - we - will not soon forget.$B$BNow we will return to the Vault of Lights and assist Velen as best we can.
text.end: 保护预言者努波顿，抵御燃烧军团的袭击。

english.title: Nobundo's Last Stand
english.objectives: Defend Farseer Nobundo from the Legion Assault.
english.description: The Exodar shook from the force of the Legion's arrival. Before we could react, demons were running rampant through the halls, slaughtering everything in their path. If it were not for the Prophet, we would have all perished in the initial assault.$B$BI was charged with evacuating the Crystal Hall, which is when my Broken and I were separated from the main force.$B$BWe fell back into the collapsed hall to make our last stand.$B$BWith your aid, we may survive this invasion.
english.completion: You have my thanks, and the gratitude of the Broken, hero. Many would have considered us an acceptable loss, yet you have shown us great compassion and kindness. An act that I - we - will not soon forget.$B$BNow we will return to the Vault of Lights and assist Velen as best we can.
english.end: Defend Farseer Nobundo from the Legion Assault

objectiveDetails.description: 与努波顿交谈以开始进攻

text.title: Black Rook Hold: The Mad Arcanist

english.title: Black Rook Hold: The Mad Arcanist
Black Rook Hold: Worst of the Worst

text.title: 勇士：马迪亚斯·肖尔大师
Hitting the Books
text.objectives: Start a Research Work Order.
text.description:
$gSir:Mam;, my head would be in a book whether I was supported by the Tirisgarde or not... but my means are limited. Learning more about this weapon of yours is critical to the fight against the Legion, I know it.

If you want more researchers on the job to turn out results faster, we'll need to supply the resources to keep them going.

I promise you it will be worth every minute.

english.title: Hitting the Books
english.objectives: Start a Research Work Order.
english.description:
$gSir:Mam;, my head would be in a book whether I was supported by the Tirisgarde or not... but my means are limited. Learning more about this weapon of yours is critical to the fight against the Legion, I know it.

If you want more researchers on the job to turn out results faster, we'll need to supply the resources to keep them going.

I promise you it will be worth every minute.

text.title: 战斗的召唤
text.objectives: 与海姆达尔交谈。
text.description: 从前，泰坦铸造的奥杜尔的守护者和奥丁是关系紧密的盟友。自从奥丁脱离出来并创造了瓦拉加尔以后，就连他的亲生儿子托里姆都不再听从他的命令。$B$B不过，苍穹要塞与奥杜尔仍有联手的希望。$B$B奥丁在脱离之前，曾把迦拉尔之角赐给了海姆达尔。奥杜尔的守护者们受到誓言的束缚，必须在在迦拉尔之角响起时回应召唤，因为那预示着末日的来临！

english.title: The Call of Battle
english.objectives: Speak to Hymdall.
english.description: Once, the mighty titanforged keepers of Ulduar and Odyn acted as one. Ever since Odyn broke off to create the valarjar, not even Odyn's own son Thorim is bound to follow his father's advice.$B$BThere is one hope to unite the forces of Skyhold and Ulduar however.$B$BThe Gjallarhorn was a gift given to Hymdall before Odyn's departure. The keepers of Ulduar are oathbound to answer the call of the Gjallarhorn were it to be sounded as it would signal that the end times are upon us!

text.title: 援助教团
text.objectives: 回到虚空之光神殿的阿隆索斯·法奥处。
text.description: 教团的牧师是我们强有力的盟友。如果我们齐心协力，我们就有机会彻底消灭那个恐惧魔王。告诉阿隆索斯·法奥，我们永远会站在你这边。只要你需要我们，我们就整装待发。

english.title: Aiding the Conclave
english.objectives: Return to Alonsus Faol within Netherlight Temple.
english.description:
The priests of the Conclave are formidable allies. With our combined strength, we may just have a chance to slay the dreadlord, forever.

Let Alonsus Faol know that we will be by your side and ready to fight when you need us.

text.title: 破碎海滩之战
text.objectives: 与第三舰队汇合。
text.description:
第三舰队已经在我们之前启航了，$n。这只狮鹫会带你与舰队汇合。

祝你好运。显然，燃烧军团不会让我们好过，只能希望一切都在瓦里安国王的掌握之中。

english.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
english.objectives: Rendezvous with the third fleet.
english.description:
The third fleet has shipped out ahead of us, $n. This gryphon will bring you to them.

Good luck out there. It's clear the Legion isn't going to make this easy, but let's hope King Varian has matters well in hand.

text.title: 月之守卫传送门启动！
text.objectives: 将远古魔力注入传送道标。
text.description: <传送道标并没有激活，但至少完好无损。只要一些远古魔力就能让它重新启动。>
text.end: 使用远古魔力，重新启动传送道标。

english.title: Moon Guard Teleporter Online!
english.objectives: Infuse the Telemancy Beacon with Ancient Mana.
english.description: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>
english.end: Use Ancient Mana to reactivate the Telemancy Beacon.

english.end: Use Ancient Mana to reactivate the Telemancy Beacon.

text.title: 直入正题
text.objectives: 进入大步道，消灭$1oa个卫兵。
text.description: 先说要紧事吧，$n：我们得建立营地。$b$b我们没有时间和资源来打旷日持久的攻城战。我们也不可能把他们耗到弹尽粮绝。我们只能像箭矢一样，迅疾如风，一击穿心。$b$b他们在城里设置了越来越多的防线，而我们在设立自己的防线时，却可能会受到他们的攻击。$b$b到前线去，让他们看看，拥有数千年战争经验的卡多雷是多么骁勇善战。找出他们的弱点，攻其不备。

english.title: Down to Business
english.objectives: Enter the Grand Promenade and slay $1oa defenders.
english.description: First things first, $n: we must set up our camp.$b$bWe do not have the time or resources for a prolonged siege. It is not like we can starve them out. No, we must be swift and sure as an arrow, piercing their heart in one strike.$b$bThey are drawing up their battle lines within the city, but could attack us while we are setting up our defenses.$b$bVenture forth and show them what the kaldorei have learned from thousands of years of war. Discover their weaknesses so that we may exploit them.

text.title: 月郡庄园传送门启动！
text.objectives: 将远古魔力注入传送道标。
text.description: <传送道标并没有激活，但至少完好无损。只要一些远古魔力就能让它重新启动。>
text.end: 使用远古魔力，重新启动传送道标。

english.title: Lunastre Estate Teleporter Online!
english.objectives: Infuse the Telemancy Beacon with Ancient Mana.
english.description: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>
english.end: Use Ancient Mana to reactivate the Telemancy Beacon.

text.title: 直入正题
text.objectives: 进入大步道，消灭$1oa个卫兵。
text.description: 该干正事了，$n。我们一分一秒都耽搁不起。$b$b虽然我们不打算进行长期的消耗战，但还得有个战争营地之类的地方。在我们修建工事时，夜之子肯定不会躲在城市里面，什么都不做。$b$b他们也开始修建自己的防线了。去看看他们都在干什么。在我们进行最后的准备时，你可以从内部攻击他们。

english.title: Down to Business
english.objectives: Enter the Grand Promenade and slay $1oa defenders.
english.description: Time to get to business, $n. We cannot afford to tarry.$b$bWhile we are not setting up for a prolonged engagement, we must still have a war camp of some sorts. I do not expect the Nightborne to stay patiently in their city while we plant stakes.$b$bThey are starting to build their defenses. Go in there and see what we are up against. You will strike them from within while we finalize our preparations.

text.title: 秩序大殿的传送器已经接通！
text.objectives: 将远古魔力注入传送道标。
text.description: <传送道标并没有激活，但至少完好无损。只要一些远古魔力就能让它重新启动。>
text.end: 使用远古魔力，重新启动传送道标。

english.end: Use Ancient Mana to reactivate the Telemancy Beacon.

text.title: Hidden History
text.objectives: Use the scouting notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes Holt needs to begin research on your artifact.
text.description:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it.

If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can help with that.

Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes. They may be hard to procure. I asked one of the scouts to seek them out, here are her notes.

english.objectives: Use the scouting notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes Holt needs to begin research on your artifact.

text.title: Hidden History
text.objectives: Use the scouting notes to locate and recover the 4 ancient tomes Fjornson needs to begin research on your artifact.
text.description:
You wield ancient steel, strengthened by magics we barely understand.

If you truly want to unlock the potential of your weapons, you need to know more of how they were forged, and of the battles they've fought in. I can help with this.

Your races use books to store their histories, and I will need some of these to piece together the legend of your steel. I asked one of your followers to look into their locations for me. Here are her notes.

text.title: 黑白间谍
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“谍战风云”任务。
text.description:
军情七处是联盟的谍报机构。他们的总部设于暴风城，领导者是马迪亚斯·肖尔大师。最近，他们的活动可以说是相当怪异。

我希望你能派人去调查一下情况。或许只是我想太多了，不过我不喜欢这种不清不楚的感觉。

如果我们想战胜燃烧军团，就要尽力避免任何意外。

english.title: Spy vs. Spy
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Spy vs. Spy".
english.description:
SI:7 is the espionage and intel branch of the Alliance. They are based out of Stormwind City and headed up by Master Mathias Shaw. As of late, they have been acting, shall we say, peculiar.

I would like for you to send some of our people out to assess the situation. It might be nothing, but I am not fond of situations that I do not fully understand.

If we are going to win this war against the Burning Legion, the last thing we need is for something wholly unexpected to occur.

text.title: 药剂援助
text.objectives: 为阿隆索斯·法奥收集制作药剂的材料。
text.description: 花多少精力备战都不算过分。燃烧军团随时有可能来袭，而我们必须准备好承受大量的伤亡。$B$B扎布拉和雅丽亚向我提供了一份清单，上面列举了他们可以制作的强力药水和战斗药剂，包括回复生命、致盲敌人等多个种类。$B$B我们需要一大串的材料，才能制作大量的必需补给品。

english.title: Elixirs of Aid
english.objectives: Collect elixir crafting ingredients for Alonsus Faol.
english.description: We can never be too prepared for battle. The Legion will strike at any moment, and we must be ready to deal with a multitude of injuries and afflictions.$B$BZabra and Yalia have provided me a list of their most potent potions and battle elixirs than can do everything from restore health to blind the enemy.$B$BWe have an exhaustive list of ingredients that we'll need in order to craft a respectable supply.

text.title: Tracking Quest: Tutorial - Combat Ally Unlocked

english.title: Tracking Quest: Tutorial - Combat Ally Unlocked

text.title: 说服老扬希
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成任务“说服老扬希”。
text.description:
慢着！我们这群海盗已经很久没有招募新人了。

<“咸饼干”突然大叫了起来，以示认同。>

我刚好知道一个合适的人选。

没错，我说的正是老好人扬希·格里尔森。他是住在荆棘谷的一个老水手。

赶紧派你的几个小弟去把他揪过来吧。

english.title: Convincin' Old Yancey
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Convincin' Old Yancey".
english.description:
Avast ye! Th' time be long overdue that we get some more pirate blood into our ranks.

<Crackers gives a sudden squawk in agreement.>

And I know just th' man t' do it.

I'm talkin' about good old Yancey Grillsen, o' course. He's an old salt down Stranglethorn way.

Send some o' your land lovin' scallywags off t' round him up.

text.title: 不断壮大
text.objectives: 与传教士伊丽扎谈一谈。
text.description:
你成为领袖的消息迅速地散播了开来。各式各样的牧师来到了神殿施以援助。

能得到传教士伊丽扎的赏识，我们真是交了好运。她可是实实在在的领袖，手下有无数信徒愿意为她赴汤蹈火。

现在，去和她谈谈吧。

english.title: Recruiting More Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Vicar Eliza.
english.description:
Word of your leadership has spread rather fast. Priests of all sorts have traveled to the temple to lend their aid.

We're lucky enough to have caught the eye of Vicar Eliza. She's quite the leader in her own right, commanding countless devotees that do her bidding without question. 

Speak to her now.

text.title: 棒小伙与海盗
text.objectives: 与你的海盗征募官扬希·格里尔森谈一谈。
text.description:
没错，扬希现在是我们的船员，我很开心。

<特塞斯从桌上拿了些干果喂给“咸饼干”吃。>

不如你也帮个忙，去看看他能不能帮我们召集一些鼠辈。

english.title: Fancy Lads and Buccaneers
english.objectives: Speak with your Pirate recruiter, Yancey Grillsen.
english.description:
Aye, it warms me heart t' know that Yancey's now part o' th' crew.

<Tethys feeds Crackers some cackle fruit from the table.>

Why don't you be a good $g lad:lass; and see if he can sponge us up some bilge rats.

text.title: Hitting the Books
text.objectives: Start a Research Work Order.
text.description:
Any death knight worth their salt knows the weapon they wield as if they were born with it.  But you now carry a weapon older than any in this hall.

If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

text.title: 书籍研究
text.objectives: 开始一项研究工作的订单。
text.description:
没有吹毛断发的利刃，恶魔猎手就不值一提。但你手中那对战刃比你还要古老……并且具有我们尚无法理解的力量。

如果你真要解放它全部的潜力，就得更了解它。想要全部浏览、翻译并得出有价值的成果的话，需要大量的时间，我一个人也无法担此重任。

我们应该优先抽调一部分组织的资源来进行此项研究。我向你保证，我们付出的每一丝努力都不会被白费。

english.title: Hitting the Books
english.objectives: Start a Research Work Order.
english.description:
A demon hunter is nothing without blades with which to cut flesh. Yet those you wield are older than even you... and have power we don't understand yet.

If you truly want to unlock all of their potential, we need to learn more about them. It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

text.title: 书籍研究
text.objectives: 开始一项研究工作的订单。
text.description:
你拥有一件古老而强大的武器。但我们并不了解它。如果我们真要解放它全部的潜力，就得更了解它。我可以帮你。

但想要全部浏览、翻译并得出有价值的成果的话，需要大量的时间，我一个人也无法担此重任。

我们应该优先抽调一部分组织的资源来进行此项研究。我向你保证，我们付出的每一丝努力都不会被白费。

It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this. We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

text.title: 准备行动
text.objectives: 与沙尔艾兰的大法师卡雷会面。
text.description: 多亏了你不知疲倦的努力，辛艾萨莉之心已经准备好承接燃烧军团的力量。$B$B从我们旅程开始的那一刻，我们的终点就一直刺眼地占据着我们的视野——暗夜要塞，现在的那里已经完全变成了古尔丹的巢穴。$B$B在我们进攻要塞之前，我们应该重新集结起沙尔艾兰的月之守卫们。我们仍然需要他们的力量，我也敢肯定，他们和曾经的兄弟姐妹们有一笔旧账要算。

english.title: Preparing to Move
english.objectives: Meet Archmage Kalec in Shal'Aran.
english.description: Thanks to your tireless efforts the Heart of Zin-Azshari is ready to withstand the full power of the Legion.$B$BThe final destination in our journey has stood defiantly in front of us from the moment we began - the Nighthold, now home to none other than Gul'dan himself.$B$BBefore we move on the hold, we should reunite with the Moon Guard in Shal'Aran - we still have need of their skills, and I would wager that they have unfinished business with their former brothers and sisters.

text.title: 诅咒战马
text.objectives: 完成5个“堕落战马”系列任务。
text.description: 骑手萨拉纳尔已经从暗影界来到黑锋要塞。他拥有渊博的知识和强大的力量，可以召唤天启四骑士的战马。$b$b萨拉纳尔给了我们第一份清单，列出了召唤战马的必要物品。我已经安排了一大堆任务，以便取得这些东西。$b$b使用任务台并派遣你的勇士执行任务吧。

english.title: Steeds of the Damned
english.objectives: Complete 5 "Fallen Steeds" missions.
english.description: Salanar the Horseman has arrived at Ebon Hold from the Realm of Shadows. He alone has the knowledge and power to conjure the steeds of the Four Horsemen.$b$bSalanar has given us the first list of necessary components to create the steeds. I have organized a number of missions to obtain these items.$b$bUse the mission table to assign your chosen champions to the task.

text.title: 深入梦魇：塞纳留斯的堕落
text.objectives: 击败翡翠梦魇的塞纳留斯。
text.description: 我们都知道，梦魇会扭曲现实和梦境之间的边界，毫无疑问，这会对我们造成威胁。我们的盟友已经堕入了黑暗。

english.title: Into the Nightmare: Fall of Cenarius
english.objectives: Defeat Cenarius in the Emerald Nightmare.
english.description: While we know that the Nightmare bends the boundary between reality and dream, there is no doubt of the threat upon us. Our own allies have fallen into darkness.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 深入梦魇：萨维斯
text.objectives: 击败翡翠梦魇的萨维斯。
text.description: 是时候清除梦魇的根源并让翡翠梦境重归平衡了。深入梦魇之心，并战胜梦魇之王萨维斯。

english.title: Into the Nightmare: Xavius
english.objectives: Defeat Xavius in the Emerald Nightmare.
english.description: The time has come to tackle the source of the Nightmare, and restore balance to the Emerald Dream. Battle into the heart of the Nightmare, and face the Nightmare Lord Xavius.

text.title: 暗夜要塞：高级植物学家特尔安
text.objectives: 在暗夜要塞消灭高级植物学家特尔安。
text.description: 夜之子所擅长的魔法可不止一种。我们很有可能在暗夜要塞内遭遇强大的敌人。如果我们想要打倒古尔丹，我们就必须先消灭暗夜要塞中强大的法师和战士。

english.title: The Nighthold: High Botanist Tel'arn
english.objectives: Kill High Botanist Tel'arn in The Nighthold.
english.description: The Nightborne are adept in more than one kind of magic, and we will likely face formidable foes inside the walls of the Nighthold. Their strongest mages and warriors must fall before we can hope to face Gul'dan.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 暗夜要塞：艾利桑德
text.objectives: 在暗夜要塞消灭艾利桑德。
text.description: 很久以前，大魔导师艾利桑德曾经站出来对抗过燃烧军团，并公然表达了对艾萨拉女王的蔑视。但数千年的岁月改变了她的思想，并将她变成了恶魔的帮凶。是时候面对她了。

english.title: The Nighthold: Elisande
english.objectives: Kill Elisande in The Nighthold.
english.description: Long ago, Grand Magistrix Elisande opposed the Legion and defied Queen Azshara herself. Passing millennia have changed Elisande's mind, and turned her into an ally of the demons. The time has come to face her.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 暗夜要塞：古尔丹
text.objectives: 在暗夜要塞消灭古尔丹。
text.description: 古尔丹认为燃烧军团才是兽人的宿命所在，他也从来没有停止过这种残酷的追求。现在，我们将终结他的恶魔远征，并代表我们所有人，对他进行正义的审判。

english.title: The Nighthold: Gul'dan
english.objectives: Kill Gul'dan in The Nighthold.
english.description: Gul'dan believed that the Legion was the destiny of the orcs, and has not paused in his brutal pursuit. Now, at last, the time has come to end his demonic crusade, and dispense justice for all.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵
