text.description: 古尔丹认为燃烧军团才是兽人的宿命所在，他也从来没有停止过这种残酷的追求。现在，我们将终结他的恶魔远征，并代表我们所有人，对他进行正义的审判。

english.title: The Nighthold: Gul'dan
english.objectives: Kill Gul'dan in The Nighthold.
english.description: Gul'dan believed that the Legion was the destiny of the orcs, and has not paused in his brutal pursuit. Now, at last, the time has come to end his demonic crusade, and dispense justice for all.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 暗夜要塞：高级植物学家特尔安
text.objectives: 在暗夜要塞消灭高级植物学家特尔安。
text.description: 夜之子所擅长的魔法可不止一种。我们很有可能在暗夜要塞内遭遇强大的敌人。如果我们想要打倒古尔丹，我们就必须先消灭暗夜要塞中强大的法师和战士。

english.title: The Nighthold: High Botanist Tel'arn
english.objectives: Kill High Botanist Tel'arn in The Nighthold.
english.description: The Nightborne are adept in more than one kind of magic, and we will likely face formidable foes inside the walls of the Nighthold. Their strongest mages and warriors must fall before we can hope to face Gul'dan.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 暗夜要塞：艾利桑德
text.objectives: 在暗夜要塞消灭艾利桑德。
text.description: 很久以前，大魔导师艾利桑德曾经站出来对抗过燃烧军团，并公然表达了对艾萨拉女王的蔑视。但数千年的岁月改变了她的思想，并将她变成了恶魔的帮凶。是时候面对她了。

english.title: The Nighthold: Elisande
english.objectives: Kill Elisande in The Nighthold.
english.description: Long ago, Grand Magistrix Elisande opposed the Legion and defied Queen Azshara herself. Passing millennia have changed Elisande's mind, and turned her into an ally of the demons. The time has come to face her.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 暗夜要塞：古尔丹
text.objectives: 在暗夜要塞消灭古尔丹。
text.description: 古尔丹认为燃烧军团才是兽人的宿命所在，他也从来没有停止过这种残酷的追求。现在，我们将终结他的恶魔远征，并代表我们所有人，对他进行正义的审判。

english.title: The Nighthold: Gul'dan
english.objectives: Kill Gul'dan in The Nighthold.
english.description: Gul'dan believed that the Legion was the destiny of the orcs, and has not paused in his brutal pursuit. Now, at last, the time has come to end his demonic crusade, and dispense justice for all.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 卷土重来
text.objectives: 向德拉诺什尔封锁线的霍加尔·雷斧报道。
text.description:
部落的勇士们！拿起你们的斧子，磨尖你们的战矛！那帮子燃烧军团又来我们的世界捣乱了！

我们马上就要从刃拳海湾登船去迎击他们！我们要狠狠地击碎军团的战线！让他们尝尝部落的怒火！让萨格拉斯也知道下什么叫肉疼！

登船！那些恶魔正等着我们去杀呢！

english.title: The Legion Returns
english.objectives: Check in with Holgar Stormaxe at the Dranosh'ar Blockade.
english.description:
Warriors of da Horde! Break out ya axes and sharpen ya spears. Da Burning Legion has returned ta our world!

We be shipping outta Bladefist Bay right away. With da full fury of da Horde, we gonna smash der line so hard dat Sargeras is gonna feel it in da Nether!

Get to da ships. We got demons ta slay!

text.title: 痛苦结晶
text.objectives: 完成5个“邪恶技艺”系列任务。
text.description: 我们就快要完成诅咒战马的召唤准备了。$b$b骑手萨拉纳尔将所需的剩余物品的清单交给了我们。召唤仪式需要有五个邪恶的精华才能进行，它们的名称叫做“痛苦结晶”。$b$b我已经安排好了几项必要的任务，来获取这些道具。$b$b使用任务台，并派遣你的勇士执行任务吧。

english.title: Aggregates of Anguish
english.objectives: Complete 5 "Unholy Attainment" missions.
english.description: Our preparations for conjuring the Steeds of the Damned are nearly complete.$b$bSalanar the Horseman has given us a list of the remaining components. The ritual of conjuring requires five unholy essences known as the Aggregates of Anguish.$b$bI have taken it upon myself to organize the necessary missions to obtain these components.$b$bUse the mission table to assign your chosen champions to the task.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“邪恶技艺”系列任务

text.title: 崭新道路
text.objectives: 与德拉丝·月牙对话。
text.description: 大领主$n，能占用你一点时间吗？$B$B多年以来，我一直追随着圣光的道路，并在月之女祭司的门下长期研习。 但是，我总是感到我知识的不足，我总是渴望着学习更多的知识。$B$B当我踏入这里的时候，我终于明白了我所缺失的东西。我相信，一条崭新的道路正在前方等待着我。$B$B我希望成为一名白银之手的圣骑士。您可否准许我的加入？

english.title: A New Path
english.objectives: Speak to Delas Moonfang.
english.description: Highlord $n, if I could have a moment of your time?$B$BLong have I followed the path of the Light, and for many years I studied under the Priestesses of the Moon. Yet, I have always felt my education incomplete, and a yearning to know more.$B$BWhen I walked into these halls, I finally felt a spark of what was missing. I believe that a new path lies before me.$B$BI wish to become a paladin of the Silver Hand. Will you allow me to join you?

objectiveDetails.description: 在讲台处招募德拉丝·月牙加入白银之手
在勇士大厅与德拉丝见面

text.title: 再现传奇
text.objectives: 选择要追求的第二件神器。
text.description:
在寻找强大神器的问题上，我们或许应该更加灵活变通一些。如果你感兴趣的话，我还知道其它值得寻找的神器。

让我来为你介绍一下这些选择吧，你可以从中挑选一个。

english.title: A Second Legend
english.objectives: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
english.description:
Perhaps it's time to consider improving your flexibility when it comes to powerful artifacts. There are still others that I think are worth pursuing if you are interested.

Let me show you what your options are and you can choose one.

text.title: Seeking Refuge
text.objectives: Complete the "Nightfall" storyline in Suramar, then meet Archmage Kalec in Shal'Aran.
text.description: The Nightfallen in Suramar were once a part of the Nightborne, but have been exiled by their former brethren and cut off from the Nightwell.$B$BI believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if you can turn them to our side. I know only that they have gone into hiding somewhere in Suramar.$B$BIf you can convince the Nightfallen to aid us, they may be able to offer the Moon Guard and us both refuge right under the Legion's nose.

english.title: Seeking Refuge
english.objectives: Complete the "Nightfall" storyline in Suramar, then meet Archmage Kalec in Shal'Aran.
english.description: The Nightfallen in Suramar were once a part of the Nightborne, but have been exiled by their former brethren and cut off from the Nightwell.$B$BI believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if you can turn them to our side. I know only that they have gone into hiding somewhere in Suramar.$B$BIf you can convince the Nightfallen to aid us, they may be able to offer the Moon Guard and us both refuge right under the Legion's nose.

objectiveDetails.description: Save First Arcanist Thalryssa in Suramar

text.title: 集中全力
text.objectives: 完成苏拉玛的“堕夜”和“护月堡垒”故事线，然后在沙尔艾兰与大法师卡雷会合。
text.description: 苏拉玛的堕夜精灵原本是夜之子的成员，但被他们曾经的同胞流放，并切断了与暗夜井的联系。$B$B如果你可以将他们拉拢到我们这边，我相信他们会成为可靠的盟友，帮助我们的事业。我只知道他们隐匿在苏拉玛城的某个地方。$B$B之后，请去苏拉玛城北部地区寻找月之守卫。他们也可以成为宝贵的盟友，为我们的事业提供助力……如果他们一如多年前致力于反抗燃烧军团的话。

english.title: Focusing Our Efforts
english.objectives: Complete the "Nightfall" and "Moon Guard Stronghold" storylines in Suramar, then meet Archmage Kalec in Shal'Aran.
english.description: The Nightfallen in Suramar were once a part of the Nightborne, but have been exiled by their former brethren and cut off from the Nightwell.$B$BI believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if you can turn them to our side. I know only that they have gone into hiding somewhere in Suramar.$B$BAfterward, seek out the Moon Guard in the northern reaches of Suramar. They, too, could be valuable allies in our cause... if they still oppose the Legion as they once did many years ago.

text.title: 上古神器
text.objectives: 将上古神器带给附近的姆嘎姆嘎国王。
text.description:
<在尸体身上，你发现了一个模样怪异的纳迦神器。
在你漫步于上古海滩之时，你看到了姆嘎姆嘎国王。也许他知道这件神器的事情？>

english.title: Timeworn Artifact
english.objectives: Take the Timeworn Artifact to King Mrgl Mrgl nearby.
english.description:
<You've found a strange looking naga artifact on the fallen corpse.
You saw King Mrgl Mrgl as you were walking around Timeworn Strand. Maybe he knows what to do with it?>

objectiveDetails.description: 带400份远古魔力给塔莉萨

text.title: 开拓视野
text.objectives: 与阿格娜对话，并选择第二件你希望追寻的神器。
text.description: 你真是善于学习啊，$ct $n。元素们与你进行了沟通——这种沟通在这个世界中可不常见。$b$b一个真正的萨满必须踏上多条道路。而在扮演每一种角色时，你都需要称手的工具。只有最为强大的武器才能带领我们战胜燃烧军团。也许，我们应该再寻找一把强大的武器。$b$b我们应该谈一谈，然后告诉我你的选择。

english.title: Expanding Your Horizons
english.objectives: Speak with Aggra to choose a second artifact to pursue.
english.description: You are a fast study, $ct $n. The elements speak through you - it is rare to have such a connection to the world.$b$bA true shaman must walk many paths. For every role, one must have the right tools at hand. Only the most powerful weapons can lead us to victory against the Legion. Perhaps it is time to seek out another?$b$bSpeak with me and let us discuss your options.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第二件神器

text.title: 更多的传奇武器
text.objectives: 选择要追求的第二件神器。
text.description:
聪明人在前往战场时，身上都备有不止一把武器。有时候，某一把武器可能会更加适应战场的情况。你应该再挑选一件传奇武器带在身上，尤其是面对劲敌的时候。

你觉得呢？

english.title: More Weapons of Legend
english.objectives: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
english.description:
It is wise to carry more than one weapon to war. Sometimes one will be better suited than another. You should choose another weapon of legend to carry with you, especially against foes so deadly.

What say you?

text.title: 特工尸体
text.objectives: 调查军情七处特工的尸体并寻找线索。
text.description: 有一件急事需要你处理，$n。$b$b下水道里发现了一具女性的尸体，背后还插着一把刀。$b$b一般来说，这种事情不至于如此大张旗鼓……但这次的受害者可不是普通人。而是军情七处的特工！$b$b我已经派手下看住尸体，但你最好在消息传开之前尽快赶到那里。$b$b如果联盟知道了这件事情……那就不妙了。

english.title: A Body of Evidence
english.objectives: Investigate the body of the SI:7 operative for clues.
english.description: There is an urgent matter that requires your attention, $n.$b$bThe body of a woman with a knife in her back has turned up in the sewers.$b$bNormally, such a matter would be less than newsworthy... but this isn't your average cutthroat. It's an SI:7 operative!$b$bI've got some of our goons guarding the body, but you had better get over there before the word spreads.$b$bIf SI:7 finds out about this... it will be bad for business.

text.title: 命运之刃
text.objectives: 选择要追求的第二件神器。
text.description:
很高兴看到你整天都带着那把武器消灭敌人。如果你觉得手上的这把武器还有所不足的话，我们的盟友巫妖王主动为你提供了有关另一把武器的线索。

仔细考虑一下。如果你想去寻找其中一把武器，就告诉我。

english.title: Blades of Destiny
english.objectives: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
english.description:
I'm glad that weapon you've been carrying around has proven useful. Our ally, the Lich King, has offered to provide you with a lead on another weapon should the one you already have somehow be lacking.

Consider the options carefully and let me know which you would like to seek out.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第二件神器
Pay respects to the Fallen Jarl

text.title: 雇佣帮手
text.objectives: 找到阿鲁因并说服他帮助你。
text.description:
我很喜欢玛尔迦。她去世的消息令我们许多人心情沉重。

<凡瑟尔悲伤地摇摇头。>

如果要继续下去，我们就必须传递出一个明确的消息。我们需要让杜兰特那样的人知道，我们在看着他们，我们会让他们付出代价。

我知道谁可以帮助我们。

他叫阿鲁因。说他是一个百般不情愿的盟友都算是客气的。他为人小心谨慎，如果无利可图的话，是绝对不会冒任何风险的。

你可以在永月集市北边的巷子里找到他。

english.title: Hired Help
english.objectives: Locate Arluin and persuade him to help you.
english.description:
I was fond of Margaux. News of her death weighs heavily on many of us.

<Vanthir shakes his head sadly.>

If we are to carry on, we need to send a strong message. We need those like Durant to know that we are watching, and we will hold them accountable.

I know someone who could help us.

His name is Arluin. To call him a reluctant ally would be generously overstating it. He is cautious, and will not risk himself without compensation.

You can find him in the alleys north of the Evermoon Bazaar.

text.title: 两条道路，两件武器
text.objectives: 选择你要追寻的第二件神器。
text.description:
我们翻遍了所有的卷轴，找到了一些强大武器的新线索。也许它们能成为我们新的助力。

来吧，让我来向你介绍一下我们的发现。如果你对其中的哪件武器感兴趣，那就告诉我。

english.title: Two Paths, Two Weapons
english.objectives: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
english.description:
We've searched through our scrolls and have found new leads on a couple of powerful weapons. They may prove beneficial in our efforts.

Here, let me show you what I've found. If any of these interest you then simply let me know.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第二件神器

text.title: 招募女武神
text.objectives: 与萨薇·勇裔对话。
text.description: 强大的瓦格里——萨薇·勇裔已经抵达此地，并将帮助我们壮大我们的部队。她为英灵殿带来了一些英勇无比的维库女武神。$B$B去找她谈谈，为我们招募更多的强力部队。

english.title: Recruiting Shieldmaidens
english.objectives: Speak to Savyn Valorborn.
english.description: The powerful val'kyr Savyn Valorborn has arrived to aid us in bolstering our numbers. She ushers some of the most valorous vrykul shieldmaidens into the Halls of Valor.$B$BSpeak to her and recruit powerful troops to add to our roster.

text.title: 另一件远古武器
text.objectives: 选择要追求的第二件神器。
text.description:
你做得很好，但我们的敌人也十分的强大和狡猾。无论他们打算怎么对付我们，做好准备总不会错。$b$b你最好考虑一下如何获取另一件上古武器，以帮助我们赢得战斗。$b$b
等你做出决定后，就告诉我一声吧。

english.title: Another Weapon of Old
english.objectives: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
english.description: You have done well but our foes are powerful and cunning. It would be wise to be prepared for whatever they may unleash upon us. $b$bYou would be wise to consider obtaining another of the weapons of old to aid in our conflict.$b$bLet me know how you'd like to proceed.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第二件神器

text.title: 再度开启的典籍
text.objectives: 选择要追求的第二件神器。
text.description: 朋友，你一直都很强大，但如果你拥有另一把武器的话，你将会战无不胜。$b$b来吧，让我为你介绍一下这本书里还记录了什么武器。如果你对其中的哪一件感兴趣，就告诉我。

english.title: The Tome Opens Again
english.objectives: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
english.description: You've been doing well, friend, but you would be unstoppable if you had another weapon at your side.$b$bHere, let me show you what options remain in the book. If either of these interest you then simply let me know.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第二件神器

text.title: 保护者
text.objectives: 运用你的德鲁伊之力与野性之石、守护之石、恢复之石和平衡之石的守护者交流。
text.description: 若要完全解锁神像的力量，我们需要四种荒野精华——野性精华、重生精华、平衡精华以及坚韧精华。$B$B为找到这些精华，我们必须询问森林的保护者们。$B$B前往翡翠梦境之路，召唤上古德鲁伊之石的力量。保护者只会在那些可以证明自己与荒野的联系的人面前现身。

english.title: The Protectors
english.objectives: Use your druidic powers to commune with protectors at the Feral Stone, the Guardian Stone, the Restoration Stone, and the Balance Stone.
english.description: To fully unlock the powers of the Idol, we will need four manifestations of the wilds - an essence of ferocity, essence of regrowth, essence of balance, and essence of tenacity.$B$BTo find these essences, we must consult the protectors of the forest.$B$BGo to the Emerald Dreamway and call upon the powers of the ancient druidic stones. The protectors will only show themselves to those who can prove their connection to the wilds.

text.title: 圣光使者
text.objectives: 弄清神秘的缚光物体的用途。
text.description: 图拉扬还活着！这么多年来，我都以为我的老友已经在某个荒凉的恶魔世界中灰飞烟灭了。虽然他还活着，但得知他身处险境，这实在是让人难以忍受。$B$B抓紧时间，$n。我们必须找到这件物品的神圣用途。$B$B毫无疑问，图拉扬提到的先知就是德莱尼人的领袖，维伦。将这件东西带去埃索达吧。你将在那里找到先知维伦。$B$B我现在就来为你打开传送门。带上我的道标，当你准备好返回的时候就使用它。
text.completion: Kil'jaeden took the child from Velen, let Velen believe that the boy had been killed, then raised the child as an agent of the Burning Legion with the express purpose of murdering his own father? That bastard waited 13,000 years to exact vengeance upon Velen for defying Sargeras and the Legion? The Deceiver indeed...$B$BFor Velen to have to experience such tragedy after what he and his people have already been through is heartbreaking. Such a thing would test anyone's faith.

english.title: Bringer of the Light
english.objectives: Discover the purpose of the Mysterious Lightbound Object.
english.description: Turalyon lives! For ages I had thought that my old friend had perished on some desolate Legion world. But to know that he yet lives and is in danger is too much to bear.$B$BWe must hurry, $n. We must uncover the object's sacred purpose.$B$BThe prophet of whom Turalyon spoke of is undoubtedly the leader of the draenei, Velen. Take the object and journey to the Exodar. It is there that you will find Prophet Velen.$B$BI will open a portal for you now. Take my beacon and use it when you are ready to return.
english.completion: Kil'jaeden took the child from Velen, let Velen believe that the boy had been killed, then raised the child as an agent of the Burning Legion with the express purpose of murdering his own father? That bastard waited 13,000 years to exact vengeance upon Velen for defying Sargeras and the Legion? The Deceiver indeed...$B$BFor Velen to have to experience such tragedy after what he and his people have already been through is heartbreaking. Such a thing would test anyone's faith.

objectiveDetails.description: 弄清神秘的缚光物体的用途

text.title: Tracking Quest: Reaction to Warrior Artifacts

english.title: Tracking Quest: Reaction to Warrior Artifacts

text.title: 极限潜能
text.objectives: 与阿格娜对话，并选择第三件你希望追寻的神器。
text.description: 我见证了你踏上多条道路，正如一名真正的萨满那样。$b$b你已经拥有了两件强大的神器。但即使是再寻找第三把神器，这样也不算贪心：这将让你实现自己的宿命，完成生命的循环。$b$b和我谈谈，然后我们就一同去解放你的全部潜力。

english.title: Your Fullest Potential
english.objectives: Speak with Aggra to choose a third artifact to pursue.
english.description: I see that you walk many paths, as a true shaman should.$b$bTwo mighty artifacts are already in your possession. To seek a third would not be greed: it would be the fulfillment of your destiny, the completion of a circle.$b$bSpeak with me, and together we will unlock your fullest potential.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第三件神器

text.title: 陨落之星
text.objectives: 找到神秘的缚光物体。
text.description: $ct$n，谢谢你能赶过来。我有一件急事需要借助你独一无二的能力。$B$B根据白银之手的报告，邪能风暴中出现了一个非同寻常的发光物体，目前正朝着苏拉玛海岸的方向坠落。我对这件事最感到好奇的是，它在邪能风暴之中切开了一条光带。$B$B你可以去调查一下吗？克拉苏斯平台那里有一只狮鹫在等着你。

english.title: A Falling Star
english.objectives: Find the Mysterious Lightbound Object.
english.description: $ct $n, thank you for coming. I have a matter of some urgency that requires your unique talents.$B$BThe Order of the Silver Hand have reported that an extraordinarily luminescent object has emerged from the Felstorm and is currently falling towards the coast of Suramar. What I find most curious about this occurrence is that the object was reported as having "cut a swath" through the Felstorm itself.$B$BWill you investigate? There is a gryphon awaiting your arrival at Krasus' Landing.

objectiveDetails.description: 搭乘卡德加的狮鹫前往苏拉玛

text.title: 另一把利刃
text.objectives: 选择要追求的第二件神器。
text.description:
我们还有一些打算，准备拿到其它神兵利器，随着你的任务不断进展，它们可能会让你如虎添翼。

我很乐于和你一起仔细检查其余选择，以便让你做出明智的决定。

english.title: Another Worthy Blade
english.objectives: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
english.description:
We still have plans prepared to obtain other weapons of incredible power - tools that you may find useful to have on hand as you continue your work.

I would be happy to go over the remaining options with you so that you may make an informed decision.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第二件神器

text.title: 信任票
text.objectives: 返回残月酒馆，找到莉莉丝。
text.description:
我会努力保护我的儿子，直到投票结束。

科恩·斯特拉瑞斯即使在贵族中也以凶残而著称。他堕落到这种地步，只为确保自己的成功，这一点并不令我惊讶。

告诉莉莉丝，我会支持她的。我的立场将非常明确。

你最好再告诉她，如果放松警惕，科恩·斯特拉瑞斯就会趁机伤害她。

请务必小心。

english.title: Vote of Confidence
english.objectives: Return to Ly'leth at the Waning Crescent.
english.description:
I will endeavor to protect my son until the votes are cast.

Coryn Stelleris is a predator even among the nobility. It does not surprise me that he should stoop to such depths to ensure his own success.

Tell Ly'leth that she has my support. Unequivocally.

You may also choose to tell her that Coryn Stelleris will hurt her, if she gives him a chance.

Be careful.

text.title: 血淋淋的真相
text.objectives: 找出军情七处特工被攻击的真相。
text.description: 我们必须找到安玻·吉尔妮暗杀行动的幕后黑手。$b$b军情七处很快就会意识到他们的特工失踪了，然后派人到暗影大厅四处打探。$b$b拿上这些时髦的间谍眼镜，用它们扫描血迹。我已专门针对安玻·吉尔妮的血液进行了校准。$b$b跟着血迹找到疑犯，但千万不要暴露行踪！$b$b查到我们所需的信息后就回来报告。

english.title: The Bloody Truth
english.objectives: Discover the truth behind the hit on the SI:7 agent.
english.description: We need to find out who is behind the assassination of Amber Kearnen.$b$bIt won't be long before SI:7 realizes that their agent is MIA and comes sniffing around The Hall of Shadows.$b$bHere, take these stylish spy glasses and set them to scan for traces of hemoglobin. I've taken the liberty of calibrating them specifically for Amber Kearnen's blood.$b$bFollow the blood trail back to the culprits, but make sure to stay out of sight!$b$bReport back to us when you've got the information we need.

objectiveDetails.description: 窃听军情七处特工谈话

text.title: 传说的延续
text.objectives: 选择要追求的第二件神器。
text.description: 有两条道路供你选择——有两把强大的武器可以帮助你对抗燃烧军团。$B$B当然，我会帮助你回想起其它的选择。

english.title: Continuing the Legend
english.objectives: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
english.description: There are still two paths you may walk - two powerful weapons you might yet obtain to aid you in the fight against the Legion.$B$BI will help you recall your remaining options, of course.

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第二件神器

text.title: 浪费天赋
text.objectives: 启动传送板，把凡瑟尔的礼物交给塔莉萨。
text.description:
你在这里帮了我们很多忙，但是时候让你回去塔莉萨身边了。

附近有个传送板，近年来一直无人使用。你试试能否重新定向，用它回到塔莉萨身边。

哦，你出发之前：

<凡瑟尔交给你一瓶包装好的魔力酒。>

请把这个交给她，感谢她送你来帮忙。请告诉她，你帮助我们补满了魔力酒的存货，还令一位母亲得以和她的孩子团聚。

我们的感激之情难以言表。让我们暂且告别吧。

english.title: Wasted Potential
english.objectives: Activate the teleporter pad and bring Vanthir's gift to Thalyssra.
english.description:
You have done well for us here, but it is time for you to return to Thalyssra.

There is a teleporter pad nearby that has gone unused in recent years. See if you can reroute it and return to her that way.

Oh, and before you go:

<Vanthir hands you a wrapped bottle of Arcwine.>

Take this to her, with my thanks for sending you. Let her know that your efforts helped replenish our Arcwine supplies and reunited a mother and child.

We are grateful beyond measure. Farewell for now.

text.title: 他们将会颤抖
text.objectives: 返回塔莉萨身边。
text.description:
今日发生的事肯定会招致一些后果。

现在，你先回到塔莉萨身边去吧。告诉她，我们已为玛尔迦报仇雪恨，并且暮色百合已向所有苏拉玛城人民宣告了自己的存在。

尘埃落定之前还会有很多人死去，但他们的死亡将令像杜兰特那样的人收敛气焰，未来更加谨言慎行。

english.title: And They Will Tremble
english.objectives: Return to Thalyssra
english.description:
There will be consequences for what has transpired this day.

For now, you should return to Thalyssra. Tell her that we have avenged Margaux and that the Dusk Lily has announced itself to all of Suramar.

There will be many more deaths before this is over, rest assured, but this is a death that will teach others like Durant to tread more carefully in the future.

text.title: 朋友的好处
text.objectives: 返回塔莉萨身边。
text.description: 向来沉默的月郡侍从交给你一卷蜡封的卷轴。$b$b上面写道：$b“我最最亲爱的$n，$b$b我对我的侍从下令，如果事情的发展如我所愿，那就前来找你。$b$b顾问的职责令我必须远离庄园一段时间，同时，我为塔莉萨选好了一份礼物。$b$b我已派遣一支侍从队伍，带着一些提升舒适度的物品前往沙尔艾兰。请好好对待他们——他们必须有个服侍对象，我想她就是最好的人选了！$b$b请向其他人转达我的谢意和问候。$b顾问莉莉丝·月郡”

english.title: Friends With Benefits
english.objectives: Return to Thalyssra.
english.description: The Lunastre Attendant, silent as ever, offers you a wax-sealed scroll.$b$bIt reads:$b"Dearest $n,$b$bI asked my attendant to catch you, should things go in my favor.$b$bThe role of Advisor will keep me away from the estate for some time and I settled on a gift for Thalyssra.$b$bI have sent a detachment of attendants to Shal'Aran with some comfort items. Treat them well- they need someone to wait on and I could think of none better!$b$bGive the others my thanks, and my love,$bAdvisor Ly'leth Lunastre"

text.title: 他们有头深渊领主
text.objectives: 击败库格拉罗斯。
text.description: 邪能图腾并非首个屈服于燃烧军团诱惑的部族。他们也不会是最后一个。$b$b然而，他们不自量力地召唤出了一头深渊领主。$b$b你愿意与我们并肩击败这头野兽吗？你的神器和技能所蕴含的力量，在对抗此类生物时应当能够发挥出无与伦比的威力。

english.title: They Have A Pitlord
english.objectives: Defeat Kuglaroth.
english.description: The Feltotem are not the first to embrace the temptations of the Burning Legion. And they will not be the last.$b$bBut in their arrogance, they have conjured a pit lord.$b$bWill you join us in battle against this beast? The power of your artifact and skill could prove invaluable against such a creature.

text.title: “高贵的”活动
text.objectives: 派遣勇士调查狩猎活动。
text.description:
这像是一封私人猎狐活动的邀请函。他们想要猎杀沃平，破碎群岛上一只罕见的狡狐。说不定我们可以利用这个机会？

我们必须获得更多关于这次狩猎的消息，同时得想办法不让夜之子知道你的计划。你的勇士们可以替你调查狩猎在哪里开始。

english.title: A "Noble" Event
english.objectives: Send champions on missions to investigate the hunt.
english.description:
The invitation appears to be for an exclusive fox hunt. They plan to hunt Volpin, a rare, elusive fox somewhere in the Broken Isles.  Perhaps we can take advantage of this?

We need to gather more information about this hunt, but we should do so without alerting the Nightborne to your plans. Your champions can act in your stead and further  investigate where the hunt will be.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 狡猾的沃平
text.objectives: 扰乱猎狐活动。
text.description:
按地图上显示，猎狐活动会在苏拉玛的羽鬃狩猎场开始。如果夜之子成功了，他们会杀死沃平，让它的族群在破碎群岛上的血脉彻底消失。

去狩猎场扰乱这场狩猎吧。

english.title: Volpin the Elusive
english.objectives: Interrupt the fox hunt.
english.description:
According to the map, the fox hunt will start at the Feathermane Hunting Grounds in Suramar. If the Nightborne succeed, they will kill Volpin, a fox that is the last of his kind in the Broken Isles.

Travel to the Hunting Grounds, and interrupt the hunt.

text.title: 强化你的武器库
text.objectives: 选择要追求的第二件神器。
text.description: 大领主，您还可以获得其他武器，帮助您击败燃烧军团。当您在破碎群岛上的时候，我们一直密切留意着这些武器的下落。$B$B如果您愿意的话，我很乐意与您一同查看。
text.completion: Excellent. There's no time to waste.

english.title: Bolstering Your Arsenal
english.objectives: Choose a second artifact to pursue.
english.description: Highlord, there are still weapons that you might obtain to help you defeat the Legion. We have kept a close eye on them during your time on the Broken Isles.$B$BI would be happy to review them with you if you wish.
english.completion: Excellent. There's no time to waste.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: 选择要追求的第二件神器

text.title: Shaman Has Given Doomhammer to Oracle

english.title: Shaman Has Given Doomhammer to Oracle

text.title: Shaman Has Given Sharas'dal to Oracle

english.title: Shaman Has Given Sharas'dal to Oracle

text.title: 奈萨里奥的巢穴：坚韧精华
text.objectives: 从奈萨里奥巢穴的洛克莫拉身上收集 1 份坚韧精华，然后杀掉地底之王达古尔。
text.description: 您好，大德鲁伊。我听说您在寻找坚韧精华。$B$B这世上没有比岩石生物更为顽强和牢不可破的东西了。$B$B奈萨里奥的巢穴中有一头叫做洛克莫拉的怪物。杀掉它，并从它的身上萃取你所需要的精华。

english.title: Neltharion's Lair: Essence of Tenacity
english.objectives: Collect 1 Essence of Tenacity from Rokmora in Neltharion's Lair, then slay Dar'grul the Underking.
english.description: Greetings, Archdruid. I hear that you seek the essence of tenacity.$B$BThere is none more unyielding and unbreakable than a creature of stone.$B$BIn Neltharion's Lair is a monster known as Rokmora. Slay him, and draw from him the essence that you need.

text.title: 英灵殿：野性精华
text.objectives: 从英灵殿的芬雷尔身上收集1份野性精华，然后向奥丁证明你的价值。
text.description: 想要得到野性精华，就必须找到一种屠杀过万千生命，甚至让神明也感到敬畏的生物。$B$B我说的就是魔狼芬雷尔，它一直在英灵殿永恒的森林里狩猎。

english.title: Halls of Valor: Essence of Ferocity
english.objectives: Collect 1 Essence of Ferocity from Fenryr in the Halls of Valor, then prove your worth to Odyn.
english.description: To find the essence of ferocity, you must seek a creature who has slain thousands, and is revered by even the gods.$B$BI speak of none other than the wolf, Fenryr, whom you can find hunting in the eternal forests of the Halls of Valor.

text.title: 黑心林地：重生精华
text.objectives: 从黑心林地的橡树之心身上收集1份重生精华，然后击败萨维斯之影。
text.description: 我的孩子，我只知道一个地方可以获得重生精华。$B$B黑心林地的深处潜藏着林地忠实的上古守护者——橡树之心。最近，他已在梦魇的腐蚀下堕落。但内心深处，他依然在战斗。$B$B收集这棵巨树的精华，让他那不灭的灵魂浇灌全新的生命。

english.title: Darkheart Thicket: Essence of Regrowth
english.objectives: Collect 1 Essence of Regrowth from Oakheart in Darkheart Thicket, then defeat the Shade of Xavius.
english.description: My child, I can think of only one place to capture the essence of regrowth.$B$BDeep within Darkheart Thicket is Oakheart, a loyal ancient defender of the grove. He has recently fallen to the Nightmare's corruption, but deep within his heart, he still fights.$B$BGather the essence of this great tree, so that his everliving soul may be used to fuel new life.

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：平衡精华
text.objectives: 从艾萨拉之怒身上收集1份平衡精华。
text.description: 在阿苏纳的艾萨拉之眼，一个名为艾萨拉之怒的强大实体正在增强力量。那是偷盗的奥术之力的融合体，是对自然的亵渎，绝不应当存在。$B$B消灭它，然后就能获得你所追寻的平衡精华。

english.title: Eye of Azshara: Essence of Balance
english.objectives: Collect 1 Essence of Balance from the Wrath of Azshara.
english.description: Within the Eye of Azshara in Azsuna, a powerful being known as the Wrath of Azshara grows in strength. It is a blasphemy of nature - an infusion of stolen arcane power, and cannot be allowed to exist.$B$BSlay it. In its aftermath, you may find the essence of balance that you seek.

text.title: 黑锋骑士团
text.objectives: 与考加兹·亡斧谈一谈。
text.description: 考加兹·亡斧已抵达阿彻鲁斯，帮助我们招募更多死亡骑士。他很善于发现人才。$b$b我已反复强调过，在与燃烧军团的战斗中，最重要就是补充我们的战力。$b$b恶魔大军的数量几乎无穷无尽，而我们则人少势微。$b$b准备好招募更多死亡骑士后，与考加兹对话。

english.title: Knights of the Ebon Blade
english.objectives: Speak to Korgaz Deadaxe.
english.description: Korgaz Deadaxe has arrived at Acherus to aid us in recruiting additional death knights. He has an eye for potential.$b$bI cannot emphasize enough that it is of the utmost importance that we replenish our numbers during the battle with the Burning Legion.$b$bThe demon armies are nearly endless and we are few.$b$bSpeak with Korgaz when you are ready to recruit additional death knights.

text.title: 第一位通灵师的魔典
text.objectives: 从整个破碎群岛上的强大人形勇士处收集13个斩杀之颅，将它们带到位于逆风小径摩根墓场附近的地下墓穴中的刽子手的祭坛。
text.description:
这本古籍似乎是第一位通灵师萨泰尔的法术书。

你在里面记载的许多咒术和咒语中发现了萨泰尔用于强化乌萨勒斯，逆风收割者的方法。她将之称为“处刑仪式”。

场地已经选好，并筹备妥当，但萨泰尔却在举行仪式之前遭遇了不测。也许你可以完成她的工作？

首先，你需要一些颅骨。

english.title: The Grimoire of the First Necrolyte
english.objectives: Collect 13 Skulls of the Executed from powerful humanoid champions throughout Broken Isles, and bring them to the Executioner's Altar in the crypt near Morgan's Plot in Deadwind Pass.
english.description:
This ancient tome appears to be the spellbook of Sataiel, the first necrolyte.

Within its pages of curses and cantrips, you discover instructions for a ritual that Sataiel was concocting to empower Ulthalesh, the Deadwind Harvester. She calls this ritual, "The Rite of the Executioner."

The site was chosen and prepared, but Sataiel met her unfortunate end before she could proceed.  Perhaps you can pick up where she left off?

First, you'll need some skulls.

text.title: 为玛尔迦报仇
text.objectives: 杀掉8名酒庄管事或卫兵。
text.description:
<希尔维林苍白着脸，气急败坏地说道。>

他们怎么能这样？玛尔迦满足了他们的所有要求，有过之而无不及！即使他们如此对待我们，魔力酒也始终未曾终止供应！他们竟然这样对她！

这样恶毒的行为不容于世。我们必须为玛尔迦报仇。

english.title: Vengeance for Margaux
english.objectives: Slay 8 Vineyard Enforcers or Wardens.
english.description:
<Sylverin sputters, pale-faced with rage.>

How could they? Margaux did everything they asked of her and more! The arcwine never stopped flowing despite everything they did to us! To her!

Such injustice cannot stand. We must take vengeance for Margaux.

text.title: 返回邪能之槌号
text.objectives: 在邪能之槌号与战争领主加尔顿谈一谈。
text.description:
$n，战争领主加尔顿派我来找你。他说他有件很重要的事情需要你的帮助。

他希望你尽快返回邪能之槌号。
text.giverWindow: 指挥官，请尽快返回邪能之槌号与我会面。

english.title: Return to the Fel Hammer
english.objectives: Speak with Battlelord Gaardoun on the Fel Hammer.
english.description:
$n, Battlelord Gaardoun asked me to retrieve you. He says there is a very important matter that he needs your help with.

He requests your presence back on the Fel Hammer as soon as possible.
english.giverWindow: Return to me on the Fel Hammer as soon as possible, commander.

objectiveDetails.description: 回去找战争领主加尔顿
使用伊利达雷传送门（可选）

text.title: 更强大的武器库
text.objectives: 与卡里杜斯交谈，选择你希望追寻的神器。
text.description:
这本典籍讲述了又一件可以用来对抗敌人的武器，朋友可以用得上！

你想去追寻它吗？

english.title: A Greater Arsenal
english.objectives: Speak with Calydus to choose to pursue your final artifact.
english.description:
The tome speaks of one more weapon that friend can use against our foes. 

Do you wish to seek it?

text.title: 宣誓效忠
text.objectives: 返回神射手营地，找到祭坛守护者别恩。
text.description:
这头鹰似乎有消息要传达给你：
$B|cFF660000致：$n|r$b$b希望这封信完好地交到你手里。$B$B欧恩哈拉的预言传播得很快。很多人想要向隐秘通途的新领袖宣誓效忠。$B$B请返回神射手营地找我讨论具体情况。.$B$B|cFF660000             |r——祭坛守护者别恩。

english.title: Pledge of Loyalty
english.objectives: Return to Altar Keeper Biehn in Trueshot Lodge.
english.description:
The eagle appears to have a message for you:
$B|cFF660000To: $n|r$b$bI hope this message finds you well.$B$BWord of Ohn'ahra's omen has traveled fast. There are many who wish to pledge their loyalty to the Unseen Path's new leader.$B$BReturn to me at Trueshot Lodge, and we can discuss this further.$B$B|cFF660000             |r-Altar Keeper Biehn

text.title: Protect the Home Front
text.objectives: Open your map to find an active Legion invasion in Kalimdor or Eastern Kingdoms. Go to the invasion site and stop the demons!
text.description: The Legion hasn't just invaded this city. Their evil is spreading across Azeroth, threatening the far corners of our world.$b$bWe must seek them out and stop them, everywhere their darkness touches.$b$bWe've dispatched scouts around the world to watch for Legion activity. As invasions arise, we'll mark the locations on your map.$b$bMake them suffer, $n!

english.title: Protect the Home Front
english.objectives: Open your map to find an active Legion invasion in Kalimdor or Eastern Kingdoms. Go to the invasion site and stop the demons!
english.description: The Legion hasn't just invaded this city. Their evil is spreading across Azeroth, threatening the far corners of our world.$b$bWe must seek them out and stop them, everywhere their darkness touches.$b$bWe've dispatched scouts around the world to watch for Legion activity. As invasions arise, we'll mark the locations on your map.$b$bMake them suffer, $n!

text.title: 招募学徒
text.objectives: 与大咒术师米米克对话。
text.description: 大咒术师米米克已前来帮助我们扩充部队。她会找出最有前途的学徒，并将他们迅速培养起来。她以前的学生都可以位居世界上一流咒术师之列！$B$B和她对话，招募她的学徒加入我们的队伍。

english.title: Recruiting Apprentices
english.objectives: Speak to Grand Conjuror Mimic.
english.description: Grand Conjuror Mimic has arrived to aid us in bolstering our numbers. She seeks out the most promising apprentices and trains them very quickly. Her former students are some of the most powerful conjurors in the land!$B$BSpeak to her and recruit some of her apprentices to add to our roster.

text.title: 共同的朋友
text.objectives: 返回恐痕裂隙，找到卡里杜斯。
text.description:
很高兴见到你。

我们的朋友卡里杜斯派我前来。他迫切希望与你交流。

当你方便的时候，请你尽快返回恐痕裂隙。

english.title: A Mutual Friend
english.objectives: Return to Calydus within Dreadscar Rift.
english.description:
It's good to see you are well.

I've been sent by our mutual friend, Calydus. He is eager to speak with you.

Please return to Dreadscar Rift at your earliest convenience.

text.title: 正式介绍
text.objectives: 回到虚空之光神殿的阿隆索斯·法奥处。
text.description:
我很高兴能够找到你。

阿隆索斯·法奥有消息带给你。

他说介绍事宜已经安排妥当，并且需要你的出席。如果方便的话，请你尽早前往虚空之光神殿。

english.title: Proper Introductions
english.objectives: Return to Alonsus Faol within Netherlight Temple.
english.description:
I'm glad I found you. 

I have a message from Alonsus Faol.

He says introductions are in order, and requests your presence within Netherlight Temple at your earliest convenience.

text.title: 补给减少
text.objectives: 挑战并打败正在抢夺你的补给品的恐怖图腾勇士。
text.description: 这些大地之环补给品尚未处理。看上去似乎有人曾经翻找过它们，并且把所有可以带上的东西都劫走了。你有理由怀疑恐怖图腾部族，因为他们的一个勇士就在附近，光明正大地窃取你的东西。$b$b挑战那名恐怖图腾，保护你的资源。

english.title: Supply Dropped
english.objectives: Challenge and defeat the Grimtotem Champion who is raiding your supplies.
english.description: These supplies for the Earthen Ring have not been processed yet. It looks like someone has been rummaging through them and looting whatever can be carried. You have reasons to suspect the Grimtotem tribe, on account of the fact that one of their champions is nearby, visibly pilfering your stuff.$b$bChallenge the Grimtotem to secure your resources!

text.title: Azsuna - Treasure 046 - Temple of a Thousand Lights

english.title: Azsuna - Treasure 046 - Temple of a Thousand Lights

text.title: 传承大德鲁伊
text.objectives: 前往萨斯塔拉寻找埃洛瑟尔。
text.description: 埃洛瑟尔居住在古老的萨斯塔拉林地，他在那里与自然进行交流，并将治疗之术与知识的传承教导给他的信徒。$b$b去找到他，并告诉他这里非常需要他的帮助。

english.title: Archdruid of Lore
english.objectives: Seek out Elothir in Thas'talah.
english.description: Elothir resides in the ancient grove Thas'talah, where he communes with nature and instructs his acolytes in the ways of healing and the preservation of lore.$b$bSeek him out and tell him that he is desperately needed here.

text.title: 梦想交易
text.objectives: 使用夜之子药瓶制作伊瑟拉的梦境饮剂。
text.description: 从外表判断，我猜你是个炼金师，对吗？$b$b只要我认为价钱合理，就可以向你出售我的服务。$b$b时至今日，我已离开苏拉玛城一段时间了。我非常渴望得到伊瑟拉的梦境饮剂。你需要几片入梦叶，以及沉睡者之泪的叶子来制作这种饮剂。$b$b附近一些废墟里的空地上就长着一棵。拿上我的药瓶，帮我作出这种饮剂，我就会满足你的要求。

english.title: Trading for Dreams
english.objectives: Use the Nightborne Flask to craft an Ysera's Dream Draught.
english.description: From the look of you, I take it you're an alchemist, yes?$b$bI'd be willing to trade my services with you for a price that I deem is fair.$b$bI have been away from Suramar for some time now. I long for an Ysera's Dream Draught. To concoct it, you'll need some dreamleaf as well as the leaves of a Dreamer's Tear.$b$bOne grows not to far from here in the clearing of some ruins. Take my flask, make this drink for me, and I'll do as you ask.

text.title: 欢迎来到《军团再临》！
text.description: 欢迎来到《魔兽世界：军团再临》！我们希望你喜欢破碎群岛上为你准备的全新体验，并希望确保你全副武装与燃烧军团对抗。

english.title: Welcome to Legion!
english.description: Welcome to World of Warcraft: Legion! We hope you enjoy all of the new experiences that await you in the Broken Isles, and want to make sure you're well-armed to take on the Burning Legion.

text.title: 黄金海湾之谜
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾的黄金海湾与舰队上将特塞斯对话。
text.description: 燃烧军团入侵了艾泽拉斯，而军情七处却在浪费宝贵的资源抓捕和刺杀自己的顶级特工？$b$b感觉不太对劲……我们必须查出这事儿究竟牵连多深。安玻·吉尔妮为什么会遭到自己组织的追捕？$b$b她身上的那封密文信中也许会有线索……但我们需要更多信息。$b$b你在达拉然跟踪的杀手提到了黄金海湾……去黄金海湾寻找线索，我们会设法将破解这封密文信。

english.title: Mystery at Citrine Bay
english.objectives: Speak with Fleet Admiral Tethys at Citrine Bay in Stormheim.
english.description: The Burning Legion invades Azeroth, and SI:7 is wasting valuable resources hunting down and assassinating one of their top agents?$b$bSomething isn't adding up...$b$bWe need to find out how deep this goes. Why was Amber Kearnen being hunted by her own organization?$b$bThe encrypted letter she was carrying may hold the clues... but we need more information.$b$bThe SI:7 assassins you tailed in Dalaran mentioned Citrine Bay... search Citrine Bay for clues and we'll see about getting this letter decrypted.

text.title: 喝着朗姆，光阴飞逝！
text.objectives: 收集10瓶深红之剑朗姆酒。
text.description: 除了深红之剑以外，你也不会希望和其他海盗交战的！他们都是些酒鬼，实打实的！$b$b也就是说，他们酿造的朗姆酒很特别。我跟你说实话，$n……很少有朗姆酒能像深红之剑的那样美味。$b$b你去寻找线索的时候四处看看，找到酒的话带几瓶回来！$b$b能带几瓶带几瓶给我，我的奖励很大方的！我以海盗的荣耀发誓，$n！

english.title: Time Flies When Yer Havin' Rum!
english.objectives: Collect 10 bottles of Red Blade Rum.
english.description: Thar be few pirates ye want to cross swords wit' less than th' Red Blade! They be salty dogs, indeed!$b$bThat being said... they does have a way wit' rum! I'll level wit' ye, $n... thar be few rums as jolly as that 'o th' Red Blade.$b$bSeein' as ye be headin' off in search 'o clues, ye might as well brin' back a few bottles while ye be at it!$b$bBrin' me back as many bottles as ye can find, and I'll reward ye handsomely! Pirates honor, $n!

text.title: 伊利达雷盟友
text.objectives: 在暴风城法师区和伊利达雷代表会面。
text.description: 起初，我并不确定让伊利达雷进入这座城市是否明智。但他们刚刚救了我们所有人的命。$b$b我已经准许恶魔猎手们在法师区建立一座临时营地。我希望你能作为我的全权使节来和他们沟通。替我感谢伊利达雷的无私帮助，并且了解一下他们还能为我们提供哪些帮助。$b$b只是……记得保持警惕。他们驾驭着一种强大的力量，而我们必须做好防备——他们有可能被力量中所蕴藏的黑暗所吞噬。
text.completion: I see by the blood spatters that Jace revealed the demons to you. I trust the young king is safe.$b$bWe have more work ahead of us, $c. Much more.

english.title: Illidari Allies
english.objectives: Meet with the Illidari representative in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
english.description: At first I was unsure whether it was wise to allow the Illidari inside the city. But they may have just saved all our lives.$b$bI gave the demon hunters leave to establish a temporary camp in the Mage Quarter. I'd like you to be my personal envoy to them. Thank the Illidari for their assistance and see how they can aid our cause.$b$bJust... keep your eyes open. They have harnessed a terrible power, and we must be ready should they be consumed by the darkness within.
english.completion: I see by the blood spatters that Jace revealed the demons to you. I trust the young king is safe.$b$bWe have more work ahead of us, $c. Much more.

text.title: Druids of the Scythe - First Freed

english.title: Druids of the Scythe - First Freed

text.title: 投入战斗
text.objectives: 在伊利达雷哨所与恶魔猎手的首领谈一谈。
text.description:
燃烧军团在这里打败了我们，但是伊利达雷还没有倒下。看来恶魔猎手们正在独力坚守阵线，但是只能勉强支撑。

来吧，让你的武器发挥作用。在你痛击燃烧军团的时候，我会想出下一步行动。

english.title: Into the Fray
english.objectives: Speak with the lead demon hunter at Illidari Stand.
english.description:
The Burning Legion has beaten us here, but so too have the Illidari. It looks like the demon hunters are holding their own, but just barely.

Come, let's put that weapon of yours to use. I'll figure out our next move while you crush the Legion.

text.title: 从内部瓦解
text.objectives: 在法罗纳尔的征服岗哨寻找考瓦斯·血棘。
text.description:
我们的恶魔猎手考瓦斯·血棘和赛娅娜·夜刃已经带着一小支伊利达雷部队前往法罗纳尔。他们的任务是从内部削弱燃烧军团。

我有一阵子没收到他们的消息了。

如果你可以去找到他们，并且带领他们完成任务，那就再好不过了。你愿意吗？

english.title: From Within
english.objectives: Find Kor'vas Bloodthorn on Faronaar at Vanquish Point.
english.description:
Our demon hunters, Kor'vas Bloodthorn and Cyana Nightglaive took a small force of the Illidari across to Faronaar. Their mission was to weaken the Legion from within.

I haven't heard from them in a while.

It would be best if you could find and lead them to success. Agreed?

text.title: 日益严重的危机
text.objectives: 在法尔多拉神殿与山谷行者法罗丁会面。你可以使用沙尔艾兰的传送点前往目的地。
text.description:
阿坎多尔正在衰败。

这种能量原本流淌在它的枝干中，支持它的生长。生命与奥术之间原本是平衡的。

如今，这种能量却肆意流泄。当核心无法再约束能量时，这棵树就会杀掉殿堂里所有的活物。

我曾亲眼见过这种事，所以我必须设法阻止它再次发生。

我们必须找到以前的那棵树。它的遗骨可以指引我们。

在法尔多拉神殿和我碰头。我们一起下去。

english.title: A Growing Crisis
english.objectives: Meet Valewalker Farodin at the Temple of Fala'dora. You can travel there using the Portal to Falanaar in Shal'aran.
english.description:
The Arcan'dor is failing.

This energy was once bound in its boughs and fueled its growth. There was balance, between life and arcane.

Now that energy is breaking free. When the heart can no longer hold it, this tree will kill every living thing in this hall.

I have seen this happen before and I must find a way to stop it from happening again. 

We must go to the tree that came before. Its bones can guide us.

Meet me at the temple of Fal'adora. We will descend together.

text.title: 圣光的代价
text.objectives: 将圣光之心存放在你的职业大厅中。
text.description: “我们都不想担此重任，但这是命中注定的。”图拉扬最后的话语依旧回响在我的脑海中，挥之不去。我为德莱尼的命运而担忧……为我的朋友维伦的命运而担忧；但我们必须保持警惕，$n！$B$B至少现在，圣光之心依旧需要你的照看。我相信它可以安全地保存在艾泽拉斯大陆上的一个地方：你的职业大厅。将它带去那里，$n。我会留在达拉然，继续寻找答案。肯定还有其他办法！
text.completion: <A force within Light's Heart activates as you lay it down.>$B$B<You feel hopeful.>

english.title: Light's Charge
english.objectives: Place Light's Heart in your Order Hall.
english.description: "You did not ask for this burden, but it is what fate has deemed." Turalyon's haunting last words still echo in my mind. I worry about the fate of the draenei... about the fate of my friend, Velen; but we must remain vigilant, $n!$B$BFor now, Light's Heart remains under your watchful eye. There is one place on Azeroth that I would trust with the safekeeping of the object: your order hall. Take it there, $n. I will remain in Dalaran and continue looking for answers. There must be another way!
english.completion: <A force within Light's Heart activates as you lay it down.>$B$B<You feel hopeful.>

objectiveDetails.description: 将圣光之心放在职业大厅里

text.title: 处刑仪式
text.objectives: 点击颅骨堆，在逆风小径摩根墓场附近的地下墓穴中完成处刑仪式。
text.description:
头骨已经收集完毕，仪式场地也已筹备妥善。

唯一剩下的就念出咒语，然后刽子手的精华就能灌注到乌萨勒斯当中。

english.title: The Rite of the Executioner
english.objectives: Interact with the Pile of Skulls and complete the Rite of the Executioner in the crypt near Morgan's Plot in Deadwind Pass.
english.description:
The skulls have been gathered and the ritual area is prepared.

All that is left is to perform the incantation, and Ulthalesh will become imbued with the essence of the Executioner.

text.title: 寻找线索
text.objectives: 找到军情七处与深红之剑合作的证据。
text.description: 我们来黄金海湾调查一桩谋杀案，结果却在这里发现了臭名昭著的“深红之剑”海盗团伙，这绝对不是巧合！$b$b没错，绝对不可能是巧合，$n……但我们需要证据！$b$b你继续去寻找线索，我去找几个无赖审问一下。$b$b$n，我们肯定能查清这件事的！这一点毋庸置疑！

english.title: Searching For Clues
english.objectives: Find proof of SI:7 working with The Red Blade.
english.description: It be no coincidence that we be in Citrine Bay investigatin' a murder, and we find th' band 'o pirates known as th' Red Blade here as well!$b$bAye, this be no coincidence at all, $n... but we be needin' proof!$b$bYe go on ahead and look fer clues and I'll find some scallywags to interrogate.$b$bAye $n, we'll get t' 'th bottom o' this t' be sure! Thar be no doubt!

text.title: 又一扇门关闭了……
text.objectives: 返回沙尔艾兰。
text.description:
我希望你明白目前的危机。

来吧。这里已经没什么可做的事了。

到沙尔艾兰与我碰面，我们讨论一下之后的计划。

english.title: Another Arcan'dor Closes...
english.objectives: Return to Shal'aran.
english.description:
I hope you have a better understanding of what is at stake.

Come. There is no more for us to do here.

Meet me in Shal'aran and we will discuss what steps we may take next.

text.title: 马林的宝库赠品券
text.objectives: 将宝库赠品券交给马林·诺格弗格。
text.description: 这张宝库赠品券应当交到马林·诺格弗格手中。

english.title: A Ticket for Marin
english.objectives: Deliver the Vault Ticket to Marin Noggenfogger.
english.description: This Vault Ticket should be delivered to Marin Noggenfogger.

objectiveDetails.description: 将入场券交给马林·诺格弗格

text.title: 加尔顿的需求
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“加尔顿的需求”任务。
text.description:
战争领主加尔顿主动请缨，要为我们的事业招募更多的破碎者战士。首先，他需要一些东西。他提到要有合适的工具才能事半功倍之类的话。

是时候派出你的新勇士接受考验了。我敢肯定，这次的任务会非常辛苦。

english.title: Things Gaardoun Needs
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Things Gaardoun Needs".
english.description:
Battlelord Gaardoun has offered to recruit more broken warriors for the cause. He just needs a few things first. He said something about the right tool for the job, or something like that.

Time to put your new champions to the test. I'm sure it will be a grueling mission.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“加尔顿的需求”任务

text.title: 燃烧的时光之路
text.objectives: 完成5个时空漫游地下城。
text.description: 燃烧之星照耀着大地，使土地布满焦痕，四处都是干枯的景象。那是一颗残忍而恶毒的星星。在它的影响持续期间，新的道路将被打开，通往遥远的空间甚至时间。没有哪位贤者真正了解这一天象的涵义，但英勇的行为总会得到幸运的眷顾。

english.title: A Burning Path Through Time
english.objectives: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
english.description: The blazing star shines upon the land, searing the earth and parching the landscape. This star is relentless, malevolent almost. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

text.title: 冰冻的时光之路
text.objectives: 完成5个时空漫游地下城。
text.description: 寒冷之星用它冰冷的光芒照耀着大地，就连灵魂都退缩到了暗影之中。这颗星星与天空中其他的星星完全不同，它会吸取热量与生命。在它的影响持续期间，新的道路将被打开，通往遥远的空间与甚至时间。没有哪位贤者真正了解这一天象的涵义，但英勇的行为总会得到幸运的眷顾。

english.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
english.objectives: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
english.description: The chill star shines upon the land with its cold light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, sapping warmth and life. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

text.title: 崩裂的时光之路
text.objectives: 完成5个时空漫游地下城。
text.description: 毁灭者之星的光芒照耀着大地，就连灵魂都退缩到了暗影之中。这颗星星与天空中其他的星星完全不同，它可以揭示人们的弱点，哪怕是最勇敢的英雄也不例外。在它的影响持续期间，新的道路将被打开，通往遥远的空间甚至时间。没有哪位贤者真正了解这一天象的涵义，但英勇的行为总会得到幸运的眷顾。

english.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
english.objectives: Complete 5 Timewalking dungeons.
english.description: The Destroyer's star shines upon the land with its piercing light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, laying bare the weaknesses of even the boldest heroes. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

text.title: 战争的使者
text.objectives: 完成4个史诗难度的地下城。
text.description: 当战士的天象在夜空中闪耀之时，幸运将眷顾勇敢者。强大的敌人可能会带来更丰厚的奖赏。深入洞穴和要塞，证明你的价值。

english.title: Emissary of War
english.objectives: Complete 4 dungeons on Mythic difficulty.
english.description: When the sign of the warrior shines in the night sky, fortune favors the daring. Powerful foes may yield even greater rewards. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

text.title: 竞技场的召唤
text.objectives: 在竞技场练习赛中获得10场胜利。
text.description: 星辰的排列显示出了可怕的天象，刺激着人们心中嗜血的渴望，呼唤着战士到战场上与敌人短兵相接。在这样的日子里，竞技场高手们总是获利颇丰，他们可能也不明白为什么竞技场比赛总是场场爆满。在这激动人心的时刻，竞技场中会有丰厚的奖励等待着那些勇敢的，或者说莽撞的人……

english.title: The Arena Calls
english.objectives: Win 10 Arena Skirmish battles.
english.description: This alignment of the stars is a dire sign, stirring bloodlust and calling warriors to battle to the death in close quarters. Arena masters turn a tidy profit during these days, likely not understanding why their stands are overflowing. Amidst the excitement, great rewards do await those brave, or foolhardy, enough to venture into the arena....

objectiveDetails.description: 获得竞技场练习赛胜利

text.title: 战斗的呼唤
text.objectives: 在战场中获得4场胜利。
text.description: 将军与战争领主的幸运星主宰了天空，护佑着各地的战术家。有人说战争之星可以强化指挥官的本能，让他们拥有接近先知的能力。如果你曾经打算在战场上检验自己的水平，现在就是最好的时机了。

english.title: A Call to Battle
english.objectives: Win 4 Battleground matches.
english.description: The favorite star of warlords and generals dominates the sky, offering good fortune to tacticians everywhere. Some say that the battle star hones the instincts of commanders to the point of near-prophecy. If ever you were going to test yourself on the field of battle, now is the time.

text.title: The Very Best
text.objectives: Defeat 5 players through Find Battle with a team of level 25 pets.
text.description: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

english.title: The Very Best
english.objectives: Defeat 5 players through Find Battle with a team of level 25 pets.
english.description: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

text.title: 世界在等待
text.objectives: 在破碎群岛完成20个世界任务。
text.description: 当使者的象征在夜空中闪烁时，星辰将会强化已有的羁绊，并会创建新的联系。想要获取友谊并不容易，你需要通过自己的行为来证明忠诚，但在这样的日子，信任会更容易建立。在破碎群岛上游历一番，尽量四处提供帮助，以证明你的价值。

english.title: The World Awaits
english.objectives: Complete 20 World Quests in the Broken Isles.
english.description: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture across the Broken Isles, and give aid where you may, to prove your worth.

text.title: 家的便利
text.objectives: 把旅行者的银柜带到沙尔艾兰。
text.description: 这个箱子对我们的事业很有帮助。将箱子带回沙尔艾兰。

english.title: The Conveniences of Home
english.objectives: Take the Traveler's Banking Chest to Shal'aran.
english.description: This chest could prove very useful to our efforts. Take the chest back to Shal'aran.

objectiveDetails.description: 把旅行者的银柜放到沙尔艾兰

text.title: 黑暗的秘密和不可告人的交易
text.objectives: 与拉文霍德公爵对话。
text.description: 不管安玻·吉尔妮知道了什么，马迪亚斯·肖尔都不想让她泄露出去……$b$b没错，这绝对是一笔肮脏的交易，用这样的高价雇佣深红之剑……竟然只是为了去追捕和刺杀他们的自己人！$b$b你最好返回暗影大厅，将我们在黄金海湾的发现告诉拉文霍德公爵。$b$b不管军情七处有什么阴谋，都比我们之前想象的更为严重……

english.title: Dark Secrets and Shady Deals
english.objectives: Speak with Lord Ravenholdt.
english.description: Whatever Amber Kearnen knew, Mathias Shaw didn't want it gettin' out...$b$bAye, this be dirty business indeed, hiring th' Red Blade at such a price... just to hunt down and kill one of their own!$b$bYe best get back to th' Hall 'o Shadows, and let Lord Ravenholdt know what we found here in Citrine Bay.$b$bWhatever SI:7 be up to, it be goin' deeper than we first imagined...

text.title: 威力超强的药水
text.objectives: 从加里维克斯的私人保险箱中偷取6号爱情药水。
text.description: 我有个任务给你，$n！$b$b据说贸易大王加里维克斯最近获得了一瓶价值连城、独一无二的爱情药水。只有一个地精可以复制这种药水，远在天边近在眼前！将那瓶药水带来，我会让我们比国王更富有！$b$b忘忧宫就在艾萨拉里面。自从战争开始之后，那里就进入了高度戒备状态。除了他的私人员工之外，加里维克斯不允许任何人进入。但我认识一个内部人员！$b$b找到她，她会帮你找到保险箱的！

english.title: A Particularly Potent Potion
english.objectives: Steal Love Potion #6 from Gallywix's personal safe.
english.description: I've got a proposition for ya, $n!$b$bWord has it that Trade Prince Gallywix recently acquired a priceless, one-of-a-kind love potion. There's only one goblin who can replicate it and you're looking at him! Get me that potion and I can make us both richer than kings!$b$bThe pleasure palace is located in Azshara and it has been on high alert since the war started. Gallywix isn't letting anybody in except his personal staff, but I know a girl on the inside!$b$bFind her and she'll get you to the safe!

text.title: Treasure
text.objectives: Speak with Valtrois.
text.description:
There is a strange energy in the air.

I feel as if a force is growing, pressing down on us. It is worrisome.

Valtrois works most closely with the sources of power in this room.

Speak to her. Ask if there is anything to be concerned with.

english.title: Treasure
english.objectives: Speak with Valtrois.
english.description:
There is a strange energy in the air.

I feel as if a force is growing, pressing down on us. It is worrisome.

Valtrois works most closely with the sources of power in this room.

Speak to her. Ask if there is anything to be concerned with.

text.title: 兵临城下
text.objectives: 在达拉然的守护者大厅与卡德加见面。
text.description: <元素里又传出了卡德加的声音。>$B$B我们能在燃烧军团阻挠之前，获得创世之柱的情报，这是一项了不起的胜利。虽然无法挽回破碎海滩上消逝的生命，但我相信这能帮助我们为他们复仇。$b$b达拉然已经成为了军团进攻的焦点，你必须在这里协助防御。既然恶魔还在花费那么大力气攻击这座城市，那就意味着，达拉然在拯救艾泽拉斯的行动中扮演着极其重要的角色。
text.completion: I shored up Karazhan's defenses as best I could, but I have little confidence they'll hold. We have other matters to focus on in any case.$b$bGul'dan has set his demon dogs loose upon Dalaran. He wants this city gone... but we're not going to let him have his way.$b$bI believe Dalaran will become the focal point of our campaign against the Legion, neutral ground where the heroes of every kingdom can join together against our mutual foe.$b$bLet's get to work, $n.

english.title: City Under Siege
english.objectives: Meet Khadgar at the Chamber of the Guardian in Dalaran.
english.description: <Khadgar's voice erupts from the elemental once again.>$B$BObtaining information on the Pillars of Creation before the Legion could stop us was a considerable victory. It won't bring back those we lost on the Broken Shore, but I believe it will help us avenge them.$b$bDalaran has become a focal point of the Legion's assault. Your presence here is crucial. If the demons are putting this much effort into attacking the city, it means Dalaran will play a pivotal role in the struggle to save Azeroth.
english.completion: I shored up Karazhan's defenses as best I could, but I have little confidence they'll hold. We have other matters to focus on in any case.$b$bGul'dan has set his demon dogs loose upon Dalaran. He wants this city gone... but we're not going to let him have his way.$b$bI believe Dalaran will become the focal point of our campaign against the Legion, neutral ground where the heroes of every kingdom can join together against our mutual foe.$b$bLet's get to work, $n.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门前往卡拉赞上方的达拉然

text.title: 勇士：乔拉齐·拉文霍德公爵
眨眼之间
text.objectives: 见证达拉然传送到破碎群岛。
text.description: 我们的目的地是破碎群岛，$n。$b$b将达拉然闪现到新位置的法术可不简单。它需要议会投入全部的力量和注意力。$b$b由于吉安娜的……缺席，蓝龙军团的卡雷苟斯会来帮助我们。$b$b燃烧军团一定会不遗余力地阻止我们，但我们是不会动摇的。该开始了！
text.completion: Ah, $n, it's good to see you on your feet! The members of the Council of Six are recuperating from their ordeal.$b$bThe intensity of the teleportation spell can be disorienting. It seems you lost consciousness for a time, but at least you didn't awaken to find yourself stuck in a wall!$b$bDalaran has been relocated to the Broken Isles. From here, we will spearhead the effort to acquire the Pillars of Creation and drive the Legion from Azeroth once and for all!

english.title: In the Blink of an Eye
english.objectives: Witness the teleportation of Dalaran to the Broken Isles.
english.description: The Broken Isles is our destination, $n.$b$bThe spell that will blink Dalaran to its new location is not a simple one. It will take this Council's full energy and attention.$b$bAs Jaina is... absent, Kalecgos of the blue dragonflight has offered us his aid.$b$bThe Legion will make every attempt to stop us, but we will not falter. It is time to begin!
english.completion: Ah, $n, it's good to see you on your feet! The members of the Council of Six are recuperating from their ordeal.$b$bThe intensity of the teleportation spell can be disorienting. It seems you lost consciousness for a time, but at least you didn't awaken to find yourself stuck in a wall!$b$bDalaran has been relocated to the Broken Isles. From here, we will spearhead the effort to acquire the Pillars of Creation and drive the Legion from Azeroth once and for all!

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门前往卡拉赞上方的达拉然

text.title: Special Army of the Dead Summoned

english.title: Special Army of the Dead Summoned

text.title: 武器订单
text.objectives: 下达订单，订购一批勇士武器和装备。
text.description: 我能以最优惠的价格给你弄到一些稍微用过……几次的……装备。

english.title: Workorders for Armaments
english.objectives: Place a workorder for a shipment of Champion Armaments and Equipment.
english.description: I can get you the best deals on some slightly... used... equipment.

objectiveDetails.description: 下达一张勇士武器的工作订单

text.title: 封印他们的命运
text.objectives: 下达一份破碎命运印记订单。
text.description:
有没有觉得运气总是不在你这一边？也许我能帮上些忙。

我的旅途中见识过一些有趣的小玩意儿，它们能让你万事如意，至少也能多给你一次机会。这可能需要一些时间，货源也不是很充足。但我至少能给你弄到一个……当然这会需要一点点代价。

english.title: Seal their Fates
english.objectives: Place a work order for a Seal of Broken Fate.
english.description:
Ever feel like luck just isn't on your side?  Well maybe I can help you with that.  

There are some interesting items I've come across in my travels which can be used to swing the dice in your favor, or at least give you another shot at it.  It takes some time, and supplies are hard to come by, but I can get you one of them... for a price?

objectiveDetails.description: 下达一份破碎命运印记订单

text.title: 改变命运
text.objectives: 下达一份破碎命运印记订单。
text.description:
灵魂的奇想是可以被引导的，我之前见过这种事情。

有低语说，有一种宝物，一种办法，可以改变命运的道路。我听到过这低语，而且我去探寻过它的来源。多年以来，我都从风中听到这些低语，直到有一天，它们为我指出了道路。而这，就是我要给予你的东西。这可能得花费一些时间，还有一些宝贵的资源。但之后，我就能通过仪式来让你掌握这种力量。

你觉得如何呢？准备好了吗？

english.title: Shape Your Fate
english.objectives: Place a work order for a Seal of Broken Fate.
english.description:
The whims of the spirits can be guided, I have seen it.

There were whispers of an item, a way to change the path of destiny.  I heard dem, and I went looking.  For many years I listened to those whispers on the wind until one day they showed me the way.  This is what I offer you.  It will take some time, and some valuable resources, but I can perform the ritual to allow you to control this power.

Well?  Are you ready?

objectiveDetails.description: 下达一份破碎命运印记订单

text.title: 升腾者
text.objectives: 下达命令，招募升腾者。
text.description:
这些萨满终其一生致力于钻研风、水和火之道。只要你下达命令，我们就会祈求这些元素来升腾他们。在升腾之后，他们会成为短暂而强大的力量，可以参与到对抗军团的战争之中。

升腾仪式可不能轻易进行。

english.title: The Ascended
english.objectives: Place a request to recruit Ascendants.
english.description:
These shaman have spent their lives dedicated to the path of Air, Water or Fire.  On your request, we will beseech the elements to Ascend them, becoming a powerful, if short lived, force to deploy in this war against the Legion.

The ritual of ascension is not to be requested lightly.

objectiveDetails.description: 下达命令以招募升腾者

text.title: 满是宝物的传送门
text.objectives: 下达订单，订购一批勇士武器和装备。
text.description:
当我听说守护者圣殿重新开启的时候，我就对自己说：“米娜蒂，你的机会来了！”我急匆匆地赶了过来，满心以为会被直接扔到前线去。想象一下吧，我，又矮又老的我，用法术攻击恶魔，再闪现躲开邪能流星。那真是太棒了！

可实际上，他们把我派到了这里，还说：“你能在这儿开几个传送门吗？那样我们就能从这儿扔些东西过去了。”至少我能从中赚点钱。

english.title: Portal Full of Shiny Things
english.objectives: Place a work order for Champion armaments and equipment.
english.description:
When I heard the Hall of the Guardian was open again, I said to myself "Minuette, this is your chance!" I rushed over here thinking I'd be hurled into the front lines.  Imagine it, me, little old me, assaulting Demons with missiles, blinking away from Fel Meteors.  That would be brilliant!

Instead, they send me over here and say "Hey, open up some portals so we can throw things through, would you?" At least I get to charge something for it.

objectiveDetails.description: 下达一份勇士武器订单

text.title: 命与时
text.objectives: 下达一份破碎命运印记订单。
text.description:
多年以来，我们一直在怀疑，在揣测——我们究竟有没有可能掌控那错综复杂、稍纵即逝而又不可捉摸的命运？这些书籍向我们展示了那些掌握了操纵时间的力量的强大法师的故事。不不，不是时间扭曲那样的东西。他们会嘲笑我们这些愚蠢的初学者的。不，他们是真正的时光之主。

我们所能解读出的唯一法术是一个咒语。他们将其称之为“命运印记”。这可以让他们重演过去的行动。不如我们试一下吧？

english.title: Fate and Time
english.objectives: Place a work order for a Seal of Broken Fate.
english.description:
For years we wondered, we conjectured, that it was possible to control the twisting, slipping, streaming threads of fate and destiny.  These books tell of powerful mages who embraced the manipulation of time.  No no, not like Time Warp, they would laugh at us, think us silly amateurs.  No, they were true Chronomancers.

The only spell we've been able to determine is a conjuration.  It calls forth what they termed  a "Seal of Fate".  This allowed them to repeat their actions.  Let us try it out shall we?

objectiveDetails.description: 下达一份破碎命运印记订单

text.title: 达拉然之力
text.objectives: 将达拉然的力量导入聚焦水晶，然后释放力量以完成一个世界任务。
text.description:
在危急关头，达拉然的法师可以把力量汇聚成一种纯粹的毁灭性武器。而眼下就是这样的非常时刻。

一旦收到指示，法师们会把力量导入一个聚焦水晶之中，然后我们会把它交给你。释放它的力量，完成一项意义非凡的任务。

english.title: The Might of Dalaran
english.objectives: Channel the power of Dalaran into the focusing crystal, then unleash it to complete a World Quest.
english.description:
In times of great need, the mages of Dalaran can focus their power into one pure, destructive form.  This is such a time.

On request, these mages will channel that power into a focusing crystal, which we will impart to you.  Use it to unleash that power, completing a quest of great value.

objectiveDetails.description: 在地图上使用“达拉然之力”

text.title: The Might of Dalaran pt2
text.objectives: Collect the Focusing Crystal and use it to complete a world quest.
text.description: Yes, now once the crystal has been empowered, collect it here, and use it to unleash the power of our mages on a world quest.

english.title: The Might of Dalaran pt2
english.objectives: Collect the Focusing Crystal and use it to complete a world quest.
english.description: Yes, now once the crystal has been empowered, collect it here, and use it to unleash the power of our mages on a world quest.

objectiveDetails.description: Use the "Might of Dalaran" on the Map to complete a World Quest

text.title: 隐秘武器
text.objectives: 下达订单，订购一批勇士武器和装备。
text.description:
如果我们想要赢得这场战争，我们就得给我们的勇士们更好的装备。

它们并不便宜，也不容易获得。但我能给你弄来。

english.title: Unseen Armaments
english.objectives: Place a work order for Champion armaments and equipment.
english.description:
If we gonna win dis war, we need to get these Champions of ours better equipment.  

It won't be cheap, or easy, but I can get dem for you.

objectiveDetails.description: 下达一份勇士武器订单

text.title: 隐秘命运
text.objectives: 下达一份破碎命运印记订单。
text.description:
狩猎之路崎岖变幻，充满艰难险阻。但是你知道吗？踏上这条道路的机会并不止一次。我们现在有机会获取一件具有强大力量的宝物。它能给我们一次机会，重新来过的机会。

你想得到这个机会吗？

english.title: Unseen Fate
english.objectives: Place a work order for a Seal of Broken Fate.
english.description:
Our path is a winding, twisting road full of peril.  Yet did you know it can be walked many times?  There is an item of great power available to us.  It allows us another opportunity, a second chance.

Do you wish to acquire one?

objectiveDetails.description: 下达一份破碎命运印记订单

text.title: 时刻准备！
text.objectives: 接受伊利达雷的礼物。
text.description:
$n，你的力量和领导才能激励了我们所有人！

伊利达雷准备为你提供全套装备来协助你对抗燃烧军团。继续在破碎群岛上扩展你的影响力吧，要不了多久我们就会取得胜利。

english.title: You Will Be Prepared!
english.objectives: Accept a gift from the Illidari.
english.description:
$n, your strength and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

The Illidari are prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

text.title: 还有一件事……
text.objectives: 前往位于邪能之槌号下层的纳斯雷兹姆诅咒熔炉。
text.description:
干得好，屠魔者。你现在真正地成为了伊利达雷的领袖。但你还有一件事要做。

我们在熔炉那儿见。

english.title: One More Thing...
english.objectives: Head down to the chamber of the Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim on the lower level of the Fel Hammer.
english.description:
Well done, Slayer. You are truly now the leader of the Illidari. But there's one more thing.

Meet me down at the forge.

text.title: 还有一件事……
text.objectives: 到无冕宝库和拉文霍德公爵会面。
text.description:
首先，请允许我恭喜你。没有人比你更适合暗影之刃这个称号。但我还有一件事要做。

到熔炉附近来找我。

english.title: One More Thing...
english.objectives: Meet Lord Ravenholdt in the Uncrowned Vault.
english.description:
Firstly, allow me to congratulate you. I know of no one more deserving of the title of Shadowblade. But there's one more thing.

Meet me over near the forge.

text.title: 死亡领主护甲
text.objectives: 接受黑锋骑士团的礼物。
text.description:
$n很强！$n是伟大的领袖！

黑锋骑士团想要送你一套护甲来帮助你多杀点恶魔。变得更强些，杀更多恶魔！

english.title: Armor Fit For A Deathlord
english.objectives: Accept a gift from the Knights of the Ebon Blade.
english.description:
$n is strong! $n is great leader!

Ebon Blade want to give you full set of armor to help with the little demon killing. Get stronger, make demons more dead!

text.title: 勇士武器
text.objectives: 下达订单，订购一批勇士武器和装备。
text.description:
这场对抗燃烧军团的战争并不容易。我们需要武器和装备来武装我们的勇士。

下命令吧长官，我会把命令传达出去，并带回军备物资。

english.title: Champion Armaments
english.objectives: Place a work order for Champion armaments and equipment.
english.description:
This war against the Legion won't be won easily.  We will need armaments and equipment for our Champions.  

Give the order sir, I'll get the word out and have a shipment brought in.

objectiveDetails.description: 下达一份勇士武器订单

text.title: 命运祝福
text.objectives: 下达一份破碎命运印记订单。
text.description:
圣光的祝福非常强大。我们用它来治愈创伤，也用它来击败敌人……我们甚至能用它复活战友。你知道吗？它还可以扭转你的命运。

白银之手可以找到一件宝物，它可以帮助你对抗燃烧军团。这个封印能在最关键的时刻给你一次改变命运的机会。

要我们帮你去找吗？

english.title: Fate's Blessing
english.objectives: Place a work order for a Seal of Broken Fate.
english.description:
The Light's blessing is powerful. We use it to mend, to defeat our enemies... we even use it to resurrect our allies. Did you know it can also be used to alter your destiny?  

The Silver Hand is able to procure a valuable item to help you in our war against the Legion. This Seal can be used at the most opportune moments to grant another chance at destiny.

守望者地窟里的状况比我们想象的还要糟糕。原来的囚犯摇身一变成为了狱卒，全面占领了地窟。不过，我们情报显示，科达娜·邪歌可能就在那里。

进入守望者地窟，净化那里的邪恶。

english.title: Vault of the Wardens
english.objectives: Defeat Cordana Felsong in Vault of the Wardens.
english.description:
It's worse than we thought within the Vault of the Wardens. The prisoners have become the jailers, and have completely taken over the vault. However, our intelligence reports that Cordana Felsong herself may be there.

Enter the Vault of the Wardens and cleanse the place of evil.

text.objectives: Defeat Advisor Vandros in The Arcway.
text.description:
The Arcway is even more vast than we thought, and holds many dangers. If we have any hope of taking the city, we must first see to the underground.

Enter The Arcway and clear out any, and all enemies.

text.description:
魔法回廊比我们想象的还要错综复杂，并且危机四伏。想要攻下那座城市，我们就必须将目光转向地下。

进入魔法回廊，消灭所有的敌人。

text.objectives: 击败奈萨里奥巢穴的达古尔。
text.description:
我们的斥候发现，卓格巴尔不仅得到了泰坦圣物，还集结了一支足以威胁整个世界的大军。

在卓格巴尔军队大举入侵之前，深入地下，阻止地底之王。

english.title: Neltharion's Lair
english.objectives: Defeat Dargrul in Neltharion's Lair.
english.description:
Our scouts found that not only have the drogbar obtained a Titan relic, but also they've amassed an army large enough to threaten the overworld.

Delve underground and stop the Underking before he can unleash the might of his drogbar army.

text.objectives: 击败噬魂之喉的海拉。
text.description:
根据我们的斥候报告，被诅咒的维库人被迫登上了纳格法尔号幽灵船。

前往噬魂之喉并击败海拉，阻止她吸收更多的不幸灵魂。

english.title: Maw of Souls
english.objectives: Defeat Helya in Maw of Souls.
english.description:
Our scouts report that the vrykul damned are forced to sail aboard the Naglfar, a ship built of death.

Travel to the Maw of Souls and confront Helya, before she collects any more poor, unfortunate souls.

text.objectives: 击败英灵殿中的奥丁。
text.description:
奥丁亲自发来了一则消息。他和他的战士们正在英灵殿里等待有资格的挑战者出现。

击败英灵殿的勇士，夺得荣耀。

english.description:
Odyn himself sends a message. He and his warriors await worthy contenders within the Halls of Valor.

Defeat the champions of the Halls of Valor, and claim glory.

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼
text.objectives: 击败艾萨拉之眼的艾萨拉之怒。
text.description:
我们经过调查发现，在艾萨拉女王的命令之下，纳迦正在准备召唤某种强大的存在，企图让艾萨拉的力量席卷整个破碎群岛。

前往艾萨拉之眼，阻止这场仪式。

english.title: Eye of Azshara
english.objectives: Defeat the Wrath of Azshara in Eye of Azshara.
english.description:
Our investigation found that the naga, under the orders of Queen Azshara herself, are preparing to summon a powerful entity to unleash Azshara's power across the Broken Isles.

Travel to the Eye of Azshara, and put a stop to the ritual.

text.title: 黑心林地
text.objectives: 击败黑心林地的萨维斯之影。
text.description:
在莎拉达希尔的枝干底下，萨维斯不断施压，扭曲并折磨着曾经圣洁的德鲁伊林地。

不仅如此，萨维斯还俘虏了许多德鲁伊，以缓慢又痛苦的方式折磨他们。我们必须前往黑心林地，阻止他的邪恶计划。

english.title: Darkheart Thicket
english.objectives: Defeat the Shade of Xavius in Darkheart Thicket.
english.description:
Beneath the boughs of Shaladrassil, Xavius extends his power to twist and torment the once-pure druid grove. 

Not only this, but Xavius has taken a prize from among the druids, and his revenge will be slow and painful. We should go to Darkheart Thicket and stop his wicked plans.

objectiveDetails.description: 在黑心林地击败萨维斯之影

text.description:
The weather is perfect for a party, isn't it?

Travel to the Court of Stars, where the Grand Magistrix herself may appear among her nobles to reassure them of the need for all the Legion patrols.

这样的天气最适合开派对了，不是吗？

前往群星庭院，大魔导师可能会在那里现身，试图让贵族们认同燃烧军团巡逻的必要性。

text.objectives: 击败黑鸦堡垒的库塔洛斯·拉文凯斯。
text.description:
我们的勇士在调查黑鸦堡垒废墟的时候遭到了伏击！黑鸦领主似乎已经和燃烧军团勾结到了一起。

我们需要你协助我们击败他不断壮大的军队并将他消灭。

english.title: The Lord of Black Rook Hold
english.objectives: Defeat Lord Kur'talos Ravencrest in Black Rook Hold.
english.description:
While investigating the remains of Black Rook Hold, our Champions were ambushed!  The Lord of the Rook appears to have allied himself with the Legion.

We need your assistance to defeat his growing army, and bring him down.

text.title: 解救伊利达雷
text.objectives: 解救瑟留斯·黑翼、凯赛尔·夜棘和阿莎·鸦歌。
text.description: <奥顿·魂刃身上的几道可怕的伤口正在流血。看上去他被留在这儿等死。>$B$B这监狱里有我们的三个……<咳咳>……战友。$B$B我们在侦察这片区域的时候遭到了突袭。$B$B我已经活不了多久了，$n，但请你……你还能救回他们。

english.title: Illidari Freedom
english.objectives: Free Sirius Ebonwing, Cassiel Nightthorn, and Asha Ravensong.
english.description: <Arduen Soulblade is bleeding from several ghastly wounds. It appears he was left here to die.>$B$BWithin the prison are three of our... <cough>... comrades.$B$BWe were taken by surprise while scouting the area.$B$BI am not long for this world, $n, but please... you can still save them.

text.title: 整装待发
text.objectives: 拜访德拉诺什尔封锁线的部落部队。
text.description:
我们的盟友已经赶到了奥格瑞玛，前来支援我们的战斗。

你先去拜访他们一下吧，$n。有了他们的支援，我们的胜利会更有把握。

english.title: To Be Prepared
english.objectives: Visit Horde forces in Dranosh'ar Blockade.
english.description:
Our allies have made the journey to Orgrimmar to support our war efforts.

Stop and visit with them, $n. Their assistance will secure our victory today.

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：冰封之魂
text.objectives: 从艾萨拉之怒那里取回冰封之魂吊坠。
text.description: 啊，死亡领主。很高兴见到你。如果你想要去冒险的话，我正好有一个惊险刺激的任务要交给你。$b$b我最近发现了一本书的晦涩脚注，上面记述了艾萨拉女王亲自创造的一个古代护符的故事！它叫做冰封之魂吊坠，能够为冰霜之力的操控者提供强大的力量。$b$b根据我的推断，我们或许能够在艾萨拉之眼那里找到这个吊坠。$b$b请为我取回那个吊坠，它可以为我的研究提供极大的帮助。

english.title: Eye of Azshara: The Frozen Soul
english.objectives: Retrieve the Frozen Soul Pendant from the Wrath of Azshara.
english.description: Ah, Deathlord. It is good to see you. I happen to have a fascinating task for you, should you be in the mood for adventure.$b$bI recently came across an obscure reference to an ancient amulet that was created by Queen Azshara herself! It is called the Frozen Soul Pendant and it offers tremendous power to those who channel the power of frost.$b$bI have reason to believe that it may be found somewhere within the Eye of Azshara.$b$bRetrieve the pendant for me, and it will prove most useful in my studies.

text.title: 翡翠梦魇：撕开帷幕
text.objectives: 从普通难度翡翠梦魇的塞纳留斯身上收集4个清醒精华。
text.description: 梦魇的黑暗力量层层笼罩，扭曲了现实，并且使所有生命的感知都发生了变化。梦境中的空间都已经逐渐得到净化，萨维斯的掌控遭到了削弱。很快，通往梦魇中心的道路就会显露出来。但也许还有一种更直接的方法……我的老师曾经提到过，有一种纯净的力量能够穿透梦魇的黑暗，并让所有通路都变得明晰。但是可惜的是，塞纳留斯迷失了……

english.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Piercing the Veil
english.objectives: Collect 4 Essences of Clarity from Cenarius in The Emerald Nightmare on Normal difficulty.
english.description: The darkness of the Nightmare is like a heavy shroud, warping reality and altering the perception of all living things. As areas of the Dream are cleansed, Xavius's hold weakens, and the way to the heart of the Nightmare will be revealed. But there might be a more direct way... my teacher once spoke of a pure power that could illuminate the darkness of the Nightmare, and allow all paths to become clear. But alas, Cenarius is lost....

text.title: 守望者地窟：血肉杰作
text.objectives: 从守望者地窟中取回跳动的邪能之心和恶魔内脏。
text.description: 啊，死亡领主！这真是个令人高兴的惊喜！您很少亲自来参观我的工坊。$b$b实际上，我为您准备了一件特殊的礼物。我之前一直在开发一种新型憎恶，它混合了恶魔与人类的血肉。$b$b我的第一只原型体“腐肠”已经接近完成了！不过，我还缺乏一些难以获取的身体部件。$b$b或许守望者地窟的囚犯们可以为我的作品捐献一些身体部件。

english.title: Vault of the Wardens: A Masterpiece of Flesh
english.objectives: Retrieve the Beating Fel-Heart and Demonic Entrails from Vault of the Wardens.
english.description: Ah, Deathlord! What a pleasant surprise! It is not often that you visit my workshop of blood and flesh.$b$bActually, I have something quite special to show you. I have been developing a new type of abomination that mixes the flesh of demons with that of humans.$b$bMy first prototype, Rottgut, is nearly complete! However I am still missing some of the more difficult-to-find body items.$b$bThe prisoners in the Vault of the Wardens should make fine donors for the parts I require.

text.title: 团体的祝福
text.objectives: 请求团体的祝福。
text.description: 尽管这需要耗费时间和资源，但我们可以为你的勇士们赋予祝福。有了祝福之力，他们成功完成任务的几率将大大提高。

english.title: Blessings of the Order
english.objectives: Request a Blessing of the Order.
english.description: Though it takes time and resources, we are able to, of course, Bless your champions.  With this Blessing, their success on their adventures will be greatly improved.

text.title: 三倍力量
text.objectives: 告诉梅瑞尔你是否要去寻找下一件神器。
text.description:
如果你想探寻其他类型的魔法力量的话，我们得到了你所要寻找的最后一件神器的情报。

详情都在这里。告诉我你准备怎么做。

english.title: Thrice the Power
english.objectives: Let Meryl know if you'd like to pursue another artifact.
english.description:
We have information on one last artifact you might seek out, should you seek to weave other types of magic.

All the details are here. Let me know how you'd like to proceed.
